Augmented Body: Barem has strength, defense, and speed well above average for being a hybrid, being able to match beings like Katana Man and Chainsaw Man.

Flamethrowers: Barem can generate powerful blasts of fire from his flamethrowers; they are strong enough to cause explosions that reach an entire floor of a building and set an entire horde of zombies on fire.

Blood Consumption: As a Hybrid, Barem is able to heal wounds by consuming blood, regenerating his entire body.

Nigh-Immortality: Due to being a Hybrid, Barem is immortal and nearly unkillable. He can survive being shredded, getting shot, and take all kinds of injuries that would kill most Devils. Even if he dies, as long as someone presses his molar, Barem can come back to life in perfect condition.

entries.name: Bat Devil
entries.content: The Bat Devil is a devil who embodies the fear of bats. The Bat Devil resembled an enormous humanoid bat with multiple sharp teeth and large round eyes. His arms are connected to his torso by flaps of skin which also serve as wings. During his introduction he was missing an arm but regrew it after consuming blood from Denji. While keeping Meowy prisoner he wore a birdcage on a chain around his neck which he kept the cat in. After his death, the Bat Devil returned to Earth with a different appearance, such as parts of him having more exposed flesh, with large bulging eyes and bigger and unbalanced teeth. After his death, the Bat Devil returned to Earth with different personality. The bat devil is far less intelligent to the point that he appears to be incapable of speech. He is now a savage monster that acts purely on instincts.

entries.name: Beam
entries.content:
Beam was a Shark Fiend and a Public Safety Devil Hunter from Tokyo Special Division 4. Beam possesses the body of a muscular young man and as a fiend his shark's snout and fin replace of the top half of his head; he has no visible eyes. He has short, spiky black hair and very sharp teeth. He exclusively wears swimming trunks. Beam is very eccentric, naive and innocent. He often goes along with Denji's plans no matter how crazy they are due to having a lot of respect for the Chainsaw Devil. His devotion to the Chainsaw Man is such that he always tries to protect Denji personally and will offer his blood to revive him, even if ends up severely hurting or killing him.

He is shown to greatly enjoy fighting, eagerly diving into packs of zombies and eating them.

entries.name: Bucky
entries.content: Bucky is the Chicken Devil, a Devil that embodies the fear of chickens. Bucky appears as a headless chicken with a bow tie. He is able to speak despite the lack of a head. Bucky has a cheerful personality, constantly joking and trying to get along with the students. Despite being a Devil, he shows absolutely no antagonism or hostility to humans, though he does mention he’d have no hope of surviving on his own, which may hint at the pragmatism of being friendly.

entries.name: Carpenter Bee Devil
entries.content: The Carpenter Bee Devil is a devil that embodies the fear of carpenter bees. The Carpenter Bee Devil's appearance is that of an extremely large bee with multiple eyes and jagged teeth.

entries.name: Class President
entries.content:
An unnamed high school student was the class president of Asa Mitaka's class at Fourth East High School who made a contract with the Justice Devil out of jealousy. Originally, she appeared to be mild-mannered and supportive, such as when she sought out and consoled Asa Mitaka after their class was given Bucky. In reality, she was delusional, presumptuous and narcissistic, believing that Asa was having a sexual relationship with their teacher, Mr. Tanaka, whom she herself had been having a sexual relationship with.

It is possible that, just like with Yuko, her personality got warped by the Justice Devil and that her original personality was quite different.

entries.name: The Claw Devil is a devil that embodies the fear of claws. At some point Kishibe made a contract with the Claw Devil
keys: The Claw Devil is a devil that embodies the fear of claws. At some point Kishibe made a contract with the Claw Devil
entries.comment: The Claw Devil is a devil that embodies the fear of claws. At some point Kishibe made a contract with the Claw Devil

entries.name: Cockroach Devil
entries.content: The Cockroach Devil is a devil who embodies the fear of cockroaches. The Cockroach Devil is gigantic and has a meshwork appearance of a skeletal layer on its body that covers its head but does not fully cover its exposed torso. It resembles a humanoid cockroach and has antennae on its head and across its back. The Cockroach Devil seems to be calculating and vengeful, hoping to catch Chainsaw Man off-guard by dropping a highschool teenager and a car full of elderly people in order to test Chainsaw Man's ability to be a "superhero."

entries.name: Cosmo
entries.content:
Cosmo is the Cosmos Fiend, and was one of Quanxi's girlfriends and represents the fear of omniscience and gaining knowledge of everything in the universe. 

Cosmo possesses a corpse with spiky pink shoulder-length hair fashioned into pigtails with red hair bands. She also has hearts for pupils, colored either orange-red or yellow-red, and her right eye usually hangs out of its socket. On the surface, Cosmo doesn't exhibit many emotions aside from her usual smiling, happy-go-lucky attitude. She doesn't speak except for repeating the word "Halloween" and, like the rest of Quanxi's fiends, follows Quanxi around and is in constant love with her and under her command. When Cosmo uses her powers on Santa Claus, the two had a conversation in Cosmo's mind, revealing her true inner personality. Here, she is capable of talking normally, conversing with Santa Claus about what's happening. She is straightforward and formal in her manner of speaking, seeming far less excitable than her outward personality. Cosmo was not particularly upset about her girlfriend's murders, explaining that she has no emotions strong enough to drive her to be upset about "the course of nature". Her true personality therefore seems more logical, detached from others, and mostly devoid of emotion.

Her surface personality might be the result of her powers affecting her, causing her to only say "Halloween." However, unlike those she inflicts her power upon, Cosmo is still capable of understanding the speech of others and seems to be capable of thinking, as she is able to take orders and carry them out just fine.

Cosmo is shown as one of Quanxi's girlfriends, alongside Pingtsi, Long, and Tsugihagi. Like the other fiends, she is loyal to Quanxi and can be seen following her around during the arc. She never says anything other than "Halloween." After Santa Claus kills Quanxi's other girlfriends besides Tsugihagi and threatens to make Quanxi one of her dolls, Quanxi tells Cosmo to give Santa Claus a taste of an all-out Halloween. Cosmo obliges, and brings Santa Claus into her mind telepathically.

Santa Claus observes that Cosmo intends to launch a psychological attack on her, but alledges that it would be ineffective. Cosmo then responds in normal speech to introduce herself as the Cosmos fiend, surprising Santa Claus. Cosmo explains that while she has no personal anger towards Santa Claus, the attack that will be launched on Santa Claus' mind is simply the natural order. She further tells Santa Claus that she is about to gain total knowledge of everything in the universe, and afterwards, she will be incapable of thinking about anything other than Halloween until she dies. This is exactly what happens, and Santa Claus and all of her dolls are left semi-catatonic, only saying and thinking of Halloween. Despite her help in defeating Santa Claus, Cosmo is still beheaded by Makima along with Quanxi and Tsugihagi.

The corpses of Cosmo and the other Fiends were eventually taken into custody by the Public Safety. As revealed by the scarred Public Safety agent during Asa Mitaka and Fami's assault on the Tokyo Devil Detention Center, Quanxi was supposedly recruited into Special Division 7 with the promise of regaining the corpses of her now deceased friends and lovers.

As a fiend, Cosmo can't make contracts. However, she still has all the other standard devil abilities. As the fiend that embodies the fear of the infinite knowledge of the cosmos and outer space, the more fear people have towards gaining total understanding of everything in the universe and similar concepts, the more powerful Cosmo will become.

Total Understanding: Cosmo can telepathically send a person’s mind into her own mind that seems to be a dimensional space that resembles a gigantic library, she would then force the target to understand everything in the universe. This renders them into a semi-catatonic state in which they are "only able to think of Halloween until they die." Once this occurs, the victim will be unable to think or say anything other than the phrase "Halloween" until their death. It is heavily implied that the target needs to copy Cosmo saying “Halloween” after she says it, and possibly for there to be some kind of direct focus, in order to work.
Omniscience: Cosmo has all the knowledge in the universe inside her head. This essentially gives her a possibility to be omniscient, however, due to the fact that Cosmo herself appears to be affected by her power likely because of her weakened state due to being a fiend, she is unable to utilize or access this knowledge in any meaningful way, being only able to think and say the word "Halloween". She doesn’t seem to be omniscient when she isn’t using her ability as in many circumstances she seems to not know or expect many things and in contrast to her neutral inner personality, who accepts the fate of hunting or be hunted to be natural, seemed more concerned with death and freaks out in dangerous situations. Cosmo may only be able to think completely normally when she is inside her own dimension talking to someone else that she sent there, but she does have a higher degree of functionality than her victims even outwardly, as she is not rendered semi-catatonic by her power.

entries.name: Crambon
entries.content:
Crambon was a cat who was saved and adopted by Asa Mitaka, during the attack of the Typhoon Devil. During the attack of the Typhoon Devil, Crambon hurt it's paw. Seeing this Asa tried saving it but tripped and fell. Because of this Asa's Mother had to stop and help her up which cost her her own life.

After the attack, having no family left Asa adopted the cat and named it Crambon. Together with Asa he was moved to an orphanage for children whose families have been killed by devils.

There, her caretaker, whose mother also died because of the Typhoon Devil, convinced her to give Crambon away to give him a happier home. However, another orphan later told Asa that the children found Crambon drowned in a river. It turned out that the caretaker had lied to Asa and killed Crambon because she was jealous that Asa still had someone she considered family.

entries.name: Curse Devil
entries.content: The Curse Devil is a devil that embodies the fear of curses. When summoned, the Curse Devil manifests as a large, two-headed skeleton with horns, its right skull appears human while the left skull has three eye slits and longer, mandible-like teeth. The Curse Devil has clawed hands and a large, distended ribcage. Whenever it speaks to someone the Curse Devil physically appears behind them.

entries.name: Darkness Devil
entries.content:
The Darkness Devil is a devil that embodies the primal fear of the dark. 

The Darkness Devil's body is made up of many emaciated human bodies, with two bodies acting as its legs and four other human bodies acting as its torso, each having a unique face: the one immediately below the neck has no eyes, nose and a vertical mouth, the second head has open eyes and a stitched mouth, the third one has no nose, an open mouth and stitched eyes, and the fourth one has no eyes and a somber expression. Its head is akin to that of a pterodactyl with curved horns. The first human body has its arms stretching outwards holding what seems to be a cape of darkness.

Nothing is currently known about the Darkness Devil's personality, except that it will attack anything it perceives as a threat. Even though it is almost entirely silent, it is shown to be intelligent and capable of reasoning, as a human can make a contract with it. Like other Devils, it displays high animosity towards Chainsaw Man because of the threat he poses.

The Darkness Devil is described as a transcendent being — one of the "Primal Fear" Devils that have never experienced death due to being so powerful; embodying a Primal Fear, it can be assumed that the Darkness Devil is almost as old as humanity itself. Indeed, the Darkness Devil's power is such that ordinary Devils and humans will supposedly die the very moment they draw its hostility.

Naturally, it possesses all of the standard Devil abilities such as blood consumption, contract creation, etc. The only contract with the Darkness Devil seen so far was made by Santa Claus: in exchange for delivering the heart of Denji to Hell, Santa Claus gained a small piece of the Darkness Devil's flesh that allowed the assassin to manipulate their body in darkness and amplified their total power vastly.

Immense Speed: The Darkness Devil can travel and attack at high speeds. It was able to appear in the midst of several Devil hunters, including Quanxi, without any of them being able to perceive its movements. By using its multiple arms it could slice through several fighters before they could react, and dodged or otherwise counteracted attacks with ease.
Immense Strength: The Darkness Devil has shown to be able to lift its targets with great ease and damage them easily by swinging its arms around.

Nigh-Absolute Immortality: Devils of Primal Fear status are considered unkillable due to their power, hence why they never undergo reincarnation. The Falling Devil affirmed that, at present, humanity has no means of attack that could kill a Primal Fear.

Immense Healing Factor: While in the dark, the Darkness Devil can rapidly regenerate from any injury, easily healing from a powerful attack from Makima.

Darkness Manipulation: As the embodiment of fear of darkness, the Darkness Devil has the ability to manipulate darkness. It can transform into a mass of darkness and envelop the surrounding area in darkness, manifesting the bodies of 10 bisected astronauts as it does so.

Blade of Darkness: The Darkness Devil can also conjure a large blade with bells attached to its hilt that can be telekinetically controlled to attack its enemies. Once it makes contact, any being will hemorrhage violently once the bells ring.

Force Manipulation: The Darkness Devil has been shown to offensively manipulate an unseen force in various ways similar to the Control Devil. With this ability, the Darkness Devil can sever the arms of various humans, fiends and devils, cut them into pieces just by pointing at them or through movements of its many arms, or brutally obliterating their body after uttering an unreadable word. It can also induce violent hemorrhages on those it watches. However, Makima is shown to be stronger in this ability, as she can heavily damage the Darkness Devil only by pointing her finger at it. It seems that the power of this ability can be increased by switching gestures, as the Darkness Devil completely twisted Makima's arm in the second attempt while praying with two of its hands despite the Control Devil trying to block the attack with all five fingers.

Regeneration Nullification: Those who are dismembered by the Darkness Devil appear to have their regeneration nullified. The extent of this ability is unclear, as Kobeni and Power were able to return to normal, only one of Aki's arms was reattached, and Angel's arms were permanently lost, with him stating that he is unable to regenerate them and can no longer be a Devil hunter.

Devil Manifestation: The Darkness Devil appears to be able to forcefully manifest other Devils and kill them instantly. In the case of the Stone Devil, this also resulted in the death of the human they contracted with, Kusakabe.
Weaknesses

Light: Because Denji was able to overpower and damage a Darkness-empowered Santa Claus by lighting himself on fire (thus producing light and weakening the powers given to her by the Devil), it can be inferred that the Darkness Devil's powers can be counteracted with light. However, as a Primal Devil, it would likely be insufficient to kill them.

entries.name: Death Devil
entries.content:
The Death Devil is the strongest Devil who embodies the world's ultimate fear: death. She is the eldest of the Four Horsemen, first mentioned by her younger sister Makima and eventually appearing under the alias of the Famine Devil, Fami.

As the Ultimate Terror and Great King of Terror, she is prophecied to descend to Earth in July 1999 and bring upon the apocalypse, which would end humanity and usher in an Age of Devils.

Posing as a student at Fourth East High School and the true leader of the Chainsaw Man Church, the Death Devil serves as the main antagonist of the Academy Saga, as majority of her actions are what drives the story's events as well as the conflict between mankind and Devils.

The Death Devil takes on the appearance of a young woman who wears a high school uniform and a black cap from the Devil Hunter Club. She has grayish mountbatten pink colored neck-length hair and has several moles on her face. Similar to the other Horsemen, she has piercing, multiple-ringed eyes. On a colored manga cover her eyes are shown to be pink. Her ears feature four green earrings, two of which are beads on her right and the other two are unusually long and have a triangular shape at the end.

The Death Devil has a very mysterious personality and shows little outward emotion. She is always calm, cold, and composed and also seems to be very good at reading others, as she accurately describes both Asa's and Denji's characters. Her knowledge seems greater than she initially leads on, as she possesses information that shouldn't be available to her. Death doesn't care if someone discovers her true identity and therefore puts little to no effort into her alias. What's more is that she doesn't necessarily seem to be as outwardly malicious as her brethren, even informing Public Safety officials such as Yoshida about more dangerous Devils, albeit after being threatened first. Despite being intelligent, she can underestimate others, believing that Asa, like most people, would be willing to do anything to survive if forced to, which gets proven wrong.

The Death Devil is more than willing to sacrifice people for her goals. For example, she traps Asa and her fellow club members in an aquarium, knowing that they will starve and suffer, and tries to turn Yoru into a pawn of hers so she can use her as a weapon against the apocalypse. To achieve the latter, she unleashes the Falling Devil on Earth, which not only causes high casualties and worldwide destruction but also ends up not working, making the deaths meaningless. Later, the Death Devil also condemns hundreds of thousands of civilians to lose their minds under the influence of the Fire Devil so that her plans come to fruition. She prefers lethal methods in combat, ordering the Guillotine Devil to hack her enemies to pieces and being disappointed when it only disarms them. However, she spares the likes of Haruka Iseumi after he denounces his loyalty to her, presumably because she doesn't find him worthy of her attention.

Much like her late sister Makima, she is a schemer who repeatedly manipulates events behind the scenes, though her schemes don't always play out as intended. Currently, she is the secret leader of the Chainsaw Man Church, which she claimed to use to eradicate the devils in Tokyo to enable Denji to live a peaceful life and separate him from Pochita, whom the Death Devil claimed she would hand over to Yoru to kill. Despite Haruka being the face of said organization, Death refused to reveal to him the full extent of her plans and told him he didn't need to think. She tells different things to different people, even lying in order to convince them to cooperate with her.

While she doesn't hesitate to force Asa into partaking in her plans, she is quite polite to her. The Death Devil also seems affectionate towards Yoru, saying that she would do anything for her "little sister". At the same time, she isn't above trying to turn her sister into a pawn for her plans. Despite Death's affection for Yoru, the War Devil does not reciprocate those feelings and describes her as insane and someone from whom Asa should stay away. The Death Devil wants Yoru to treat her like a sister and, therefore, only answers when Yoru addresses her in a more affectionate way. As shown, it's implied that Death has a similar relationship with the other Four Horsemen, as seen when the current Control Devil calls her sister. Death also calls the Guillotine Devil by an affectionate nickname.

According to Nayuta, who shares a close bond with Death due to their sisterhood, "Fami"'s actual plan is to stop the apocalypse by killing the Death Devil, which she aims to achieve by making Chainsaw Man and the War Devil more feared and, therefore, more powerful. This goes against the wishes of Asa (who has feelings for Chainsaw Man and wants him to become human again), Yoru (who wants to kill Chainsaw Man), and Yoshida (who wants Denji to never reveal his identity as Chainsaw Man), showing that the Death Devil is perfectly willing to betray those she cooperates with.

She is also a major glutton, frequently ordering inhuman levels of food to consume in a single setting and sometimes eating it without any utensils, seen when she messily eats a giant plate of spaghetti with her bare hands and no thought of the mess on her face from the marinara sauce. She wants to prevent the extinction of humanity and the resulting age of Devils, since that would also mean the end of her favorite foods, something she describes as "the worst scenario imaginable". Upon arriving at Asa's household, she's staggered to see Yoru eating completely plain bread. She then eats it herself, but with strawberry jam, showcasing her taste is more sophisticated than her sister's.

However, per Nostradamus' Prophecy, the Death Devil is to bring about the apocalypse, end humanity, and usher in the Age of Devils.

The Death Devil is the strongest Devil in existence, her name being most feared of all.

Death herself possesses all of the standard Devil abilities. While her powers and their extent are still unclear, she seems to be able to influence the power of Devils in some way. Rather than being directly involved in conflicts, she prefers to utilize the powers of other Devils who are either cooperating with her voluntarily or under her direct control. She was able to separate Yoru from Asa temporarily but left Asa her power to turn people and objects into weapons and communicated with her at a distance despite Asa being trapped in another Devil's pocket dimension.

While lesser "Primal Fears" are already transcendent beings that cannot be killed and whose mere presence can be felt across the world, the Death Devil's arrival is held as tantamount to the apocalypse. Indeed, the Prophecy of Nostradamus calls her "Ultimate Terror" and "Great King of Terror" — who is to usher in an Age of Devils and thus end the human race. According to Yoru, once Death descends, the other high-ranking Devils, such as the Fire Devil, will pay court to her.

However, her sisters seem to believe that killing Death is within the realms of possibility: Makima desired to kill all her sisters by having Chainsaw Man eat them, and "Fami" plots to empower the War and Chainsaw Devils by rapidly reigniting humanity's collective fear of them (by means of inciting a global war) so that both can grow strong enough to rival Death. Yoshida has reiterated this notion, stating that, while no country in the world has the means to prevent Death's descent, if War were to control Chainsaw Man as a mindless weapon, humanity may have a chance of surviving and perhaps even overcoming Death.

entries.name: Debt Collector
entries.content: Debt Collector (real name unknown) was a yakuza leader, who took young Denji after his father's death and forced him into paying off his debt. He was also the beloved grandfather of Katana Man. He is an elderly man with a scruffy grey beard and mustache. He wears a hat, suit and glasses. He is very cruel and uncaring and does not care about hurting, abusing or killing even children. He seems to be only kind to close associates such as family members.

entries.name: Denji
entries.content:
Denji is a Chainsaw Devil Hybrid. As a young boy, he inherits his father's debts from the Yakuza. After meeting Pochita, he becomes a Devil Hunter for the Yakuza in an attempt to clear his debt. Once the Yakuza, under the control of a Devil, betrays him, he dies and Pochita becomes his heart. He is then revived and can become the Chainsaw Man by pulling a cord on his chest. After meeting Makima, he became a Public Safety Devil Hunter as a member of Tokyo Special Division 4.

Following Makima's death by his own hands, he resigned from his position as a Devil Hunter but continues to fight as Chainsaw Man under the public eye, all the while being enrolled in Fourth East High School as a student. He is also the caretaker and adoptive brother of Makima's reincarnation, Nayuta.

Human Form: Denji is a teenage boy with scruffy blond hair. He has yellow-brown eyes and bags underneath, resulting in a dazed and tired expression. His teeth are noticeably sharp and angular. Due to malnutrition in his childhood, he has a scrawny build with protruding ribs, and due to the stress of what he did for a living, he’s often mistaken for being older than he actually is.

Post Fusion Form: After Denji forms a contract with Pochita, his heart is fused with Pochita, a chainsaw cord forms in the middle of his sternum and he regains his lost organs along with having a muscular build.

He spent much of his time wearing the standard Public Safety Devil Hunter uniform, consisting of a white shirt, tie, and slacks. He wore the uniform carelessly, his shirt wrinkled and sleeves rolled up.

After resigning from a Public Safety Devil Hunter, Denji now wears Fourth East High School's uniform, an unbuttoned black buttoned long-sleeved shirt (similar to a gakuran outfit's) and black pants.

Hybrid Form: If his chainsaw cord is pulled while he has enough blood for the transformation, then his head will morph into a demonic, mechanical shape with long, jagged fangs and a chainsaw handle on the back. Large chainsaws will emerge from his forehead, arms and legs, he is able to retract and extend any of them at will. If Denji's chainsaw cord is pulled while he does not have enough blood, then a chainsaw blade will partially emerge from his face.

Devil Form: After losing his will to live and surrendering himself to Makima, Pochita takes control of Denji's body and reveals the true Chainsaw Devil, completely losing his human consciousness and letting Pochita take over. Prior to the transformation, his intestines emerge from his stomach and wrap around his neck, resembling a scarf or a collar. Once transformed, his body is black, looking to be covered with either armored plates or scales. He gains spikes on his shoulders and the back of his head, his eye-slits are gone, and the handles are replaced with horns. He becomes much larger and bulkier, towering over the average human. His arms split at the elbows, each with two forearms equipped with their own Chainsaw Blades.

Denji is both brash and naïve as a result of being unable to have a formal education and socialize due to living in severe poverty. His personality comes off as rude and harsh in an almost childish way. However, he has a good sense of empathy towards other people, willing to save those in danger as much as he could, showing he is a kind-hearted person despite his shortcomings. While Denji doesn't necessarily possess the highest intelligence, he is capable of clever ideas to take down Devils, such as lighting himself on fire and using the light emitted to weaken Santa Claus enough to kill her.

After becoming a Public Safety Devil Hunter and fulfilling his basic needs, Denji is unsure of what he wants in life. Many of Denji's said basic needs were fueled by sexual desire, going so far as to accept dangerous missions in exchange for some form of sexual gratification. One such case was feeling up Power in exchange for rescuing her cat, however, he later realized and laments that the satisfaction from such intimate acts is fleeting. Denji also harbors a fear that his seeming lack of empathy and attachment after his transformation is a sign that he is losing his sense of humanity.

While transformed into his Hybrid form, Denji becomes extremely ruthless, aggressive, bloodthirsty and sadistic, releasing his most deranged side while facing other Devils, to the point of enjoying killing them. He also displays a twisted and sarcastic sense of humor. The first time he transformed into his Hybrid form he found it amusing that he could pay off his debt by killing all the Yakuza members who were turned into zombies due to the power of the Zombie Devil. While facing the Eternity Devil he says that "its blood tastes like rat but drinking it while watching a son of a bitch suffering and feeling terrified makes it taste as delicious as a strawberry jam", and considers himself a genius for creating a "perpetual motion machine" worthy enough of a Nobel Prize. Later, when the Spear Hybrid has Denji pinned down, he bisects both himself and the hybrid behind him before crawling over to him, cutting his head off, and thanking him for the food while holding said head.

As time progresses, it becomes more evident that Denji is emotionally damaged, and desperate to feel love and be loved by someone. He clings to Makima as a coping mechanism, even going as far as stating that his wish was to just be a mindless dog, so he would not feel hurt from losing the things and people he loved. This backfired, as watching Power die was enough for him to surrender himself to Makima completely, essentially erasing his personality and mental state. This is still evident when Denji tells Kishibe that he did not set out to kill Makima, but rather become one with her, allowing him to defeat her.

Near the end of the first part, as well as at the start of the second part, Denji starts growing more ambitious and lavish in his desires; whilst before he was happy with simply being able to eat jam on toast and feeling a girl's chest, now he desires to have steak for breakfast every day and to have numerous, lustful girlfriends. It's also shown he has grown more arrogant in his Devil-slaying, as he is willing to expose his identity if it means he'd get more attention from girls, despite how disastrous the consequences would be.

As such, at the beginning of the second part, Denji's personality seems to have remained relatively stagnant, aimed at openly leaving clues that indicate that he is Chainsaw Man, such as leaving his school I.D. at the scene of his fight with the Cockroach Devil, or directly telling Asa Mitaka that he is Chainsaw Man (to which she thinks he is bluffing). He also reveals himself to be obsessed with money, so much so that he is willing to let others pay to use him as a "chair" for a few yen (although he seems to enjoy it when a woman uses him as a chair) and to sell used cigarettes to the homeless, passing them off as new, just to make money.

However, Denji later demonstrates the true motivation behind most of these behaviors, which is to fund his adopted sister's education, thus showing that he has matured following the disastrous consequences of letting Makima groom, abuse, and control him in their relationship, becoming more independent and standing up for himself without allowing others to dictate his behavior. During the date with Asa, Denji becomes flustered and angry with her when she told him that he didn't need to think about anything, possibly reminding him of his relationship with Makima. He further reveals to Asa that the reason he is desperately saving money is to provide Nayuta with a proper education and a comfortable lifestyle, showing that he has acquired a strong sense of responsibility towards others.

The trauma from Part 1 has clearly taken a toll on him. He displays practically none of the enthusiasm and upbeat demeanor he did before, and is constantly seen with a haggard expression and baggy eyes. He openly admits to Asa that he still hasn't gotten over his horrendous past. It is later revealed that he has nightmares where he tells himself he could never have a family because he killed his father, showing that Makima's words still linger in his mind. He's also picked up a habit of biting his finger when thinking of sex, which is likely a remnant of Makima telling him to "remember her bite." In spite of this, Denji still believes that life consists of more than just pain and that his reason to live makes him willing to endure the bad aspects of life. When asked what that reason is, he replies with sex, his main source of motivation.

Due to his desire to have intercourse with a woman, he generally treats women with more kindness and respect than men. He does his best to treat women with respect and never does anything without their explicit consent. When he and Asa were escaping from the large clawed tendrils, he refused Asa's instructions to steal a woman's motorcycle, calling her a thief. However, when she asks him to steal a man's motorcycle, he doesn't hesitate to kick the man off his motorcycle, telling him to beat it. Denji told Aki that when he fights against men, he usually aims to their intimate zone (their testicles) and demonstrated it when they had a fight when he kicked him repeatedly in the groin.

In spite of his desire to have sex, this does not allow Denji to override his better judgement. Though he was initially eager to become part of the Chainsaw Man Church to have sex with a girl, he's immediately put off when he realizes how insane the cult really is. He is able to clearly see that the anti-American conspiracy theory that they propagate is a lie. Furthermore, once he learns that he'd be forced to marry the girl with whom he'd have sex with, he draws a line and refuses to marry a random girl. Whereas Sugo agrees with the practices of the Chainsaw Man church, Denji clearly sees the unethical behavior of the church and refuses to abide by it. When Barem arrives and suggests killing Asa Mitaka so he can be Chainsaw Man again, this is enough for Denji to leave in disgust, declaring the Chainsaw Man Church to be a crazy place.

Also, Denji has started to struggle with having a normal life since he has come to like transforming and being Chainsaw Man due to the attention and popularity he receives. When Hirofumi Yoshida forced him to make a choice of having a normal life with Nayuta or being Chainsaw Man but it would mean getting Nayuta killed, Denji chose to have both of them, and while he ultimately obeys and starts a normal life without transforming, he slowly begins to feel bored and wonders if he'll be able to maintain that life with the same routine every day for the rest of his life. As he becomes increasingly jaded to living a normal life with constrictions on his personal freedom, his home burns down and his pets murdered due to the machinations of Barem, which finally pushes him over the edge. He subsequently ignores Nayuta's pleas to run away with her and feels glad to be Chainsaw Man again despite the horrific circumstances that led to it happening. He also expresses immense disgust at himself when he tries coping with the emotional turmoil that he feels over Nayuta's disappearance and the loss of his pets by trying to seek sexual gratification at a brothel, fully realizing that he constantly allows his base desires to supercede his priorities.

entries.name: Denji's Father
entries.content: This unnamed man was the father of Denji. When Denji was young he killed his father in self defense, as his father was in a drunken aggressive state and he feared for his life. His father's murder was ruled a suicide by the adults in Denji’s life as acknowledging his death as a murder would mean they would be unable to get any money from his death. After his death, Denji inherits his debt to the Yakuza.

entries.name: Division 4 Female Member
entries.content: She appears to be a woman in her early to mid 20's with brown and black short hair. She has narrow brown eyes. She also has silver piercings in both of her earlobes. She is shown to have a mature and caring personality during the "newbie welcome party". She is also shown to comfort Kobeni by calling her "Beni" during the party.

entries.name: Doll Devil
entries.content: The Doll Devil is a devil that embodies the fear of dolls. The Doll Devil's real appearance is currently unknown. The only time it was ever physically seen was when it took over Tolka's body. Little is known about the Doll Devil. However, they appear to be on good terms with Santa Claus, since it was willing to help her in her plan to make a deal with the Darkness Devil.

entries.name: Dominion
entries.content: Dominion is either a Devil or a Fiend who was under Makima's control. They were shown alongside Seraphim, Virtue, and Princi, as well as the corpses of Power, Galgali, Angel, and Beam. Dominion is some sort of mammalian-looking creature with 4 pointed ears, and 4 eyes with horizontal pupils. According to the digitally coloured manga, they have yellowish-cream skin.

entries.name: Eternity Devil
entries.content:
The Eternity Devil is a devil that embodies the fear of eternity. The Eternity Devil's core is a lump of flesh in the shape of the number 8 which can also be seen as the infinity symbol with an eye and mouth on either side and two mouths in the center.

Within its own stomach the Eternity Devil can manifest as an endless wave of flesh consisting of many arms and heads fused together. It initially appears very small and weak but rapidly grows over time. After its death, the Eternity Devil returned to Earth with a different appearance. When its effect is forcefully ended by Asa turning the aquarium into a spear, the Eternity Devil appears as a vaguely humanoid mass of partially melted fingers with a hood-like head with no facial features and instead of legs it has a slug-like foot. It appears to be far removed from the encompassing Devil it was before. The differences likely stem from the previous incarnation being abnormally powered-up through eating Gun Devil flesh.

entries.name: Fake Chainsaw Man
entries.content: An individual referred to as Fake Chainsaw Man is a mysterious figure, his real name remains unknown. He is an exceptionally tall male and has a rather bulky physique. He wears an all-black uniform and dark pants which appears to be the common outfit of male Devil Hunter Club members. He also wears a black cap which obscures his face, however his hair is still visible and was show to be black. Not much is known about his personality except that he speaks in a formal, polite, and calm manner. His actions so far hint at him wanting to help the real Chainsaw Man however he can. He also seems very knowledgeable about the Devils in Hell. He might be religous because he mentions Adam and Eve in his TV speech.

entries.name: Falling Devil
entries.content:
The Falling Devil is a Devil that embodies the primal fear of falling which includes both the act of physically falling down and mentally "falling" into depression.  

She is a subordinate to Fami. Upon arriving on Earth, she assembled herself a form out of mangled human corpses. 

Upon appearing on Earth, she takes the form of a large, big-breasted, feminine, and headless humanoid made of corpses with hands for feet and a pointed tendril covering her groin. This also seems to be her true form, as demonstrated by the miniature version of herself she turns into when not active. In addition to two multi-jointed arms, she has a pair of scythe-like limbs that resemble featherless wings and two more pairs of arms sprouting from her back. One pair holds a decapitated head with a black ponytail; blood drips out of the ever-closed eyes, nostrils and mouth.

Her most notable trait is her chef uniform, which consists of a tall toque, black leggings, long, black gloves, a white chef jacket, and a black waist apron. The Falling Devil appears to view herself as being subservient to the wishes of other Devils, often announcing that her goals and desires are that of Hell as a whole. Despite this, she doesn't seem above the idea of serving death to fellow Devils should they not respect her own established conditions.

The Falling Devil appears to view herself as being subservient to the wishes of other Devils, often announcing that her goals and desires are that of Hell as a whole. Despite this, she doesn't seem above the idea of serving death to fellow Devils should they not respect her own established conditions.

Much like her appearance, Falling Devil speaks similarly to a chef as well, describing her different attacks as “courses” that will “delight your tastebuds”, whilst insisting people finish their "trauma-laden" meal. Falling Devil also appears to have a form of humility to her, such as when she covered herself up after noticing her own nudity. Despite being a devil, she will only attack humans if they're necessary "ingredients" (and opts to leave them injured instead of dead whenever possible) for her dishes or in self-defense. She claims to dislike meaningless slaughter and was reluctant to fight Denji, preferring to work on her dish instead. She takes great pride in the "meals" she prepares, so much that, if they aren't eaten or are ill-received, she loses her composure and kills those who don't enjoy her food.

The Falling Devil is generally polite. Perhaps due to her nigh-immortality, she expresses only mild irritation or impatience at attackers, seeing them as mere inconveniences. Even after being attacked by the Chainsaw Man himself, she doesn't take him seriously and instead cracks a joke. She appears to be mentally mature and well-mannered for a devil, as she responds with disgust to Denji's sexual comments towards Asa.

The Falling Devil is also very cruel, preferring to break her victims emotionally and mentally until they decide to commit suicide, rather than killing them herself straight away.

As shown, due to coming under Fami’s control, the Falling Devil is very loyal towards her. As shown where she apologised to her for failing to successfully put Asa/War into a starved state as her master desired and later, willingly allowed herself to turn into a figurine for Fami to pick up. It's possible her chef motif also stems from her master's culinary tendencies.

Being a Primal Fear, the Falling Devil is described as a transcendent being; one of the Devils embodying a Primal Fear and has never experienced death due to being so powerful. As a devil that embodies a Primal Fear, it can be assumed that the Falling Devil is almost as old as humanity itself. However despite her power she somehow managed to fall under the Famine Devil control. As Fami later explains, the Devils she summons are unable to fight at full strength, meaning that the Falling Devil was even more powerful before falling under her control. As a Devil, the Falling Devil possesses all of the standard Devil abilities.

Nigh-Absolute Immortality: Devils of Primal Fear status are considered unkillable due to their power, hence why they never undergo reincarnation. The Falling Devil affirmed that, at present, humanity has no means of attack that could kill a Primal Fear.

Immense Healing Factor: True to her claim of being unkillable, the Falling Devil can heal from any damage done to her no matter how severe. The regeneration seems automatic with no stamina cost (requiring no blood) and is so quick as to be barely visible. In one instance she was shown being reduced to a gory pile of flesh by sustained gunfire, yet in the next moment appeared fully healed, standing upright with her clothes intact. Even when shredded to pieces and eaten by Denji in his Chainsaw Man form, it took her one second to reconstitute herself, doing so from within Denji's body with such force that the boy was ripped apart.

Hell Connection: The Falling Devil can freely manifest multiple doors that connect directly to Hell. This allows her to send certain individuals to Hell as well as travel freely between the two realms herself.

Gravity Manipulation: The Falling Devil can selectively manipulate gravity on herself, the environment or individual people. This power is so significant that her presence could be detected around the world as a result of gravitational anomalies causing earthquakes and landslides. The strength and direction of the manipulated gravity can be changed by simply pointing her finger in that direction. This ability includes: 

Traumatic Anti-Gravity: The Falling Devil possesses an ability that allows her to invert gravity on people, causing them to fall up into the sky. The force of reversed gravity is related to a person’s past and trauma, with those who have suffered little to no trauma being barely affected. Upon reaching a certain height, the person falls into a door to Hell.

Levitation: The Falling Devil can use the gravity manipulation ability on herself to freely move in any direction and at high speeds. She can also suspend herself in the air and keep herself stationary.

Area Denial: The Falling Devil can fully reverse gravity in its immediate vicinity, completely destroying the area. She later used this ability again to force Asa out of her hiding spot.

Targeted Control: The Falling Devil can also focus her power on a singular object and manipulate its gravity to her will. She used this ability to lift up and entire apartment building high into the air and then launch it towards the fleeing Denji and Asa.

Energy Beam: With a pointing gesture the Falling Devil can summon a powerful beam of energy. She used this ability to instantly kill the Justice Devil.

Thought Manipulation: Falling Devil can force its victims to relive traumatic memories in their minds. This ability complements her gravity manipulation which is tied to a victim's past trauma. However, this power can be resisted if the victim's brain is damaged, as Denji stopped falling after slicing his brain up.

Emotion Manipulation: As shown when Asa began becoming affected by its power, the Falling Devil possess the power to draw out and magnify the negative feelings of her victims, causing them to become more inclined to her manipulating their thoughts such as making people commit suicide.

Body Control: Aside from controlling her own vessel made out of human corpses, she appears to be able to force humans to move against their will, as seen by her forcing a Devil Hunter to sit in an unnaturally contorted position.
Object Creation: The Falling Devil is able to summon/create various objects at will such as her chef's uniform and various restaurant-related utilities.

Immense Strength: Kicks from the Falling Devil can send Denji flying into buildings with enough force to demolish them. Her scythelike limbs are sharp enough to cleanly decapitate humans. Notably, she stopped a dashing Chainsaw Man with a single finger.

Immense Speed: The Falling Devil is able to move around very quickly, beheading someone in mid-air and was also precise enough to pluck multiple eyes and ears from passersby without further injuring them.
Weaknesses

Low Durability: The Falling Devil's body is quite fragile and can be easily destroyed by gunfire and Denji's chainsaws. This isn't enough to kill her due to her immortality and immense healing factor, however it leaves her temporarily incapacitated. This gives her enemies a small window of time to escape or recuperate while she waits to regenerate.

Dishes served by the Falling Devil so far are:
Hors d'oeuvre, La Root Vonla: The "appetizer". It consists of random people who were sent to hell with her gravity inversion ability.

De Root Atelanta: The "soup course". It's a potage made from the ears, nose, and tongue of several Devil Hunters alongside an alive Devil Hunter. She delivers him and the soup to hell where he's devoured by the Justice Devil.

Failed dishes:

Asa Root Yoru: The "main course, a Human and War Devil mix". Its primary ingredients include Asa and Yoru served with sauce. As for the sauce it consists of apples, a man's head, ten eyes, and four ears. However after being served, Asa was promptly rescued by Denji before any Devil could eat her.

entries.name: Fami
entries.content:
Fami is the Famine Devil which embodies the fear of famine and starvation and is a member of the Four Horsemen.

She is initially thought to have been the Death Devil when confronted by the Fake Chainsaw Man, but it is revealed that the real Death Devil had been using her name all along as an alias to keep her identity a secret.

Fami's current form resembles that of a humanoid woman with long unkempt hair that falls in uneven layers and strands. Some of her strands stick out, with bangs across her forehead and sides that reach her ears, and a pair of longer bangs that loosely reach her collarbones. Like the rest of her sisters, the Famine Devil possesses multiple-ringed eyes and wears the standard Fourth East High School uniform, similar to Fami. In most of her appearances, she wears a nervous expression on her face and is usually shown crying.

From what has been seen so far, Fami appears to have a meek and taciturn demeanor and is very outwardly emotional, in stark contrast with her sisters. She was nervous when introducing herself to students of Fourth East High School, crying throughout her entire introduction and openly bawling when she sees that nobody was paying attention to her. At the same time, she appears to have somewhat of a high opinion of herself, refusing to take out the trash because it would be a waste of her superior talents. Despite this, when she's chastised by a student for her behavior and told to go "crush ants", she actually goes outside to do so. When she's easily dispatched by the Fake Chainsaw Man, she immediately resorts to begging for her life by offering him a meager 2,000¥ from her wallet, demonstrating an overt cowardice that her sisters lack.

Fami appears to pity humanity and arrives claiming to save them with her special powers. Her notion of salvation seems to be releasing humans from their suffering through death. Although she does not display the same bravado as devils like Makima and Yoru and can be argued to be benevolent, Fami is still deeply fatalistic, as seen in her method to "save" humanity: In order to mend her injuries, she spares no thought to an innocent student who wanted to help her and immediately steals his life force. Despite this, her pleading for Death to kill herself does display that she, in her own warped sense, ultimately sides with humanity over Devils.

Fami appears to have a high degree of confidence in her combat skills, and contrary to her usual personality is relatively calm and collected in an encounter against a formidable foe. She utilizes basic hand-to-hand combat in attempts to battle with the physically imposing Fake Chainsaw Man, analyzes his fighting style, and boldly claims to be capable of defeating him in mere seconds despite being rapidly dismembered by him a moment prior. It can be inferred from her genuine shock at being bested that she may have been a much more powerful fighter at a previous point but has been dramatically weakened to the state she's in at the time of her appearance.

Fami possesses some level of martial arts prowess and knowledge, though the extent of which is questionable. Although her attacks dealt little damage to the Fake Chainsaw Man, she was nonetheless shown to be somewhat athletic in combat. Accurate or not, she also analyzes multiple supposed weaknesses in Fake Chainsaw Man's attacks and fighting style with just a sparse few demonstrations of his abilities. However, she was easily bested by him all the same in their brief clashes despite insisting it would only take three seconds to eliminate him.

The Famine Devil can be assumed to hold all standard Devil abilities, such as regeneration, forming Contracts, etc.

Starvation Inducement: The Famine Devil naturally has the ability to induce death through the starving of those she comes into physical contact with, although the full extent of this ability is currently unknown. The Famine Devil first utilized this power by killing one of the Festival Committee students to revive herself when facing off against the Fake Chainsaw Man.
Life Absorption: She is also capable of using the energy stolen from her victims to heal herself from even fatal injuries.
Durability: Unlike many other Devils, the Famine Devil is able to live past mortal injuries, such as getting her body cut to pieces, and can still talk while her head is detached from her body.

entries.name: Fish Devil
entries.content: The Fish Devil is a devil who embodies the fear of fish. Fish Devil has the appearance of a giant fish, with twin tails at its back end. Its only other distinguishing feature is its set of 6 seemingly bio-mechanical legs.

entries.name: Fox Devil
entries.content:
The Fox Devil is a devil that embodies the fear of foxes. The Fox Devil's full appearance is unknown but its head resembles a giant fox's head with multiple giant eyes covering it, each full of concentric circles. The Fox Devil's arm is likewise monstrously large with oversized claws and is covered in multiple eyes. The Fox Devil has no conflicted feelings over killing and eating other devils; eagerly asking permission from Aki Hayakawa to swallow the Leech Devil's head.

The Fox Devil is friendly with humans, allowing numerous Devil Hunters to make contracts with it. However it only grants attractive people the ability to summon its head, showing a rather superficial side.

entries.name: Fumiko Mifune
entries.content:
Fumiko Mifune is a Public Safety Devil Hunter from Tokyo Special Division 7 who works with Hirofumi Yoshida. She formerly served as Denji's so-called "bodyguard", in which she attended Fourth East High School to "protect" Denji from threats who may know his identity as Chainsaw Man.

Fumiko Mifune is a jolly young woman with short black hair. Her hair has a rather unkempt appearance though her bangs are tied into two ponytails at each side of her face. Fumiko's eyes are unusually large with giant black irises, containing a white circle within them. Her unusual eyes could be explained by a Devil contract, as was the case with Akane Sawatari. Her demeanor is also quite unique, as she is usually seen wearing a wide, uncanny smile on her face.

Despite her age, she dresses like a highschooler and usually wears the same school uniform that Asa Mitaka, and other girls from Fourth East High School have. Her appearance is considered "cute" by other characters. Outside of school, Fumiko wears black pants and a cropped shirt that shows off her midriff. When on duty, she wears her Public Safety uniform.

Fumiko is generally a very upbeat woman who constantly has a smile on her face. She is also quite perverted as she gropes Denji's crotch without his consent and then offers to have sex with him despite them never having met before, and their age difference. Her attraction to Chainsaw Man does seem somewhat obsessive, saying that she fell in love with her "senpai" because he was the one and only Chainsaw Man. Fumiko generally seems to be a happy-go-lucky, fun-loving person who passionately sings karaoke in the middle of getting swarmed by an aggressive mob, stating that she didn't want her songs to get interrupted.

Overall, Fumiko's behaviour can be seen as quite inconsiderate, predatory, and unprofessional, groping a teenager without consent while knowing his age, wanting to do unsanitary activities like sexual intercourse in a semi-public location, encouraging Denji to do disturbing acts for her own entertainment, watching him in his bathroom without his knowledge, and making all kinds of sexual and romantic advances towards him. Hirofumi Yoshida is seen reprehending her for not taking her job seriously and reminding her of keeping focused on her mission. On top of this, she puts on an almost fetishistic persona of a high-schooler, She seems to care little about her job, singing karaoke instead of protecting Denji from attackers, revealing secret information to him without thinking and allowing Denji to be recruited into the Chainsaw Church when he is not supposed to turn into Chainsaw Man anymore.

She also loves fighting, as she grabs a baseball bat to join Denji fighting the mob instead of singing the song's second verse, saying that it seems "more fun." Furthermore, it appears that one of the main reasons as to why she fell in love with Chainsaw Man was due to his physical prowess. However, Fumiko also resents Chainsaw Man to some extent, as he didn't save her parents while fighting the Gun Fiend. Despite that, she witnessed Denji crying and saw him for what he really was, a teenager. From that point on, she made up her mind and wanted to save him, claiming to be interested in Denji as a person and not the devil within him.

Fumiko's devotion to saving Denji is rather limited as she puts her position as a public servant above him and isn't willing to go beyond the scope of her job, happily telling Nayuta she isn't going to risk her life to save Chainsaw Man. When Nayuta tries to appeal to her conscience by reminding her that their family died in a house fire, Fumiko replies that those were "only pets", not their family, showing her lack of sympathy and a cruel sense of humor. When Denji gets detained and Public Safety plans to dismember him, Fumiko gleefully asks Yoshida if she can pluck out some of Denji's hair and nails before his body becomes official state property. Yoshida remarks that he thought she was a fan, to which Fumiko replies that she is and that she wants to add his body parts to her fan collection.

After ditching Denji and Nayuta, Fumiko is revealed to be a psychopath, as she is fully prepared to initiate Public Safety's plan to sacrifice the lives of 10,000 children. She is also willing to do whatever it takes to ensure humanity's evolution, even if it meant sacrificing her body to allow the Aging Devil to get consumed by the Chainsaw Devil.

At first glance, Fumiko appears to be skilled enough to handle the risks of a Public Safety Devil Hunter. However, it is shown that Fumiko is rather inexperienced and new to the job, as she constantly fails to protect Denji and Nayuta from harm. In fact, she never bothers to put herself in danger to save Denji, despite her so-called claims of wanting to protect him.

Fumiko's inexperience prevents her from being of any help when a dire situation arises, often leading to her being bailed out by those with more experience. A notable example of this is when facing off against Barem's horde of pseudo-Chainsaw people, Quanxi, a veteran Devil Hunter, had to bail her out as she wasn't able to do anything in that situation. Even when being armed against Barem and the Weapon Humans, she was unable to fight back and ended up being taken as a hostage.


Enhanced Reflexes: Fumiko was capable of narrowly avoiding Nayuta's chain aimed at her head.

Aging Devil Contract: Fumiko formed a contract with the Aging Devil in exchange for being spared from the Chainsaw Devil's attacks. As part of the contract, the Aging Devil can use Fumiko as a weapon by sacrificing any organ from her body. By doing so, it can cleave through opponents each time it sacrifices an organ, which in turn causes Fumiko immense pain as a result.

Blunt Weapon Proficiency: Armed with a baseball bat she was able to swiftly knock out and disarm a man brandishing a pistol, although the gun was later revealed to be non-functional.

Firearm Proficiency: She was capable of wielding a handgun and used it to prevent Barem from transforming into his hybrid state.

entries.name: Furio
entries.content: Furio is a highschooler attending Fourth East High School who is a member of the Devil Hunter Club. Furio is a lanky teenager with black hair and freckles scattered across his face. He fights with a crossbow. He was disgusted when seeing Yuko's devil form, calling it "freaky". He was quick to rush to the scene to help Seigi Akoku and the other Devil Hunter Club members, indicating he is loyal and reliable.

entries.name: Furuno
entries.content: Furuno is a devil hunter from Tokyo 2nd Division. Furuno is tall man usually wearing the standard Public Safety uniform suit.

entries.name: Fushi
entries.content:
Fushi was a Public Safety Devil Hunter in Tokyo Special Division 4. Fushi is a man of average appearance with short light-colored hair and grey eyes. Fushi appears to be considerate as he didn't bring his fiend partner to a public party because they're too scary.

He is hinted to be proud of his high IQ score of 134 as he remembers the exact number.

Fushi was among the devil hunters targeted during the Gun Devil's plot to assassinate to the Special Divisions of Public Safety. Several gunmen pulled out their weapons and shot him in broad daylight, killing him and his partner.

entries.name: Future Devil
entries.content:
The Future Devil is a devil that embodies the fear of the future. After seeing Aki Hayakawa's future, it made a contract with him, so he can see that future himself. 
The Future Devil's lower half resembles a tree growing from the floor with branches and a trunk extending up to a humanoid body with outstretched arms and a horned head. Multiple vine-like streamers grow from its arms and chest.

Its face has three pairs of eyes stacked on top of each other vertically and its wide mouth is almost perpetually open.

The Future Devil has a large hole in the center of its chest, inside of which is another oversized eye.

It has a extremely playful personality, regularly boasting that the future is best. The Future Devil's contracts are typically very costly, but after witnessing Aki's future, it gives him a contract on the condition that it be allowed to reside inside his eye to witness his horrible future up close, mocking him.

entries.name: Gun Devil
entries.content:
The Gun Devil is a very powerful devil who embodies the fear of guns/firearms. 

Not much is known about the Gun Devil's personality as a whole. In its Devil form, it has not once displayed any form of communication in the entire storyline either due to the inability to do so or simply due to not having any interest in doing so, rendering it difficult to pinpoint any personality trait. However, given the cataclysmic damage and the countless lives it has taken in mere minutes, the Gun Devil can be described as being a vile and wicked entity with no regards to anything besides itself.

Makima has stated it to be a merciless and evil being whose defeat would be worthy of having any wish granted to the person who could accomplish such a feat.[1] Even when under Contract from the President of the United States, the Gun Devil has taken in it's own hands to brutally execute hundreds of innocent lives, including children, before even attempting to complete its given mission to kill Makima, furthermore showcasing it's malevolent nature.

Full Devil Form (November 18th Attack-100%): While never shown yet, it has been stated that when the full form (100%) of the Gun Devil first appeared in the attacks of November 18th, it was depicted as having a full set of legs, feet, bones and flesh as well. Not much else is known about its full figure, however.

Fragmented Devil Form (American percentage-20%): When 20% of its body is summoned by the President of the United States, the Gun Devil resembles an enormous floating humanoid figure with multiple building-sized rifles for arms, a roughly skeletal body crammed full of disembodied screaming heads, and an oversized barrel and slide emerging from its skeletal face. The Gun Devil is also missing the lower half of its body and is instead replaced by 6 long giant 7.62×51mm NATO ammo belts attached to the bottom of its torso.

The main parts of both its arms appear to be M4 Carbines, with other well-known assault rifles in its arms well. These include: the AK-47 , the M16A1, and the Mk18 assault rifle. Both arms appear to wield the same rifles. The Gun Devil's head appears to be the slide and barrel of a large M1911 missing the hammer. Some of the firearms on its back appear to be unknown Infantry Rifles, all others are completely unidentifiable.

Fiend Form (Aki Hayakawa): After the Gun Devil took over Aki Hayakawa's body and becomes the Gun Fiend, its hair is let down with its eyes and forehead covered in dark veins. The barrel and slide of an M1911 is seen protruding out of its face in between its eyes with the gun's hammer sticking out the back of its head, its left forearm is replaced with an M4.

Weapon Form (Soviet Union percentage-28%): When the Gun Devil (the 28% owned by the Soviet Union) is transformed by Yoru into one of her weapons, it takes the form of a completely black right arm, which replaces the one the girl previously lost. This arm is covered by a stretchy dark lace glove.

entries.name: Grape Devil
entries.content: The Grape Devil is a devil who might be the embodiment of the fear of grapes. The Grape Devil's appearance is like a cluster of eyeballs connected with each other by veins, little arms and intestine-like appendages.

entries.name: Ghost Devil
entries.content: The Ghost Devil is a devil that embodies the fear of ghosts. The Ghost Devil is a large devil with a somewhat cylindrical body; its torso is covered in white flowers with either yellow or pink centers and has several arms instead of legs. In the colored manga it seems to have skin (arms and legs) of a grey hue but change in tint depending on the scene. It's head appears old and desiccated, with long dark wavy or curly hair and sunken cheeks. The Ghost Devil's eyes and mouth are sewn shut. In the anime, the flowers are pink on the outside and blue on the inside.

entries.name: Galgali
entries.content:
Galgali  was the Violence Fiend and a Public Safety Devil Hunter from Tokyo Special Division 4. Galgali possesses the corpse of a fairly thin man and is dressed in a suit with a hood, and wears a plague doctor gas mask which covers his features. In the colored manga, Galgali's mask is colored in a very bright green, red and orange that looks like the colors of a parrot. In the anime, the mask has more muted colors, such as grey and beige, and some yellow.

When he doesn't have his plague doctor mask on, he becomes much taller, very muscular, has spiky black hair, and has 4 empty eyes.

Despite his moniker as the Violence Fiend, he is extremely polite and straightforward. He apologized to Beam after hitting him in self-defense and told the Spider Devil to evacuate the area when he mistook her for a human lady.

Enhanced Strength: The Violence Fiend has extraordinary power for a fiend despite fiends ordinarily being weaker than devils. In order to keep his strength in check he is forced to wear a poison-dispensing mask.[2] When fighting against Reze, the Violence Fiend's kicks were strong enough to crack the ground she stood on after she blocked his attack.[7]
Poison Resistance: While he is put into a weakened state from his poison dispensing mask, he shows no signs of any ill effects from it.

Body Transformation: Violence has been shown during his attack on Reze, that he can access his strength and transform portions of his body to that of his released state. Doing so, said limb will enlarge and gain muscle mass, becoming immensely more powerful.

Hand-to-Hand Combat: The Violence Fiend's primary fighting style is unarmed combat; being able to knock back Beam with a punch and decapitate a zombie at point-blank range with a kick.

entries.name: House Devil
entries.content: The House Devil is a Devil that embodies the fear of houses. The House Devil is a large inn in the shape of a cross. It can be compared to the body of a human.

entries.name: Hirokazu Arai
entries.content: Hirokazu Arai was a Public Safety Devil Hunter. He was a new recruit working under Makima's special squad paired up with Kobeni Higashiyama. Hirokazu is a young man with short spiky hair, a scar on his left cheek and black round eyes. He is usually seen wearing a black suit. Hirokazu is shown to have high moral standards as he became flustered when Himeno promised a kiss to whoever killed the devil on their mission and he stated a young woman should not be giving herself away before marriage.

entries.name: Hirofumi Yoshida
entries.content:
Hirofumi Yoshida is a Public Safety Devil Hunter. Formerly a Private Devil Hunter, he was considered by Makima as a high-class bodyguard specialist along with Kusakabe and Tamaoki. After joining Public Safety, he has kept tabs on Denji by attending Fourth East High School and has intervened on multiple occasions to prevent Denji from revealing his identity as Chainsaw Man.

Yoshida has mid-length smooth black hair that only reaches the top of his neck, dark eyes, and a slim face. There is a beauty mark under his lips. He has eight piercings on his left ear, though usually, only six are visible below his hair. His piercings are likely a reference to his contract with the Octopus Devil. As a civilian Devil Hunter, Yoshida wears a casual outfit that consists of an unbuttoned light jacket and dark pants.

In Part 2 of the manga, Yoshida starts wearing the Fourth East Highschool uniform in a tidy manner, buttoned-up normally, unlike Denji and Miri Sugo. When performing tasks for Public Safety, Yoshida is usually seen wearing the organization's standard suit and tie.

Yoshida is quite playful and mischievous and loves to have small talk with his opponents during battle. Although Yoshida always has a smile on his face, he is also ruthless. This side of him is demonstrated when he mercilessly kills the Joey of the three Immortal Brothers in a back alley after showing up behind the surviving brother. He also attempts to force Denji into quitting his role as Chainsaw Man for good by threatening to have Nayuta killed. From his interactions with Kishibe, he is revealed to be still attending high school.

Yoshida seems to take his job seriously; he told Denji that if he attempts to reveal his identity as Chainsaw Man, he will interfere and take action to stop him, and eventually does it by grabbing him with the power of the Octopus Devil right before Yoru could attack him in his back, demonstrating he is also someone who keeps his word. He is also entirely capable of acting as the 'bad guy' if it helps him on his mission, taking Nayuta as a hostage by sending a special squad to her school or having Denji kidnapped in a unknown location. And, on the other hand, he is capable of being Denji's best support and ally, which is seen when he offers to skip classes and go to watch a movie in the cinema to cheer him up and even making a date for him.. Also, while on his duty as a devil hunter he seems to be somewhat strict and serious, telling to Fumiko Mifune stay focus on her mission and not get distracted.

He also seems to have a disdain for death, asking if it is possible for Denji, as Chainsaw Man, to consume the Death Devil for the good of the people. Whether this is a personal desire or the intentions of the organization he is part of is currently unknown. He even remarks by mocking the Eternity Devil that trapped him with his fellow members of the Devil Hunter Club that, thanks to its existence, he now appreciates life more in general.

Yoshida is someone who doesn't like to beat around the bush and prefers to get straight to the point, as seen when he meets Fami and immediately asks her about her next moves, even threatening her if she doesn't cooperate with him and Public Safety. His nearly perpetual smile can vanish and devolve into a grimace on rare occasions, like when he becomes too frustrated by Denji's lack of cooperation and seeming stupidity.

Yoshida seems to don't have any kind of interest in brawls among fellow students, considering it pointless to see them as something more than just a fight of teenagers, which demonstrates by being apathetic about a student who got hospitalized after receiving a punch on his face and only cared about it because Denji was blamed for that. He also knows when to quit; as it becomes apparent that Yoru has gained an advantage over him and he can't harm her anymore, he flees at the first opportunity.

Devil Contracts:

Octopus Devil Contract: Yoshida has a contract with the Octopus Devil for an unknown price.[7]
Tentacle Summoning: By crossing his middle and index fingers, he can summon the Octopus Devil's tentacles which protrude from ink clouds. He can summon multiple of these to attack small groups or bind them. Yoshida can summon them to wrap himself for protection or use them to catch him from falling to his death.[8]
Ink: By saying "Ink," the tentacle will produce a large black smokescreen. Yoshida uses this to blind his opponents and attack.

Hand-to-Hand Combatant: During his brief fight with Quanxi, he has shown quite a remarkable level of abilities in hand-to-hand combat, fighting for a few minutes on equal terms with her, someone who is well-known for her unnatural physical strength and fighting prowess, although he loses the battle.

Skilled Tactician: Yoshida has demonstrated to be a very competent tactician. He knows when it's the right moment to act and when it's better to stay behind and keep a low profile. He has a good intuition and is often seen moving to prevent any disaster, like when he stopped Denji and took him away when he was about to face Yoru, he also is seen going by himself to interrogate Fami about the Prophecy.

Swordsmanship: Yoshida is a proficient swordsman. His skills with the sword are seen when he cuts Asa Mitaka's right arm with Asa being unable to react when Yoshida attacks her.

entries.name: Himeno
entries.content:
Himeno was a Public Safety Devil Hunter working under Makima's Tokyo Special Division 4 Squad and she was partnered with Aki Hayakawa. 

Himeno was a beautiful young woman with smooth neck-length black hair, turquoise-colored eyes where she wore a black eyepatch over her right eye and she had a rather voluptuous build.

Himeno was shown to be a mature and experienced superior to the new recruits working under her. She generally carries herself with upbeat body language and was capable of staying calm under extremely stressful situations, such as the initial phase of her group's battle against the Eternity Devil. Himeno motivated Denji by offering him a french kiss, implying that she's at least somewhat perceptive of the people around her and was willing to take unorthodox approaches in order to ensure the best possible results from him.

Himeno was shown to be very efficient and blunt in her duty as a Devil Hunter. She responded to a small and seemingly insignificant Devil by almost immediately using her Ghost Devil to subdue it. She was shown to have a more stern side and little tolerance for behavior from new recruits that would endanger or harm her subordinates, as she swiftly took out Kobeni Higashiyama when the latter attempted to stab Denji.

Himeno was shown to be a rather caring and empathetic person as she cared for the well-being of her fellow Devil Hunters, as shown by her desire to not betray Denji during their first mission together. In a brief flashback scene, Himeno was shown to be very patient and tolerant to those that are suffering when a late partner's former girlfriend lashed out and slapped her out of grief.

However, despite this cheerful presentation, Himeno also held an extremely pessimistic worldview as a result of having witnessed multiple partners die suddenly in her line of work. This knowledge that Devil Hunters typically die as a result of their career combined with the teachings of her master eventually lead to her developing a nicotine addiction as a coping mechanism. Himeno even went as far as to pressure Aki Hayakawa into taking up smoking as a new recruit, citing the fact that Devil Hunters don't usually live long enough to suffer from the negative side effects of prolonged use of tobacco anyway.

Himeno had strongly internalized another old teaching of her master: that only Devil Hunters "who have a couple of screws loose" are ultimately successful, due to the general sense of unpredictability presented by their willingness to do unusual things to take down opponents.

Himeno cared deeply for Aki whom she trained as a new recruit and had a close personal bond with. In fact, Himeno considered the side effects of Aki using his sword bad enough that it would be worth sacrificing Denji to prevent. This puts into perspective how much she valued Aki's well-being.

Devil Contract:

Ghost Devil Contract: Himeno had the ability to use the power of the Ghost Devil; in exchange for sacrificing her right eye permanently to the Devil, Himeno could summon and control the right arm of the Ghost Devil by making the desired motions with her own right arm, which the ghost will mimic. The hand is invisible and intangible. This arm was strong enough to gouge large wounds into the Eternity Devil's flesh. During the fight with Akane Sawatari, Himeno, in exchange for her whole body, fully summoned the Ghost Devil to attack and overwhelm her opponent.
Skillset

Hand-to-Hand Combat: Himeno was a skilled fighter, instantly incapacitating Kobeni Higashiyama after she had been disarmed

entries.name: Hell Devil
entries.content: The Hell Devil is a devil that embodies the fear of Hell. The Hell Devil takes the form of a centaur with a featureless head except for its giant mouth which is open in a grimace. It is covered with taut flesh which is constantly burning.

entries.name: Haruka Iseumi
entries.content:
Haruka Iseumi is a student at Fourth East High School, where he is the president of the Devil Hunter Club and student council. He claimed to be Chainsaw Man but in actuality, he is an obsessed fan of Chainsaw Man. He then held a brief tenure as the public leader of the Chainsaw Man Church, though this backfired and he became villainized across the country.

Haruka is a slim young man who wears a bandana, an all-black uniform, and a military cap with a symbol. He has black hair combed to the side of his face. He has a pull cord in his chest identical to that of Pochita's in Denji's chest, later revealed to be a surgical implant.

Haruka seems to be benevolent and prideful on a surface level; he has a habit of constantly introducing himself in an extravagant manner and he holds his position as president of both the student council and the Devil Hunter Club in high regard. As of such, he tends to lead those around him, instructing others on how to handle a situation, utilizing their skillset to their advantage.

However, he can also be very demeaning to those he views as having no worth to the club, such as when he berates Asa for accidentally destroying her phone when she tried to help out. It's also shown that he can be fairly manipulative, lying to others that he is indeed the real Chainsaw Man, likely in order to boost his own popularity.
