However, when cornered in the aquarium he easily admits that his ripcord is simply a surgical implant and reveals himself to simply be a massive fan of the Chainsaw Man. Haruka doesn't seem exceptionally brave. When cornered in the aquarium he breaks down screaming for Chainsaw Man to save him, he is later also shown to be easily intimidated by others.

His devotion to Chainsaw Man is shown to be the main cause as to why he co-lead the Chainsaw Man Church as its "face," as he didn't have the same ulterior motives held by Barem and Fami. In fact, their plan involving the Fire Devil is shown to take a mental toll on him, and he swears to never get involved with Fami or her plans ever again. However, his devotion to Chainsaw Man immediately lead to him turning back on this vow and he decides to venture further into danger just for the chance of meeting him.

entries.name: Justice Devil
entries.content:
The Justice Devil is a Devil that embodies the fear of justice.

The Justice Devil appears as a large, caterpillar-like monster with no eyes nor nose and stone-looking pads on its shoulders.

As a Devil, the Justice Devil possesses all of the standard Devil abilities. During the battle against the Falling Devil, the Justice Devil has proven itself to be exceptionally powerful, forcing even Chainsaw Man to flee from it.


Immense Speed: The Justice Devil was easily able to keep up with Denji and Asa, even whilst they were escaping on the Super Chainsaw Man Motorcycle.

Immense Strength: The Justice Devil was able to effortlessly rip through entire buildings and crush cars using it's tentacles. It also managed to knock Chainsaw Man unconscious twice.

Regeneration: The Justice Devil was able to endlessly regenerate it's lost tentacles.

Shapeshifting: The Justice Devil was able to transform it's limbs into giant hammers, as well as create a new, enormous jaw on its belly.

It's unclear when the name of the Justice Devil began to be used to convince people to enter into contracts with the Fire Devil. The class president, later killed by Asa Mitaka when the War Devil took over her body, and then Yuko claimed to have made a contract with what they thought was the "Justice Devil", and that was still at Fourth East High School, possibly having made contracts with other students.

The true Justice Devil is later summoned from Hell by the Falling Devil, to be fed a series of dishes she would prepare, including Asa Mitaka. After nearly devouring both her and Denji, the Justice Devil is brutally killed by an enraged Falling Devil for vomiting, under the influence of Nayuta which made their taste similar to a fecal matter-like, both Asa that Denji.

Meanwhile, the Justice Devil's name would be used by Barem and the Chainsaw Man Church to convince people to enter into contracts with the Fire Devil, convincing them that the "Justice Devil" "would grant them the power to transform into any form they desired", with a person claiming to be Chainsaw Man who in a press conference claimed to have entered into a contract with the "Justice Devil".

The true Justice Devil's corpse is later inspected by the Department of Public Safety's Devil Name Consultant, who then reveals that the true Justice Devil had been killed during the Falling Devil's attack, and that the contracts in circulation could not link with it; later, Barem revealing that the culprit behind the previous contracts was the Fire Devil.

entries.name: Joey
entries.content:
Joey was a private devil hunter from the United States and part of the American Thugs. Joey is a tall man of average build, with long disheveled hair, and sinister eyes. He wears a suit similar to the Public Safety Devil Hunter uniform. Joey is the middle sibling but appears to be the least mature out of his siblings to the point that he is described as a dumbass by his older brother. He is also a womanizer, being after women no matter what country he is in. He enjoys smoking.

Despite his crude personality, he is still very close to his family, he reacted in shock and was angered by his brother dying, and tried to calm himself and Aldo before his death.

entries.name: Kusakabe
entries.content:
Kusakabe was a Public Safety Devil Hunter in Miyagi Division 2. 

Kusakabe has dirty blonde or light brown hair which extends to his upper neck. He wears black glasses, has either hazel or yellow eyes with a slightly muted hue, and a black suit like most of the Public Safety Devil Hunters.

Kusakabe is precautious and rigorous. He is the one who become furious when Denji tried to eat his food even after it fell to ground. As claimed by Makima, he is one of the best bodyguards. He cares about his mission and prepared.

entries.name: Kobeni's car
entries.content: Kobeni's car is a car bought by Kobeni Higashiyama. It is a 1965 Fiat 500. Kobeni's car is small, with a roundish roof, small wheels, a boxy front, a rectangular window shield, two doors and an older fashioned steering wheel. Kobeni's car is seen painted a bright yellow, leaning more towards pastel than vibrant.

entries.name: Kobeni Higashiyama
entries.content:
Kobeni Higashiyama is a former Public Safety Devil Hunter who started as a new recruit working under Makima's Special Squad. She later resigned from being a Devil Hunter after the battle against the Darkness Devil in Hell. Kobeni is a petite young woman with short brown hair, in both the anime and colored manga, tied in a ponytail. She has brown eyes with white pupils.

On her face are four moles, two under her left eye, one on the lower right side of her mouth, and one on her left cheek. She normally wears a professional suit and she has two hair clips.

Kobeni is exceptionally cowardly with few moments of courage. Her first confrontation with the Eternity Devil leads to her being paralyzed with fright and babbling. She is shown to easily crack under pressure and breaks down in tears when the group becomes trapped in the hotel and she is confronted with the possibility of them all starving to death without any rescue.

However, when Kobeni gets into action she had proven to be cool-headed and efficient, ruthlessly dealing with both the Katana Man and Akane Sawatari and forcing them to retreat; only breaking down in a panic once the fighting is over.

Despite being forced into a line of work that she hates by her family, Kobeni still cares about them as she sends her money to her brother to support him through college and chauffeurs her family around in her car. And despite wanting to quit, she initially stays because it was the day she was going to receive a bonus.

Kobeni is shown to be skittish when hugged repeatedly by Himeno, but tolerates her antics.

Kobeni is shown to enjoy alcohol, especially when it is paid for by someone else. Her hobby is to eat tasty things. She loves the flavor of ice cream which she has only experienced three times in her life.

In grade school, Kobeni had her parents buy her an ice cream just once for her birthday. The first taste was described by her as being so good that she broke into a run, tripped and dropped the ice cream.

Kobeni became a Devil Hunter partially because her parents forced her into work to support her brother to be able to go to college. Faced with the choice of becoming a sex worker or a Devil Hunter, Kobeni opted to become a Devil Hunter and joined Public Safety despite wanting to go to college too.

According to Himeno, Kobeni is talented, but she is held back by her timidness. This is later proven true when Kobeni manages to single-handedly defeat the Katana Man in his human form and forced Akane Sawatari to retreat.

Enhanced Strength: Kobeni is able cut a full grown man's arm clean off with a knife without much effort.
Enhanced Agility: Kobeni has an impressive level of agility, being able to dodge a tail attack from the Snake Devil before running across its body, a feat that prompted the Katana Man to call her a monkey. She also receives a perfect score when playing Dance Dance Mushroom.

Unknown Devil Contract: Kobeni has a contract with an unnamed Devil whose identity she keeps a secret.

entries.name: Knife Devil
entries.content: The Knife Devil is a devil that embodies the fear of knives.

entries.name: Kishibe
entries.content:
Kishibe  is a Public Safety Devil Hunter from Tokyo Special Division 1, but after the assault on the Special Divisions, he became captain of the Tokyo Special Division 4.

Kishibe is a grizzled man with scraggly facial hair and a stitched scar running across his left cheek from his mouth. At 194 cm (6'4"), he is quite tall. His hair is blonde with an underlying dark brown buzzcut with two piercings on his left ear and one on his right ear.

He is often seen with a silver hip flask which he frequently drinks from.

Kishibe is a stoic, straightforward individual. Due to his immense strength and skill, he often undertakes his work with a calm formality, displaying little emotion as he does so. Though he tends to speak in a relaxed, polite manner, his actions often showcase an immense brutality garnered through many years of Devil Hunting. Though he sometimes expresses emotions such as surprise and sadness at certain events, his face and voice remain entirely neutral.

Despite this stoicism, Kishibe has proven on numerous occasions to be something of a sentimental and emotional individual. During his training of Denji and Power, despite his stated hatred of Fiends and Devils, he grows affectionate towards the pair, telling Makima of his concerns for their safety. He later takes care of Meowy for them as a favor when they go on a trip. Similarly, he refuses to look at the corpse of Quanxi upon her death due to their implied past-friendship, despite the two's attempts to kill one another earlier in the day.

Kishibe told Denji and Power that he prefers to be called 'Master' while training them. He admits that he enjoys booze, women and killing devils.

Kishibe is the strongest member of Tokyo Special Division 4 according to Makima, followed by the Angel Devil. Kishibe has described himself as being the strongest devil hunter, and was purported to be a "first-rate hunter" by Hirofumi Yoshida during the International Assassins arc.

Kishibe has contracts with at least three devils which have described as being "fairly dangerous".

Though he was initially dismissed by them as being no one special, Kishibe proved strong enough to easily subdue two of the fiends who work for Quanxi singlehandedly.

Enhanced Strength: Kishibe is extremely strong for a human; he was able to pick Denji and Power up off the ground with one arm each and snap their necks with neither of them being able to stop him. With simple punches he could break weapons formed out of Power's hardened blood.

Enhanced Speed: Kishibe is an extremely quick fighter; able to dodge Denji's slash and counter-attack by stabbing him several times before Denji could react, and slash Power's throat before she could start her own attack.
Enhanced Reflexes: Kishibe has superhuman reflexes, being able to dodge a spear at point-blank range which was thrust through the door in front of him by surprise and react to incoming attacks from directly above him.
Enhanced Durability: Kishibe could survive being thrown out of a window and falling hard enough to crush the roof of a car, though he did slow his descent by stabbing a knife into the side of the building.

Devil Contracts:
Claw Devil Contract: Kishibe has a contract with the Claw Devil for an unknown price.
Knife Devil Contract: Kishibe has a contract with the Knife Devil for an unknown price.
Needle Devil Contract: Kishibe has a contract with the Needle Devil for an unknown price.

entries.name: Kenzo
entries.content: Kenzo is a Private Sector Devil Hunter who has been working as one for the past seven years. Kenzo is an average man with short brown hair parted in the middle. Kenzo is especially confident in his skills to take out devils, but he makes sure not to get too cocky. He takes the opportunity to work with other devil hunters should the chance arise, but has little problems working alone.

entries.name: Kato
entries.content: Kato was a Public Safety Devil Hunter. Kato is an average man who normally dresses in the standard Public Safety uniform. He appears to be a bit older and missing an eye.

entries.name: Katana Man
entries.content:
Katana Man ( real name unknown), known officially as Samurai Sword, is a Devil-human Hybrid who merged with the Katana Devil. His grandfather was the Debt Collector killed by Denji and because of that, he teamed up with Akane to get revenge on Denji and steal his heart.

In the Public Safety Saga, he serves as the titular main antagonist of the Katana Man arc and a minor antagonist in the Control Devil arc.

Katana Man later returns in the Academy Saga as a supporting character, having temporarily joined Public Safety as a member of Tokyo Special Division 7 with the personal agenda of reviving his grandfather's Yakuza syndicate and killing his arch-nemesis Denji.

Human Form: Katana Man is a tall man with short black hair and notable sideburns. In his debut arc, Katana Man dresses in a large leather coat with a dark military uniform underneath. During his time as one of Makima's brainwashed servants, Katana Man wore the Public Safety Devil Hunter suit and tie.

Hybrid Form: When Katana Man transforms, he grows large swords from each of his arms, and his face takes on a demonic appearance with dark skinless flesh and an oversized jaw devoid of lips. His chin becomes pointed, and another sword grows from his forehead where his eyes would be, with the handle sticking out of the back of his head. He also seemed to sport a navy blue military hat.

Katana Man is a selfish, cruel-hearted, and rather unintelligent man who only cares about killing Denji and forcing him to apologize for killing his grandfather. He will sacrifice innocent people and even his own comrades to do so, being willing to cut through them just to get to Denji. He has shown a complete disbelief in Denji's excuse that he killed his grandfather because he was a zombie and accused Denji of being a liar.

He loves his grandfather despite knowing he was a Yakuza boss because he viewed his grandfather as a man of principles who had only killed a handful of women and children. He also expresses the belief that the Yakuza are the "good guys" who protect Japan from behind the scenes, showing just how delusional he is in his ideals of justice.

Despite having his physical heart replaced with the Katana Devil, Katana Man considers himself to still have a human conscience and states that he doesn't sleep well on nights where he killed a zombie, in contrast to Denji who has no guilt at all. Katana Man has a harsh distaste for religion as well, believing his grandfather's idea that religion and idiots are making the world worse.

When he returns in Part 2, Katana Man still retains his hatred of Denji, and resents him even more than before. Those negative feelings have become worse, to the point of attacking and slicing a devil only because he talked about "Chainsaw Man" and his justice, claiming that he has no sense of justice. His hatred also extends to the symbol of Chainsaw Man as a whole, such as when screaming out of frustration at the sight of several Chainsaw Man Church members being transformed into Pseudo-Chainsaw Devils against their own will.

Katana Man's hatred for Chainsaw Man is enough that he will easily disregard orders from his superiors. Upon learning that Chainsaw Man was being held within the facility he was guarding and that Asa had come to fight him, Katana Man decides to go against Public Safety's orders to kill the intruders. Even if it means that he can never revive his defunct Yakuza syndicate, Katana Man prioritizes his hatred of Denji over everything, resulting in his betrayal of the organization to help Asa and Fami's group find his arch-nemesis.

He also seems to put a great importance of being a traditional "alpha-male", complaining how young boys like Denji now act more like a "woman" by crying all day and was disgusted to the point of saying that his grandfather would be rolling in his grave if he tried to avenge him by killing "Chainsaw Woman". So, he proposes to go to a soapland to make sure Denji can regain his manhood having sexual intercourse and cheer him up.

Though he largely shows indifference to violence being a former member of the Yakuza, he still seems to have an aversion to some forms of violence, being visibly disgusted when he saw Nayuta's decapitated head.

Hybrid Transformation: By removing his left hand from his body and revealing a katana which emerges from the stump, he can transform into the Katana Hybrid form with swords emerging from his arms and his head. Removing the katana from his arm will undo his transformation. After his transformation is undone, he is unable to fight for a while.

Augmented Strength: Katana Man's strength is greatly enhanced in his transformed state, allowing him to cut through solid walls with his slashes. He is also strong enough to cut the Fox Devil's flesh and the reinforced uniform used by Public Safety members, however he was not capable of making a deep cut in the suit with just one slash.

Augmented Durability: In his Hybrid form, Katana Man is durable enough to survive getting thrown through walls and falling from buildings without taking any damage. He also managed to survive being swallowed by the Fox Devil.
Augmented Speed: After transforming, Katana Man's speed is improved, allowing him to compete with Aki and Denji in terms of speed. He can also slash walls in the blink of an eye.

Sword-Draw Dash: Katana Man's special technique, it is a quick-draw sword technique (also known as iajitsu) by crouching down low and preparing to unleash his swords, Katana Man can dash forward at incredible speeds and slash at his opponent as he goes by them, often appearing to simply teleport past them before his attacks appear on his opponent's body. Katana Man moves faster than the average human eye can see and he can use this technique multiple times in a row without any apparent drawback. While this attack tends to only affect a specific part of the enemy's body, it does so with significant force, severing limbs or cutting the opponent in half. However, Katana Man does not actually disappear when he uses this attack, meaning it is possible to block or counterattack this move and wound him. If he gets injured while using this technique, the damage will take a few moments before it appears on his body, just like when he cuts someone with this attack.

Blood Consumption: As a Hybrid, Katana Man is able to restore his health by consuming blood. After being bifurcated by Denji, he was able to regenerate his body.

Nigh-Immortality: Due to being a Hybrid, Katana Man is immortal and nearly unkillable. He can survive being bifurcated, getting shot and take all kinds of injuries that would kill most Devils. Even if he dies, as long as someone removes his left hand, Katana Man can come back to life in perfect condition. After being killed by the Curse Devil, Akane managed to revive him, despite the curse being believed to be lethal.

entries.name: Long
entries.content:
Long was one of Quanxi's fiends, and one of her harem members. 

Long possesses a corpse with shaggy, dark purple-red hair that is around shoulder length. She also has a pair of red horns. Her eyes have red irises and yellow pupils. Her sweater is white with red shorts. She has muted red sneakers as well as cuffs on her hands.

Not much is known about her personality as she only shows expressions and not much else. She seems to be submissive and always seen with her wrists chained.

The corpses of Long and the other Fiends were eventually taken into custody by the Public Safety. As revealed by the scarred Public Safety agent during Asa Mitaka and Fami's assault on the Tokyo Devil Detention Center, Quanxi was supposedly recruited into Special Division 7 with the promise of regaining the corpses of her now deceased friends and lovers.

As a fiend, Long can't make contracts and her powers are considerably weaker than those of her devil form. However, she still has all the other standard devil abilities.

Fire Breathing: Long can breathe a large amount of fire from her mouth.

entries.name: Loneliness Fiend
entries.content: The Loneliness Fiend was a Devil that embodies the fear of loneliness. The Loneliness Fiend's seems to be an average man with numerous fangs.

entries.name: Leech Devil
entries.content:
The Leech Devil is a devil that embodies the fear of leeches. 

The Leech Devil has a large wrinkled body with four legs and two tentacle-like arms. Her limbs are tipped with circular orifices like a leech and her face consists entirely of a single large mouth with blocky teeth. She has long black hair, and three pairs of udder-like glands. 

The Leech Devil, like most devils, has a great hatred for humans. She cared deeply for the Bat Devil, referring to him affectionately and trying to avenge him after his death. She and the Bat Devil shared a dream of devouring all humans together. Despite her relationship with him however, she seemed willing to spare Denji purely because he has a cute face.

entries.name: Masaki Ando
entries.content: Masaki Ando was a Public Safety Devil Hunter. Masaki is a plain man with short dark hair. Masaki is mindful of the law even in intense situations as he requested permission to use his gun before defending himself.

entries.name: Meowy
entries.content: Meowy is a cat previously owned by Power, now being owned by Denji after Power's demise. Meowy is a cat with brown ears and a brown spot on the top of its head.

entries.name: Minami Nakano
entries.content: Minami Nakano was a Devil Hunter that was included between Kishibe and Quanxi's love-triangle. But after, she would resign from the Public Safety Devil Hunter. Minami is described as a young woman with a baby face and dark pixie haircut, as well as having big, round eyes that give the impression of a puppy. Minami is very outgoing and full of energy, as can be seen when she's being trained by Quanxi. Despite being told to rest multiple times, she keeps trying to push herself to become stronger.

entries.name: Miri Sugo
entries.content:
Miri Sugo is a Devil-human Hybrid that merged with the Longsword Devil.

Human Form: Miri is a young man of average height with unkempt black hair and visible dark circles under his brown eyes. He wears a dark blue drawstring hoodie underneath his Fourth East High School uniform. During his time as one of Makima's brainwashed servants, he wore the Public Safety Devil Hunter suit. His human appearance is noted as looking halfway between Denji and Haruka by his fellow students. He is a member of the Chainsaw Man Church.

Hybrid Form: When transformed, Miri gains a head similar to that of Katana Man, except that it has a pointed face from which two longswords protrude backwards, resembling a pair of horns. Miri's arms have blades protruding from them. In the Public Safety Saga, his arms contain cross-guards protruding from his elbows. However, in the Academy Saga, these are absent.

Initially, Miri's real personality was unknown due to being brainwashed and mind-controlled by Makima, although it seemed like he enjoyed attention and wanted to impress Makima. His character biography for the Second Popularity Poll refers to him as a young man with a light impression on things.

Post-mind control, Miri does seem to be fairly regretful for his actions during the fight, as he was able to seek out Denji to talk to him in private and empathize with his current situation. His regret stems from how he allowed himself to be manipulated by Makima, similar to Denji. As such, not only does Miri highly value his newfound free will, but he also wants to befriend Denji out of gratitude for killing Makima and freeing him from her control. Despite his best intentions, however, others such as Fumiko have noted how he still seems to be prone to being manipulated by others, despite his insistence that the opposite is true.

He is shown to easily fall for the Church's conspiracy theories. When Denji, the real Chainsaw Man, tells him that those are lies, Miri admits that the Church may not be fully honest but that it saved many people regardless and that the ends justify the means, therefore proving Fumiko's point. Denji's words do seem to have influenced him somewhat, as he's later seen questioning their decision-making.

His gratitude towards Denji has also left him fairly unsociable towards others who aren't Denji. Upon transferring to Fourth East High School, Miri immediately announces that he isn't interested in making friends while calling his classmates "pieces of trash". When bothered by some of his female classmates, Miri complains that they won't stop talking to him, even asking Denji to make them go away. Despite his attempts to befriend Denji, he seems to draw the line at "infantile behavior", as seen when Denji and Fumiko discussed their everyday food preferences instead of focusing on his offer.

Out of the four church members of "The Weapons", he alone seems to have the strongest moral compass, as he's shown to be heavily hesitant towards their plan to carry out mass murder in hopes of drawing Chainsaw Man out from hiding. He refuses the Whip Hybrid's idea that they were merely weapons, insisting that he is a human and he should think for himself.

In spite of this, Miri is still willing to aid Barem and the others in their plans and was fully ready to begin a massacre at the mall. When confronting Denji after his home had just been burned down, Miri still insists that everything they had done thus far was in order to save the world and stop the prophecy of Nostradamus. He encourages Denji to unleash his anger in order to save the world, causing the Whip Hybrid to laugh at his statements of delusion. This demonstrates Miri's inability to comprehend the severity of his actions and the kind of deep emotional trauma they would inflict on Denji and other innocent civilians.

Hybrid Transformation: Miri can remove his right hand and reveal a blade on the inside of his arm to transform into his hybrid form.

Augmented Body: Miri has strength, defense, and speed well above average for being a hybrid, being able to match beings like Katana Man and Chainsaw Man.

Blades: Like Katana Man, Miri has sharp blades on his arms that he uses to slash his opponents in combat.
Blood Consumption: As a Hybrid, Miri is able to heal wounds by consuming blood, regenerating his entire body.

Nigh-Immortality: Due to being a Hybrid, Miri is immortal and nearly unkillable. He can survive getting beheaded, impaled, and take all kinds of injuries that would kill most Devils. Even if he dies, as long as someone removes his right hand, Miri can come back to life in perfect condition.

entries.name: Mold Devil
entries.content: The Mold Devil is the devil who embodies the fear of mold.

entries.name: Mr. Kanbayashi
entries.content: Mr. Kanbayashi is the owner of a large villa on a hill. It is later revealed that said villa is the House Devil in disguise.

entries.name: Muscle Devil
entries.content:
The Muscle Devil is a devil that embodies the fear of muscles. The Muscle Devil's initial form appears as a small cycloptic snake with a weak and innocent appearance to be deceptively vulnerable.

By manipulating his muscles he reveals his true form as a large snake-like mass of skinless muscles with multiple eyes and a mouth full of crooked teeth.

The Muscle Devil is sadistic and cunning, using trickery to make Denji let his guard down and controlling a little girl's body as a pawn to do so.

He has a great hatred towards humans; taking a little girl prisoner to torture her and breaking Denji's arm just as a demonstration of his abilities.

entries.name: Michiko Tendo
entries.content:
Michiko Tendo was a Public Safety Devil Hunter from Kyoto. 

Tendo was a tall woman with black hair that was tied back in a messy ponytail with long side bangs reaching past her shoulders.

She tended to wear the standard Public Safety Devil Extermination uniform, and had a horizontal scar across her face—a feature she shared with Yutaro Kurose.

Like Yutaro, Michiko is nervous around Makima and insists that she doesn't want to join the special division. Michiko appears to have some sensitivity as she suggested stepping out to give Aki some space when she and Yutaro found him crying.

entries.name: Marshmallow Devil
entries.content:
The Marshmallow Devil is a devil who embodies the fear of marshmallows. 

The Marshmallow Devil has the appearance of a harmless-looking blob of flesh with four eyes, two in the back and two at the bottom. It has many small tentacles at the base of its body, most probably used for movement.

entries.name: Madoka
entries.content:
Madoka is a former Public Safety Devil Hunter. After the assault on the Devil Hunters by the Gun Devil's associates, he was one of the few survivors and decided to leave his job as a Devil Hunter. 

Madoka is a man of average height with short black hair. He has two horizontal scars crossing his face and wears glasses.

Madoka is cautious and rational, resigning when things get too dangerous for Public Safety's Special Division despite being one of the few survivors.

entries.name: Makima
entries.content:
Makima was a high-ranking Public Safety Devil Hunter who took Denji in as her human pet.

She is later revealed to be the Control Devil who embodies the fear of control or conquest. Following her death, she is reincarnated as Nayuta.

Makima is a Devil resembling a human woman in her twenties of average build, and marginally above average height (168 cm/5'6" to 173 cm/5'8"). She has long light red/pale auburn hair, normally kept in a loose braid with bangs reaching just past her eyebrows and two longer side bangs that frame her face. Her eyes are yellow with multiple red rings within them, making them the only visible sign of her inhuman nature.

Her usual Public Safety uniform consists of a white long-sleeved shirt, a black tie, black pants and brown shoes.

On the surface, Makima seems to be a kind, gentle, social and friendly woman who is usually seen wearing a smile on her face the entire time and acts relaxed and confident even during a crisis, speaking in a professional tone to her workers. As her natural appearance is nearly identical to that of a human, she avoids disclosing her Devil nature to most of her underlings and spends much of the series posing as a human contracted to a Devil rather than a Devil herself. However, this is only a facade that she uses to fulfill her ultimate goal. After the death of Aki Hayakawa, Makima begins to reveal her true colors to Denji. Makima's true face is of someone that is Machiavellian and calculating, who sees people around her as nothing more than "dogs" she can use as much as she likes and must obey her without any hesitation.

Makima has demonstrated herself to be extremely cunning, cold and manipulative as she controls Denji through the promises of a romantic and sexual relationship while also threatening him with outright extermination if he disobeys her. Ruthless and normally dispassionate, she will do whatever it takes to reach her goals, even at the cost of the people she should be protecting.

Makima also realizes that she is not a good person and deems herself as "necessary evil"; a weapon under control of the Japanese government, just like Gun Devil which is under the control of the American government. She is not afraid of her plans derailing, since whether her plans fail or succeed, she will almost always achieve something she wants.

Makima is an extreme fan of Chainsaw Man, the "Hero of Hell". Fascinated by its ability to wipe out the embodied concept of a Devil through consuming them, her stated goal is to bring Chainsaw Man under her control in order to use its abilities to create an ideal world without fear, death, and “bad” movies. However, failure is also acceptable, as it would mean being eaten—an honor according to her.

Makima's true goal, however, was to be together forever with Pochita and lead a happy life with him. She always yearned for something like a family, being incapable of forming equal and meaningful relationships as the Control Devil.

entries.name: Mantis Devil
entries.content: The Mantis Devil is a devil that embodies the fear of mantises. The Mantis Devil has only been partially seen, possessing massive, sickle-like limbs.

entries.name: Nuclear Weapons Devil
entries.content: The Nuclear Weapons Devil was a Devil that embodies the fear of nuclear weapons. At some point, prior to the event of Chainsaw Man, the Nuclear Weapons Devil was eaten by Pochita, thus ridding its existence along with the existence of nuclear weapons from the world. This causes one of the Horsemen, Yoru, to pursue the Chainsaw Man in order to make him vomit the nuclear weapons back up.

entries.name: Nomo
entries.content: Nomo was a Public Safety Devil Hunter and a member of Tokyo Division 2.

entries.name: Nobana Higashiyama
entries.content:
Nobana Higashiyama is a highschooler attending Fourth East High School and a member of the Devil Hunter Club as well as a tour guide for the Chainsaw Man Church. He is a brother of Kobeni Higashiyama. 

Nobana bears a notable resemblance to Kobeni, especially his face and eyes. Similarly to Kobeni he also has moles on his face, precisely two just under his right eye. He has short, brown hair that is kept in line by six hair clips on his right side and falls to his face on the left. Similarly to his sister, he is also quite short. Nobana wears the standard boys' uniform of Fourth East High School and has the typical cap from the Devil Hunter Club, though he doesn't wear it. He is always seen with sweat on his face, often also blushing.

Much like his older sister, Nobana is perpetually anxious but, unlike her, even more so and he hasn't had any moments of competency or bravery so far. He gets easily embarrassed and stutters uncontrollably when merely trying to say the word "sex". Similarly to Kobeni, his parents put a lot of pressure on him and force him to do activities he doesn't enjoy, like joining the Devil Hunter Club. Nobana's mind is fragile, as he goes insane after a few days of being trapped in the aquarium, licking the glass senselessly.

Later, Nobana joins the Chainsaw Man Church and becomes fully devoted to their cause, easily believing the lies which the Church tells its followers showing he's very susceptible to manipulation and conspiracy theories. For example, he believes that the concept of marrying as an adult is a system from the USA designed to control the Japanese like slaves and encourages students to have children and marry each other.

At some point in his life, Nobana was forced to join the Devil Hunter Club by his mother, as she believed it would earn him scholarships. He was also constantly picked on by various bullies who made him to light up their cigarettes with his lighter.

Nobana first appears alongside Fami, Haruka Iseumi, and Seigi Akoku during the aftermath of Yuko's attack on Fourth East High School. From there, the group allows Asa Mitaka to join the Devil Hunter Club before leaving elsewhere.

The Devil Hunter Club trio later show up at Tanashi Aquarium patrolling for any nearby Devils, having been trapped inside the building by the reincarnated Eternity Devil alongside Asa, Denji, and Hirofumi Yoshida. When Haruka attempts to introduce himself, Nobana freaks out and frantically explains his situation. Afterwards, the group try finding a way out, but to no avail they can only find a limited supply of food to keep them alive.

Nobana also witnesses Asa's failed attempt to prove herself useful to the Devil Hunter Club after the latter briefly argues with Denji. Three days pass, and everyone sans Denji and Yoshida are slowly going insane. Nobana himself constantly licks the glass containers as he loses his mind. The group eventually manages to escape thanks to Asa turning the aquarium into a powerful spear to take down the Eternity Devil.

Sometime after the Falling Devil's attack, Nobana joins the Chainsaw Man Church alongside various other students from Fourth East High School. Once Miri Sugo brings Denji to the church's headquarters, Nobana gives the two a tour through the building. It is revealed that Nobana has fallen for the church's crazy conspiracy theories, to which Denji denies any assumptions the church has made about him.

This causes Miri to argue back to Denji about the church's intentions, to which Nobana tries calming the two Hybrids down. Before he can show more of the building's areas, Barem Bridge stops Nobana and tells him to resume his usual duties. Nobana complies as he flees from the scene.

On the day Public Safety attacks the Chainsaw Man Church's forces, Haruka and Nobana are informed by the elderly cult leader to send all combat-trained followers to meet outside the prayer room. Despite appearing confused by this, Nobana and the other members arm themselves with guns to fight back. However, the members end up getting restrained by the Nail Fiend and Katana Man.

When various Chainsaw Man Church members have transformed into Pseudo-Chainsaw Devils due to their contracts with the Fire Devil, Nobana is not seen among the group charging at an enraged Katana Man.

A week after the recent ongoing Fire Devil attacks, Nobana and the other Chainsaw Man Church leaders were captured and locked up within the Tokyo Devil Detention Center by Public Safety. Once Asa and Fami manage to disarm a group of Public Safety guards with help from the Guillotine Devil, Nobana is freed alongside Haruka and Seigi.

Knowing how dangerous Fami is, Haruka tells Nobana and Seigi to get behind him. Haruka tells Fami to stay away from his group as their family's lives have been ruined thanks to her machinations. It is also revealed that anyone associated with the church are now placed on the country's most wanted list. However, the trio decide to accompany Fami's group once Asa informs them that she and Fami plan to rescue Chainsaw Man, who is held captive.

The group eventually runs into a Public Safety grunt who questions them the origins of the Pseudo-Chainsaw People locked inside a nearby room. A shocked Nobana continues listening to the man's words. However, Yoru deduces that the grunt was actually distracting them as Katana Man and the Nail Fiend arrive to stop Fami's group from proceeding any further.

entries.name: Needle Devil
entries.content: The Needle Devil is a devil that embodies the fear of needles.

entries.name: Nayuta
entries.content:
Nayuta is the reincarnation of the Control Devil following Makima's death. To prevent her from becoming similar to her previous incarnation, she was taken by Kishibe to be raised by Denji as Denji's younger sister.

Nayuta takes the appearance of a young girl with long dark brown hair woven into a braid and flung over her shoulder with one long bang that covers her left eye. Similar to Makima and Yoru, her eyes are yellow with multiple red-colored rings within them.

Denji describes her as a "huge-problem child with an extreme personality". As a humanoid Devil, she has a natural inclination towards humans. Just like her previous incarnation, Nayuta seems to like dogs, as seen by her getting along with Makima's dogs. However, unlike Makima, Nayuta does not seem to be controlling the dogs using her ability.

Nayuta is protective of Denji, wanting him to break off his relationship with Asa Mitaka as every woman he met tried to kill him. She seems to be very demanding, holds peace signs, and wants ice cream every day. Denji describes her as very smart.

Personality-wise, she bears little resemblance to Makima. Despite referring to Denji as her property, she does seem to care very much for him. She acts very similar to Denji, as she has picked up many of his mannerisms from being raised by him. Nayuta has taken on Denji's informal way of speaking, and even laughs like Denji. She is also well-spoken at times. When first introduced, she was taciturn and very blunt when she spoke, but upon spending time living with Denji, she has become outgoing and talkative.

She is shown to be very impish and mischievous, turning Yoru into a "dog" with her mind controlling powers and alters her and Asa's memories. Like Makima, she is able to perceive people using scent, getting a bad scent from Yoru and the Falling Devil. However, she does not seem to bear malicious intent, having only wanted to protect Denji in case he had made a bad decision. She has a personality befitting a human of her appeared age, and can act childish and argumentative with Denji. As he implied from Nayuta being smart enough to go to college, she also acts very precocious as well.

Nayuta has a rather amoral personality, where much of her morality is based on her own personal preferences. When Fami revealed a prophecy which would spell the end of humanity and the rise of Devils, Nayuta found it to be very fun. But when Fami noted this would mean the end of modern conveniences like pizza and Chinese food, she immediately changed her mind. Nayuta also refused to help Fami since she was busy with school, demonstrating how seriously she takes her education and how she's unwilling to help others if it gets in the way of her life.

Nayuta's amorality and general indifference towards others are shown further when the Chainsaw Man Church initiates their plans to strengthen Chainsaw Man and the War Devil. She had no compunction about killing any humans who attack her and Denji, and didn't hesitate to try and kill Fumiko when she tried to stop Denji and Nayuta from returning to their apartment. Nayuta believes killing other organisms is part of nature, the same way fish swim and trees photosynthesize, and that she instinctively feels that desire to kill others. She admits that she feels no real camaraderie for her friends at school and is indifferent to whether they die. To that point, she even expresses the desire to join the devil's side to free herself and Denji from the suffocation of human society to do what they please. The only thing that prevents her from acting on these desires is Denji. However, she is also shown to be visibly horrified as she watches Denji brutally slaughter the Weapon Hybrids, demonstrating that she is not nearly as apathetic towards the severity of violence and death as she proclaims. While defending herself against attacking civilians, Nayuta expects to feel the same excitement as Denji often does in a battle, but she admits that killing others isn't satisfying or thrilling to her compared to playing video games.

When she first met Denji, she was initially confused why she felt pity for him and felt a desire to take his heart. After using her powers on him, she learned of her previous identity and her goal of breaking the contract Denji made with Pochita. She sought to fulfill her previous incarnation's goal of giving Denji a normal life only to later break it in order to find out who she really was. However, after spending time with Denji, she eventually grew to care for him and abandoned her previous objective. She also prioritizes Denji's well-being over her own, brainwashing one of the attacking civilians of a frenzied mob to take Denji to safety while she was in the midst of being assaulted.

As the Control Devil, Nayuta has the same powers as Makima, as shown when she is able to use the chain link ability. She also has all the standard Devil abilities. However, unlike Makima, she can only fire three chains at a time and there are certain individuals she is not capable of controlling. This was shown when she failed to take control of Barem, though it's unclear whether she can't control any individual who was previously controlled by Makima or continue to be loyal to Makima.

Memory Alteration: Nayuta can erase someone's memories and plant false ones into their head. That ability can be used on both humans, and Devils, including Fiends.
Perception Alteration: Nayuta can change someone's perception of senses, like taste. That ability can be used on Devils.

entries.name: Nakamura
entries.content: Nakamura was a Public Safety Devil Hunter and a part of Tokyo Division 2. He is an average looking man with a bit of a square or rectangular face.

entries.name: Octopus Devil
entries.content: The Octopus Devil is a Devil that embodies the fear of octopuses. The Octopus Devil has only been partially seen as a mass of giant, oversized tentacles with suckers.

entries.name: Punishment Devil
entries.content:
The Punishment Devil is a devil that embodies the fear of punishment. 

Because of the circumstances in which the Punishment Devil made its only appearance in one gigantic amalgamation of several Devils, it is rather difficult to pinpoint exactly how it looks. They are a being of what may be several conjoined humanoid bodies with distorted faces, each carrying a different weapon. Outside of the bodies they have several conjoined arms on a opened mouth that looks very similar to the mouth of Snake Devil.  The inner body is a very light brown or brownish-yellow and the outer body with the conjoined arms on a mouth have a bolder yellow.

entries.name: Princi
entries.content:
Princi was the Spider Devil, a devil who embodies the fear of spiders, and is a Public Safety Devil Hunter from Tokyo Special Division 4. 

Princi resembles a young woman with waist-length black hair. She has eight legs ending in scythe-like, curved points which are sharp enough to stab through flesh. She appears to have a zipper in the center of her face with the pull under her chin to unzip upwards.

She normally wears a shirt and elaborate bow-tie with a knee-length skirt.

Princi usually takes a human shape so she tends to be friendly to humans and works as a devil hunter herself. She is shown to have a polite, docile and proper personality however she will still kill people for just looking at her the wrong way.

She showed no reaction at being mistaken for a human by the Violence Fiend and impassively killed zombies without any change in expression. She was bold enough to attack the Darkness Devil directly and showed no expression after being mutilated. She's also extremely devoted to Makima and will follow her orders directly, even if she has personal qualms with them.

entries.name: Pochita
entries.content:
Pochita is the Chainsaw Devil who embodies the fear of chainsaws. He was the original Chainsaw Man prior to becoming Denji's heart.

Near-death State Appearance: After disappearing from his battle with the Four Horsemen and Weapon Devils, Pochita is reduced to a “near-death state”. In this state, he appears to be a small orange canine-like Devil with a chainsaw-like appendage protruding from the center of his head. Handles emerge from his body allowing him to be wielded like a chainsaw, and his short tail is in the shape of a chainsaw's pull cord.

Normal Appearance: His true Devil form is of a large, humanoid Devil with four arms and a chainsaw protruding from each, with another chainsaw coming from the front of his head, similar to Denji's hybrid form. An intestine still connected to his stomach is wrapped around his neck, resembling a scarf or a collar.

Hybrid Form: After making a contract with Denji, Pochita assimilates himself with him, fusing with his heart and becoming part of Denji's anatomy, thus creating a hybrid. This allows Denji to become Chainsaw Man by pulling the chainsaw cord in his chest.

In this state, Pochita is smaller, has lost the chainsaw on his head, all his appendages and both handles. Pochita also has blood vessels connected to Denji. Pochita however still retains his trademark cute canine face. Denji's chainsaw cord is also directly connected to the top of Pochita's head.

When preparing to fight Makima, Denji removed Pochita from his body. Pochita then took on a Hybrid form similar to Denji's to fool Makima, with the only difference being that his arms were covered in the armored plates or scales he has in his true Devil form.

Unlike most Devils, Pochita communicated solely through barks and whines like an actual dog. However, after fusing with Denji, he is able to communicate telepathically with him. He continuously communicates with Denji through dreams, warning him to not 'open the door'.

Pochita deeply cared for Denji after his life was saved by the human, despite the Devil's general hatred toward humankind. He willingly gave up his heart to Denji so that he could fulfill his dreams which Pochita loved hearing about. He also showed that he knows Denji very well and is able to mimic Denji's personality and behavior to fool Makima.

Pochita exhibits a more erratic personality when in his true Devil form, as shown when he quickly murders anyone who expressed even the slightest bit of hostility towards him in the burger joint. However, even in this state he remembers his friend Denji's wish of trying a hamburger that isn't rotten and going on a date with a girl, which leads him to kidnap Kobeni Higashiyama. Later, he tells Denji that he always dreamed of being hugged, but his strength made that impossible, implying that his murder spree at the burger joint was accidental due to him being unable to properly control his strength around others.

He also seems to answer the calls of help from humans and Devils alike, proven when he saved both Makima and Kobeni from their problematic situations, though he later brutally assaulted the former after completing his task. Despite this, his love for Denji remained, as he was keen to fulfill his friend's dreams, and later even sacrificed himself to save Kobeni.

In spite of being a devil, Pochita appears to have a form of attachment or respect for humanity. This can be supported by the fact he has consumed various devils that are dangerous to humanity, such as the AIDS Devil, Arnolone Syndrome Devil, Light of a Star That Breaks Children's Minds Devil, Mount Hio Eruption Devil, Nazi Devil, World War II Devil and the Sixth Sense Devil. By consuming the Nuclear Weapons Devil & partially consuming the War Devil, he also prevented any more wars from rising and the risk of nuclear armageddon.

Furthermore, when Pochita disguised himself as Denji to fight Makima, he asked her whether she would eliminate bad movies from the new world she planned to create. After replying that she believes a world without bad movies would be better, Pochita realizes that he has no choice but to kill Makima, demonstrating that he does not use his erasure ability lightly and that he only uses it against devils representing very deadly concepts.

Being regarded as the Devil that Devils fear the most, the Chainsaw Devil is considered one of the most powerful entities in the series after the Primordial Devils, being able to fend off hordes of Devils in Hell unscathed. The hunt for his heart alone was enough to cause an international conflict, and even Makima, one of the Four Horsemen, considered herself inferior to him, needing the public's adoration to weaken and defeat him.

As a Devil, the Chainsaw Devil possesses all of the standard Devil abilities. These include the ability to make contracts with humans, restore his health by consuming blood and revival into hell after his death. However, unlike most of the Devils, certain aspects of his personality have never changed. No matter how many times he was killed, he would always come back to killing other Devils.

His first contract with Denji was that, in exchange for consuming his blood, Pochita assists him to pay his debts. It is confirmed later on as a real contract rather than the "promise" presented by a young Denji. Later on, after Denji is fatally injured by the Zombie Devil, Pochita became the heart of Denji in exchange for Denji living a "normal life.

entries.name: Pingtsi
entries.content:
Pingtsi was one of Quanxi's fiends, and one of her harem members.

Pingtsi possesses a corpse with dark hair with a blue hue and has an futakuchi-onna-like ponytail along with eye-length bangs and slightly longer side bangs. Given the same coloration of the ponytail and the rest of the hair it is unknown if the ponytail was originally a part of the corpse or a part of the devil that took the form of one. All of the hair bands she wears have been shown as red. She wears a long sleeved, knee-length black dress with white cuffs and a dress collar. She wears plain black shoes and black leggings. Her eyes on her ponytail seem to be purple while the eyes on her face may either be red or also purple. She is considerably shorter than the rest of Quanxi’s fiends.

Pingtsi is a very cheerful, talkative girl who likes to share useless facts in order to impress or entertain Quanxi.

The corpses of Pingtsi and the other Fiends were eventually taken into custody by the Public Safety. As revealed by the scarred Public Safety agent during Asa Mitaka and Fami's assault on the Tokyo Devil Detention Center, Quanxi was supposedly recruited into Special Division 7 with the promise of regaining the corpses of her now deceased friends and lovers.

As a fiend, Pingtsi can't make contracts and her powers are considerably weaker than those of her devil form. However, she still has all the other standard devil abilities.

Magnifying Glass: Her ponytail can turn into a magnifying glass or monocle and seems to detect information. Such as when she could find out what devils a person is contracted with, described in more detail below. When she and the others got sent to Hell, even when all the fiends were uncomfortable from the area including herself, she managed to give out information in detail about the Primal Fears watching everyone and was shown having her magnifying glass out.
Contract Perception: Her ability allows her to gain information on what Devil contracts a human has. She used this ability against Kishibe and revealed his contracted devils and the lack of sacrifices in his body, which suggests that she is able to foresee possible sacrifices required to use abilities of contracted devils.

Bilingual: Pingtsi has demonstrated the ability to speak both Japanese and Chinese, but couldn’t understand Japanese at first and needed to use her magnifying glass to collect information.

entries.name: Pig Devil
entries.content: The Pig Devi is a devil that embodies the fear of pigs. The Pig Devil's appearance is that of an extremely large pig with four eyes. Two of which are very small and just above its snout.

entries.name: Reze
entries.content:
Reze, also known as Lady Reze or Bomb Girl, is a Bomb Devil Hybrid from the Soviet Union, who was sent to Japan with the mission of stealing the Chainsaw Man's heart.

Human Form: Reze appears to be a young woman or girl, and is of slender build. She has shoulder-length purple hair and emerald-green eyes. She is shown to be prone to blushing heavily. While posing as a civilian, she is seen wearing a choker in order to conceal the grenade pin in her neck, which she uses to transform.

Hybrid Form: As the Bomb Hybrid, Reze's transformation is that of an atomic bomb, mostly reminiscent of the Fat Man atomic bomb which exploded over Nagasaki in the last moments of the Second World War. Consistent with other hybrid transformations, her teeth are always visible and are notably sharp and angular.

Bomb fuses cover her arms like sleeves while also making up a portion of her apron along with sticks of dynamite. Her clothes vary during her attempt to retrieve Denji. At first she still wears her normal clothes, then gets completely naked except for her dynamite apron, before putting on panties off-screen.

Reze initially appears to be a kind and gentle girl who has a crush on Denji soon after meeting him, taking interest in him at first sight and was portrayed to be as somewhat enthusiastic, as shown when both Denji and her have a drink of coffee at the Café she had worked at. She is shown to be laughing at his jokes and isn't afraid to get close and intimate with him.

Reze is also shown to be a bit of a tantalizer, teasing Denji on some occasions, such as when she had seen how he forced himself to drink the coffee and teased him for being "such a kid," While also displaying a rather sympathetic side to her, showing her concern about Denji never attending school as a child or in his current position. She shows little respect towards the owner of the café she works at, calling him a cheapskate for docking her pay.

This was later revealed to be just a façade in order to get her closer to Denji; even her seemingly true reactions like blushing in his presence were results of a harsh military training that Reze was subjected to from a young age. However, Reze had shown mercy towards Denji despite her mission, and at the end of the Bomb Girl arc, Reze missed her train to meet Denji again at the café, to take his offer on running away with him.

Despite her fake crush on Denji, Reze somewhat reciprocated his feelings towards her, and empathized with him since they had both never been to school before. Although using more manipulative type of fighting, she seems to not enjoy killing or harming others and prefers to avoid it, unless it's necessary for her mission.

Enhanced Strength: Despite being a young girl, Reze has a great amount of physical strength; she could break an assassin's arm effortlessly and choke him to death, and with a simple knife she could cut cleanly through Denji's wrist in one swing. She is also strong enough to bite Denji's tongue off and throw her own head with enough force to break a glass window.
Enhanced Speed: Reze could cut through Denji's throat before he could react and slice straight through Denji's wrist before he could pull his chainsaw cord.

Hybrid Transformation: By pulling a pin on her neck, much like a grenade, Reze can cause herself to explode and transform into a hybrid form. She also can perform the same technique but instead of just transforming, she blows her head off and leaves the rest of her body as a decoy to distract her opponents. This decoy can hold it's own head and throw it, the head then explodes just like a bomb and reveals a transformed Reze. The headless decoy body can be remotely controlled and act as a bomb, catching its target off-guard.

Augmented Durability: Reze becomes drastically more durable in this form as she can withstand a full-power kick from the Violence Fiend without taking any damage. Her body can also withstand her own explosions without taking any damage and fall from the sky at immense velocity.

Explosion Creation: After pulling the pin on her neck, Reze gains the ability to create explosions. The explosions are powerful enough to destroy vehicles, buildings and asphalt roads. Her explosions are also effective against other Devils, being capable of harming the Shark Fiend and Denji in his hybrid form. Besides that, Reze does not take any damage from her explosions, unless she desires, allowing her to use her powers without worrying about harming herself.
Explosive Propulsion: By releasing explosions from her arms and legs, Reze can enhance her physical attacks and mobility with the explosive force from the blasts. She can also travel through the air by causing continuous and consecutive explosions, being capable of keeping up with cars.

Augmented Strength: By infusing her attacks with explosive force, Reze's punches and kicks become more devastating. Her explosive unnamed attacks have also been shown to be powerful enough to destroy trucks and send Denji flying several feet into the air.

Augmented Speed: Reze is able to use the explosive force created from her blasts to increase her movement speed. By releasing a massive explosion, Reze was able to send herself flying several feet into the air. She was also able to use her explosions to reach Aki's car in a short period of time.
Explosive Spark: By flicking her hands, Reze can release a spark which explodes upon impact. This attack serves as a long range projectile and is powerful enough to kill ordinary humans.

Self-Detonation: Besides her ability to release explosions from her body, Reze also has the power to turn parts of her body into bombs. Unlike her normal explosions, which are more instantaneous, the explosive flesh behaves more like a remote bomb. The body parts that Reze losses by using them as explosives do not appear to cause her damage, since she is able to regrow them without needing to drink blood.

Torpedo Transformation: Reze can transform her limbs into torpedoes, which makes her punches and kicks more devastating. Reze does not appear to suffer any damage from the detonation of her torpedo-like limbs.
Blood Consumption: As a hybrid, Reze is able to restore her health by consuming blood. After drinking blood from the Typhoon Devil she could regrow her severed leg instantly.

Nigh-Immortality: Due to being a hybrid, Reze is immortal and nearly unkillable. She can survive being beheaded, bisected and take all kinds of injuries that would kill most devils. Even if she dies, as long as someone pulls her pin, Reze can come back to life in perfect condition.

Water: Reze can not use her explosion powers if she is wet, since the moisture prevents her from generating the necessary spark for her explosions.

entries.name: Quanxi
entries.content:
Quanxi, also known as The First Devil Hunter, is a Crossbow Devil Hybrid and renowned Devil Hunter from China.

Human Form: Quanxi is a tall woman with cream colored hair tied back in to a ponytail. She wears an eye patch over her right eye, has a brown left eye, and possesses an atheletic build. She currently wears the standard Public Safety Devil Hunter suit and tie. She also wore that outfit in the past and during her time as one of Makima's brainwashed servants. Her eyepatch appears to be made of frilled lace instead. She also wears a matching, black lace choker.

Hybrid Form: In her transformed state, Quanxi's teeth sharpen along her head, transforming into hardened arrows with wide curved horns taking the shape of a bow on the side of her head. Arrowheads stick out of her neck while her forearms grow glove-like flesh with sharpened bow-shaped attachments.

Quanxi is calm and stoic, having no shame in discussing business while she's in bed with her harem of fiends, showing little emotion even as her girlfriends fawn over her. Part of her indifference seems to stem from a belief that "ignorance is bliss" as she tends to be put off things she used to enjoy by learning more about them. However, she does deeply care for her fiends, making her one request for a reward be that they are given human rights and a basic education, and not attacking them even after they have been turned into dolls at the cost of her own safety.

Quanxi is ruthlessly pragmatic in combat, preferring to throw her enemies outside of the battlefield in order to efficiently cut down their numbers and remove distractions. Similarly, after being cast into Hell, she instantly requested a ceasefire in hostilities so as to determine their situation. This alliance continued until the moment the threat was contained, at which point she immediately attacked once again. Though her attacks are swift and brutal, she can at times choose to leave those other than her target alive, as highlighted when she knocked Aki and Angel Devil unconscious and offered to spare Power's life. At other times she did slice through some Devil Hunters, hired to protect Denji, that weren’t her target.

Quanxi seems to have a past amongst the bureau, being referred to by Santa Claus as the 'First Devil Hunter'. This suggestion is furthered by her conversation with Kishibe, hinting at a past friendship between the two. It was revealed that Quanxi and Kishibe were formerly partners during their career as Public Safety Devil Hunters. Despite fighting him due to recent events, she still considers Kishibe an "old friend" and takes his advice, as evident when she refuses to hurt Denji's body during Asa's raid of the Tokyo Devil Detention Center because Kishibe wanted to protect him.

Enhanced Strength: Quanxi possesses a level of strength having been described by Hirofumi Yoshida as being beyond what is humanly capable. When wielding swords, she can cut through dozens of humans and dolls without slowing down and only stopped once her weapons were destroyed by the force of her own attacks. Even a blocked strike was enough to knock out both Aki and Angel. Her strength is remarkable enough that even when in her human form, she was capable of dismembering three Weapon Hybrids, even when one was transformed.

Enhanced Speed: Even in her human form, Quanxi possesses superhuman speed. She could disappear from the sights of five Devil Hunters by blitzing past them while cutting through an army of dolls created by the Doll Devil, before the original five Devil Hunters realized they had already been killed. More remarkably, she was capable of beheading three Hybrids before any of them could properly react, all while in her human form.

Enhanced Reflexes: Quanxi has superhuman reflexes, her time perception can keep up with her own superhuman speed. She can also dodge attacks rapidly and even stop a moving knife with her fingers.

Hybrid Transformation: By pulling an arrow out of her right eye socket, Quanxi can transform into a Hybrid with many arrows and spikes emerging from her arms and head.

Arrow Shooting: In her Hybrid form, Quanxi is equipped with crossbows in her arms which can shoot several arrows at her targets. These arrows are shown to be quite powerful as they are able to tear perfectly circular holes into whatever Quanxi shoots. She can also use this ability to defeat enemies from close range by firing a buckshot to wipe out a group of enemies quickly.

Blood Consumption: As a Hybrid, Quanxi is able to heal wounds by consuming blood, regenerating her entire body from just a head.

Nigh-Immortality: Due to being a Hybrid, Quanxi is immortal and nearly unkillable. Despite likely being over 50 years old, Quanxi still looks the same way she did 30 years ago. Even if she dies, as long as someone pulls her arrow, Quanxi can come back to life in perfect condition.

Bilingual: Quanxi has demonstrated the ability to speak both Japanese and Chinese.
Hand-to-Hand Combat: Quanxi is a skilled fighter in hand-to-hand combat, with Kishibe considering her to be one of the best in the world. She is highly specialized in using kicks, within a matter of moments she could disable Denji, Tamaoki and Kusakabe using nothing but kicks.

Swordsmanship: Quanxi wields multiple blades in combat, swapping them out as they're destroyed by the force of her own attacks. Combined with her high speed she can cut through entire crowds of enemies at once.

entries.name: Santa Claus
entries.content:
Santa Claus is a global hive mind of perfect doll assassins, indistinguishable from regular humans, controlled by one individual with the help of the Doll Devil. Due to the form Santa Claus took when Cosmo sent her mind into her own mind, the aforementioned individual and the main body of Santa Claus is presumed to be a mysterious woman who has a contract with the Doll Devil allowing her to control several different bodies, one of which poses as a Devil Hunter from Germany.

Santa Claus’s main body is presumed to be a dark blue-haired, green eyed woman with a mole under her eye. She wears a dark skirt and a orange sweater.

After she ate a piece of Darkness Devil's flesh, she gained several doll arms and appendages and her legs were made of doll heads from the pile of dolls she was in. During night, she transformed and became larger and more devilish. She also grew horns just like the Darkness Devil has and sharp teeth. In the colored manga the darker skin of the body at night is a dark purplish-gray while the lighter doll head torso and legs are the same color as Santa’s human skin as the doll heads mimic her original face when she was human. She has 40 eyes on her monstrous form in total, with 10 arms at day and even more arms at night.

Santa Claus is a tactical and strategic being. She hid herself in a remote region, while using a perfect doll to bargain and negotiate. When introduced, Santa Claus appear to be a lecherous being who asked for several children of either gender as their reward for bringing in the Chainsaw Devil from Japan, apparently for use in contracts and for pleasure (although this is likely done to instill strong emotions into them and groomed them to be the next perfect doll). It is later revealed that three of the children are meant to be used for contract with Hell Devil along with the old man perfect doll.

She has no issues with forcibly recruiting large numbers of civilians to work for her by transforming them into puppets. She has shown no regard for those who seem to care for her. For example, when her ally Tolka had subdued Denji, Santa Claus turned him into a puppet to communicate with the Darkness Devil and complete the contract.

Makima and Kishibe hold “him” in high regard as the most dangerous threat towards Denji amongst the world's assassins and devil hunters as they say it will all be over if Santa Claus uses “his” devils against them.

Doll Devil Contract: Santa Claus had a contract with the Doll Devil for an unknown price.

Doll Creation: Santa Claus can create dolls out of people to obey her will. The effect is caused by touch and spreads contagiously as each doll touches another person, allowing them to create an army of dolls out of a crowd. The dolls can also transform one of their arms into blades as well as generating blades under their feet. However Santa Claus must remain in the nearby area in order to maintain control of their army of dolls, and the conversion process has no effect on fiends nor hybrids. She could supposedly made the doll regain their human consciousness, although it’s unclear if she always has this ability, if she gained it after eating the Darkness Devil’s flesh, or if she merely had the dolls mimic human behavior to dishearten Denji.

Perfect Doll Creation: By instilling emotions that only humans can have into a puppet, such as respect, worship, admiration, and guilt, Santa Claus can turn people into perfect dolls, become a part of Santa Claus and are able to make devil contracts in Santa's place. Known perfect dolls include: Santa Claus in Germany, Tolka, and possibly Master. Perfect dolls that are not directly controlled by Santa’s consciousness seem to be possessed by the Doll Devil itself, since Tolka referred to himself as the Doll Devil when talking to the Darkness Devil.

Mind Transfer: Santa Claus states that she can transfer her consciousness to any one of the dolls she has made across the world, effectively making her immortal as long as one of her dolls is still functioning. It is unclear if she has the ability to completely mind transfer her consciousness to another body prior to obtaining the Darkness Devil’s flesh, further causing ambiguity as to whether or not Master is Santa’s original body. It may be the case that she did not have this ability prior to her contract with the Darkness Devil, since she seemed to want to avoid the impending death of her main body.

Curse Devil Contract: Santa Claus was contracted with the Curse Devil. In exchange for the loss of sensations in several of their fingers, Santa Claus can use the Curse Devil's power. The contract requires the nail to be stabbed 4 times into the intended victim, after which the Curse Devil will appear and kill the target. It is not required that the stabbing must be occurring at same time or by the same person.

Hell Devil Contract: Santa Claus was contracted with the Hell Devil. Santa Claus can transport any living beings to Hell by naming the place they are currently in. However not only must they sacrifice three of their children, but they also need to sacrifice one of their own bodies as well. Later, Makima used this contract via one of their perfect dolls to return any living beings back to human world.

Darkness Devil Contract: In exchange for bringing Denji to Hell, the Darkness Devil gave Santa Claus a small piece of its flesh to ingest, which gave her a boost in several abilities such as:

Enhanced Doll Devil Power: Santa is freely able to distribute her senses and pain to all of her dolls. She is also able to turn fiends and maybe even hybrids into dolls when she previously couldn’t, although the latter is only speculated to be possible by Santa herself and was stopped by Denji before she could attempt to do it. It may also be questionable if she can only turn dead fiends into dolls, as people turn into dolls through touch even through their clothes, and when the two doll fiends were holding the living one hostage she did not turn into a doll. The dolls she made have also been enhanced, as they are able to continue functioning despite being fatally wounded when they previously couldn’t.

Enhanced Strength: Santa was strong enough to hit Denji through several floors and walls. Her strength is further increased at night.

Enhanced Speed: Santa was fast enough to jump from the ground to the top of a multi-story building in a few seconds, she was also able to catch several arrows that were as fast as bullets. Her agility also increases at night.
Enhanced Intelligence: Santa believed that with the power of Darkness, she would be able to understand everything. However, whether this is true or not, whatever understanding she gains does not compare to the knowledge of the universe given from Cosmo and she is driven to madness.
Immense Regeneration: Santa was able to heal her wounds by being in darkness, recovering from fatal injuries in an instant. Even in daylight she could instantly regenerate from being torn to pieces by Quanxi.
Devil Transformation: Santa became much taller, grew many more arms, and had many other changes to her body that resembled dolls. She grows even more devilish during nights.

entries.name: Sato
entries.content: Sato was a Public Safety Devil Hunter. Sato is a man with short light hair who tends to wear the standard Public Safety Devil Extermination uniform.

entries.name: Sea Cucumber Devil
entries.content:
The Sea Cucumber Devil is a devil that embodies the fear of sea cucumbers.

The Sea Cucumber Devil has a cylindrical fleshy body with countless human fingers emerging from all sides. At the top of its body is a large orifice and a human skull which emerges from just underneath it. Its body is magenta and blue, with blue fingers.

entries.name: Seigi Akoku
entries.content:
Seigi Akoku is a highschooler attending Fourth East High School and a member of the Devil Hunter Club. 

Seigi is a heavyset teenager and is taller than average. He wears the typical male uniform of a high school student and a black military cap. When fighting Yuko, he wore spiked brass knuckles. After his battle, he lost an eye, which is bandaged and later replaced with a black eyepatch.

He seems to be steadfast and disciplinary, going right into the action when Yuko attacked the school to buy time for more Devil Hunters to show up.

He is also shown being rescued alongside other members of the Chainsaw Man Church during Asa's attempt to rescue Chainsaw Man. Whether he joined of his own free will or due to being part of the Devil Hunter Club is unknown.

entries.name: Seraphim
entries.content:
Seraphim is either a Devil or a Fiend who was under Makima's control. They were shown alongside Dominion, Virtue, and Princi, as well as the corpses of Power, Galgali, Angel, and Beam.

Seraphim is some sort of humanoid being that resembles a bug. They have antenna and bug eyes, as well as green skin and fly wings.

entries.name: Shiina
entries.content: Shiina is a police officer of the Kanagawa Prefecture. Shiina is tall gaunt man. During the mission to take down Akane Sawatari and the Katana Man he was equipped in full riot gear obscuring most of his features.

entries.name: Skin Devil
entries.content: The Skin Devil is a devil that embodies the fear of skin.

entries.name: Snake Devil
entries.content: The Snake Devil is a devil that embodies the fear of snakes. The Snake Devil has the appearance of an enormous snake with a large mouth made out of interlocking arms and hands instead of teeth. It has green scales/skin and a red eye with black sclera.

entries.name: Spear Hybrid
entries.content:
Spear Hybrid (real name unknown) is a Devil-human Hybrid that merged with the Spear Devil.

The Spear Hybrid is a tall man with short blonde hair who wears glasses. He also has a bit of stubble on his chin.

During his time as one of Makima's brainwashed servants, the Spear Hybrid wore the standard Public Safety Devil Hunter suit and tie. After her defeat, he wears a sweater underneath a light-colored coat.

After being freed from Makima's control, the Spear Hybrid's true personality reveals him as a sadistic, cold-hearted individual with little qualms about harming innocent lives. He also appears to be devoted to Barem's cause of luring out Chainsaw Man with a massacre, even smugly grinning at the thought of making women and children scream in agony when planning to slaughter them.

entries.name: Stone Devil
entries.content: The Stone Devil is a devil that embodies the fear of stones. The Stone Devil appears to be a gargoyle-like being with stone skin, small bat wings, clawed legs and a draconic head with multiple pairs of eyes.

entries.name: Subaru
entries.content:
Subaru is a Public Safety Devil Hunter and a member of Kyoto Division 1. He had trained Miyagi's 2nd Division.

Subaru is a tall man with messy black hair and a short beard.

When Subaru, Kurose, and Tendo are driving to Tokyo, the trio of brothers (The American Thugs) set down a spike strip and make them crash. The brothers then shoot them all dead.

entries.name: Taiyo Hayakawa
entries.content: Taiyo Hayakawa was the younger brother of Aki Hayakawa who was killed by the Gun Devil. Taiyo was a young boy who heavily resembled his older brother. Taiyo was innocent and fun-loving, caring a lot for his older brother and parents.

entries.name: Takashi Inoue
entries.content: Takashi Inoue was a civilian working for Katana Man and Akane Sawatari. He was killed by Makima through the use of her Force Manipulation power.

entries.name: Tamaoki
entries.content: Tamaoki was a Public Safety Devil Hunter and a member of Miyagi Division 2. He has short hair, faint eyebrows, several eyebags and a mole on his forehead.

entries.name: Tanabe
entries.content: Tanabe was a Public Safety Devil Hunter and a member of Tokyo Division 2.

entries.name: Mr. Tanaka
entries.content:
Mr. Tanaka was a teacher of Asa Mitaka's class. He was later killed by Yoru, the War Devil, who turned him into a human weapon during her battle with the class president. Mr. Tanaka was a tall man with black hair and parted bangs. He mostly wore white shirt with black tie, and a coat.

Mr. Tanaka was a kind man who values life and the well being of his students. He took special care to make sure Asa Mitaka felt included in the class, including asking the class president to befriend her and apologizing to the class on her behalf for the death of Bucky.

However, he may have been more unscrupulous then he seemed, as it was later revealed that he was sleeping with the class president despite their age difference and student-teacher relationship.

entries.name: Tolka
entries.content:
Tolka is a private devil hunter from the Soviet Union. 

Tolka is a tall, plain-looking man with light hair and pale eyes. When he goes hunting he dons a hoodie and a quiver on his back.
