Tolka has been conditioned to believe that taking a life is not a serious matter thanks to his hunting trips with his master. After being questioned on whether or not he can kill a sixteen-year old boy like an animal, Tolka affirms that he can do so.

Tolka is devoted to his master; being willing to kill another person so that she could retire peacefully, as well as wiping her mouth when she eats.

entries.name: Tomato Devil
entries.content:
The Tomato Devil is a devil that embodies the fear of tomatoes.

The Tomato Devil has a large round red body resembling a tomato, with multiple bulging eyes sprouting its surface in all directions. It stands upon eight human-like arms which emerge from its base and has a large vertical mouth at the center of its body.

entries.name: Tomono
entries.content: Tomono is a friend of Yutaro Kurose and Michiko Tendo. Tomono is a young man with short dark hair and wears glasses.

entries.name: Tsugihagi
entries.content:
Tsugihagi is an unnamed fiend, and was one of Quanxi's harem members. 

Tsugihagi possesses a corpse with short green hair and has grey sclera and yellow eyes. She has normal pale skin albeit with a grey hue in shading with stitches covering her face, thighs and upper arm. She wears long black skirt, loose yellow cardigan with 4 buttons and black clogs. 

Nothing is currently known about Tsuguhagi's personality as she didn't speak a word in all her appearances; however, she is extremely loyal to Quanxi and her women.

In Hell, Quanxi gets decapitated and Long and Pingsti are killed. However when transported back, Tsugihagi manages to obtain Quanxi's head and when looking back she realises that Long and Pingsti have been killed. She stands at the top of the building that had been sent to hell and pulls out an arrow from under Quanxi's eyepatch. She then drops Quanxi's head to the fight that was occurring between Denji and Santa Claus below, allowing Quanxi to transform into her hybrid form and kill the dolls that were attacking Denji.

After Santa Claus has been dealt with. Makima appears out from the smoke, drawing her sword. Quanxi surrenders, pleading to Makima to not kill her women, even offering her own limbs so that she won't. However, her words are futile, and Makima kills Quanxi, Cosmo and Tsugihagi by decapitating them.

The corpses of Tsugihagi and the other Fiends were eventually taken into custody by the Public Safety. As revealed by the scarred Public Safety agent during Asa Mitaka and Fami's assault on the Tokyo Devil Detention Center, Quanxi was supposedly recruited into Special Division 7 with the promise of regaining the corpses of her now deceased friends and lovers.

As a Fiend, Tsugihagi can't make contracts and her powers are considerably weaker than those of her devil form. Tsugihagi's abilities are currently unknown, but she still has all the other standard devil abilities.

entries.name: Typhoon Devil
entries.content:
The Typhoon Devil is a devil that embodies the fear of typhoons.

The Typhoon Devil's true form resembles a gigantic humanoid surrounded by a swirling storm of brain matter with the top part of its head exposed revealing more brain matter which is connected to the storm around it. In Asa Mitaka's flashback, his face is that of an old man with a thick mustache.

The second incarnation of the Typhoon Devil has the face of a baby instead of an old man with a thick mustache.

entries.name: Virtue
entries.content:
Virtue is either a Devil or a Fiend who was under Makima's control. They were shown alongside Dominion, Seraphim, and Princi, as well as the corpses of Power, Galgali, Angel, and Beam.

Virtue is a headless humanoid with brownish skin. Their hands and feet all have 2 fingers, resembling tentacles or claws.

entries.name: Zombie Devil
entries.content:
The Zombie Devil is a devil who embodies the fear of zombies. He turned various Yakuza into zombies and attempted to kill Denji.

The Zombie Devil takes the form of a giant floating limbless torso with multiple exposed organs including a brain from which tentacles emerge to connect him to zombies within his horde. A large human-like face emerges from the right side of the devil's torso unconnected to where its head should be. During the fight with Denji, he loses his right Eye and is later cut into two halves.

The Zombie Devil has a greater hatred towards humans, particularly towards devil hunters. Since devil hunters kill his own kind, the Zombie Devil seeks to kill devil hunters in return. He appears to be somewhat cunning, since he managed to trick the Yakuza and turn them into zombies.

entries.name: Yutaro Kurose
entries.content:
Yutaro Kurose was a Public Safety Devil Hunter from Kyoto Division 1.

Kurose is a man with short black hair who tends to wear the standard Public Safety Devil Extermination uniform. He has a horizontal scar across his face which is a feature he shares with Michiko Tendo.

Like Tendo, Kurose is nervous around Makima and insists that he doesn't want to join the special division.

Kurose has a noticeable accent which he tends to tone down around people from Tokyo.

entries.name: Yuko
entries.content:
Yuko is a high school student and member of the Devil Hunter Club alongside Asa Mitaka and Hirofumi Yoshida. She has a contract with the Justice Devil.

Yuko is a high school girl of average height. She is a bit shorter than Asa. She has short hair and wears dark-colored glasses.

The contract with the Justice Devil makes her capable of transforming herself into a thin and gaunt being with an uncovered brain and tentacles instead of legs.

When she's resurrected following her first death at the hands of Asa, Yuko comes back as a gigantic monster with the head of her transformed form surrounded by tentacles. In this form, she's big enough to cover several floors of the school with her body.

After being attacked by Denji, Yuko was, according to her, turned into a Devil. In this form she has the same short blonde hair and humanoid figure that she had previously. Thin tendrils run down her face, but her mouth and nose are still visible; they also cover where her eyes should be, but Yuko still seems able to see. Her arms are replaced by tendrils and tendrils run down to her calf, twisting around her legs like a dress. Yuko wore a hoodie to hide her appearance in this form.

On the surface, Yuko seems to be kind, warmhearted, and sociable. She quickly becomes friends with Asa Mitaka after partnering with her in the Devil Hunter Club, noticing her distress at being shunned by classmates due to Bucky's death. She's very altruistic and friendly, being willing to give out her shoes to Asa so that she wouldn't have to walk home shoeless soon after meeting her, and got upset when Asa gave the shoes back.

Later, it is revealed that underneath her friendly surface lies a deranged personality with a twisted sense of justice. Yuko's extremely cold-blooded and shows no remorse or concern over killing people she deems evil, all while continuing to smile and act warmly. Her warped sense of morality led her to make an illegal contract with the Justice Devil, murdering her neighbor and attempting to "take care of" Asa's bullying problem. She also knows that Yoru has taken over Asa and how they killed the Class President. She knows all this because she can read minds because of her Devil contract. The actual price for her powers is implied to be that some part of her mind, such as her sense of right and wrong or her sense of Justice, is unknowingly getting altered and radicalized by the Justice Devil.

Despite all this, she still believes herself to be best friends with Asa, and wants to fix her problems for her, even if that requires murder.

However, as implied when Yoru asked Yuko regarding the price for her contract with the "Justice Devil", with her supposedly only receiving “a heart that shines with justice", Yuko’s extremely self-righteous behavior regarding her actions and of how she was “just” for murdering the bullies that harassed Asa due to her belief that word of her actions would spread across the nation and dissuade other bullies from bullying others, may be the result of her contract. The actual price for her powers is implied to be that some part of her mind, such as her sense of right and wrong or her sense of Justice, is unknowingly getting altered and radicalized by her devil contract.

Later, Yuko is shown to be remorseful for the people she killed, saying she only wanted to be like the Chainsaw Man and had no true noble intentions. She only befriended Asa because she had no friends already. Despite this howver, Yuko ended up developing a genuine friendship with Asa.

Fire Devil Contract: Yuko has a contract with the Fire Devil, which the girl believed that was the Justice Devil. Although Yuko tells Asa that she did not pay any price, but having only received "a heart that shines with the light of justice", it is later revealed that the price of the contract is her humanity, which turned Yuko into a devil.

Mind Reading: The contract allows Yuko to read minds. She can use this power to discover people's secrets and predict their movements in battle.

Devil Transformation: The contract gave Yuko the ability to transform into an enhanced form. After surviving the battle against Yoru and Chainsaw Man, she was permanently stuck in a halfway form with traits from both her human and transformed forms.

entries.name: Yoru
entries.content:
She is the War Devil who embodies the fear of war. She is a member of the Four Horsemen, who now occupies Asa Mitaka's body as a Fiend.

Following her taking over Mitaka's body, Yoru sets out to locate Chainsaw Man, whom secretly attends the Fourth East High School with them. She also coerces Asa into looking for a target to seduce and turn into a weapon. They choose Denji, however they eventually fail and lose their memories. After a meeting with Fami, she becomes a secret member of the Chainsaw Man Church.

After defeating Pochita and regaining her power through the increased fear of war, Yoru plans on enacting something far more catastrophic than humanity's destruction by the time the Prophecy of Nostradamus becomes a reality.

Near-death State: Following the battle with the Four Horsemen and Weapon Devils, Yoru was also reduced to a “near-death state”, due to Pochita consuming most of her body. In this state, she appears to have a bird-like body, similar to a dark colored owl or potoo with a piercing gaze. While her bird form is similar to Pochita's dog form, her true form is still unknown. The recognizable ringed horseman eyes are also present in this form.

Fiend: After taking over Asa's body and occupying half of her brain, the War Devil took on her appearance, but with added facial scars across her the center of her face and left cheek, which are in the same location where Mitaka's face was slashed by the Class President. When Yoru takes over, her eyes have multiple rings, similar to Makima, who was her sister and another Horseman. Her hair is also usually worn loose rather than in twin tails like Mitaka, and her posture is a little more straightened and confident in comparison to the timid and shy Asa. Yoru always wears the same clothes as Asa, most commonly a school uniform, since they share the same brain and just need to switch control between each other.

Yoru is first shown to be very confident and prideful, treating her opponents as mere warm-ups and confidently vowing to take back nuclear weapons from Chainsaw Man. This might be a sign of her over-confidence as she lost to him previously while at full strength and is significantly weaker now. However she is aware of her limitations and will back down from a fight if she believes the odds are against her. Yoru holds little sentimental value or attachments to humans, and is mostly uncaring of Mitaka's feelings, as evidenced by her blatant disregard for Mitaka's feeling of friendship for Yuko, repeatedly asking Mitaka to kill Yuko to use as a weapon or when she goes as far as to physically hurt Asa herself to forcefully regain control albeit with the intention of saving them both. She's been shown to be very cold and logical which clashes with Asa's highly emotional personality. Since she's completely unaffected by the Falling Devil, that means she easily gets over highly traumatic events such as being almost killed by Pochita and losing her power. Due to her predisposed nature as the War Devil, she keeps getting into conflicts with everyone around her, sometimes intentionally and sometimes not. Ironically these conflicts usually serve to hurt her. Later, Yoru devastates a whole city while using her powers and laughs maniacally when looking at the destruction she caused, reminding Asa that she, at her core, is still a devil.

Unlike her fellow Horsemen Makima and Fami, who are almost always calm and composed, Yoru is more "human" as in flawed, immature and naïve. She is prone to losing her temper, and became embarrassed and angry at being rescued unintentionally by her archenemy, Chainsaw Man. In her anger, she sometimes throws childish tantrums by punching and screaming into the pillows on Asa's bed. She is very insecure and gets royally offended whenever her strength or intellect is questioned. Yoru is also worried about losing her power and being forgotten, showing a more sensitive side. Adding to that, she seems to show signs of sympathy, at least towards Asa. Yoru is able to form emotional attachments to others, such as her "comrades" whom she wants to rescue from Pochita's stomach, and the Gun and Tank Devils whom she considers her children and is hesitant to turn into weapons, even if she eventually does so. She is very content with eating basic foods like plain bread showing she isn't very demanding when it comes to physical pleasures.

She does not have a good understanding of human society or relationships and takes things at face value, is easy to provoke and often threatens Mitaka with death. Though over time she grows closer to her and seems to understand and adapt to human society more, albeit she's still quite inept and will often unintentionally worsen her relationship with Asa because of that. Despite her apparent social-ineptitude she is very cunning in dangerous situations such as when fighting Devils and is easily able to keep a cool head unlike Asa. Though in the most extreme of circumstances Yoru will panic and scream out in fright, such as when Asa was caught by the Falling Devil.

entries.name: Whip Hybrid
entries.content:
Whip Hybrid is a Devil-human Hybrid that merged with the Whip Devil. 


Human Form: The Whip Hybrid is a woman with messy, shoulder-length brown hair with bangs covering her forehead in the colored manga. She wears the coat of her suit like some sort of cape. She has a short stature, being the shortest among the Weapon Humans. Additionally, she also has dark, almost smudged circles under her eyes.

Hybrid Form: When transformed, the Whip Hybrid has her hands transformed into multiple whips. Her head has an elongated chin and sharp, exposed teeth like Chainsaw Man's, she has whips on her nape that simulate hair, and two long, whip-like appendages.

When she was brainwashed and mind-controlled by Makima, the Whip Hybrid's real personality was unknown. According to the Second Popularity Poll, she is rather arrogant and high-handed. This is shown with her blunt response to the Spear Hybrid's proposal of competing for a date with Makima, and cackling when striking Chainsaw Man with her whips. She also thinks of herself as a superior being in comparison to mere humans, believing herself to be chosen by God.

In Part 2, the Whip Hybrid has a lax attitude and is a devoted worshipper of Chainsaw Man, willing to commit mass murder with the other hybrids in order to force Chainsaw Man into appearing. When Miri Sugo has doubts about the plan, she tells him that they are mere weapons and that he should discard all other thoughts. When going through with the plan, she was the least-affected by what they were going to commit.

She also appears to be dimwitted; when asked what humans, weapons, and devils have in common, she tries to think of an answer and says they are all hard to spell. Despite this, she dislikes being mistaken for being a child by the Spear Hybrid, as she's instead proud of the anti-aging affects brought on by the hybrid process, even stating that she's 81 years old.

Contrary to her dim-witted nature, she appears to show signs of having a great understanding other people’s manipulations, such as how she was able to say that dating Makima would just end in disaster under her control, and also that she’s seemingly the only member of the Church-affiliated Hybrids to not believe that the chaos they spread is for a greater purpose, instead committing atrocities for the sheer enjoyment of it.

In spite of her typically unfazed and cocky demeanor, the Whip Hybrid does display emotional vulnerability and some level of care for her teammates; when Denji starts to eat the Spear Hybrid, Whip yells at Denji to spit him out. When Chainsaw Man has her pinned down, she calls for Sugo in her distress and begs him to save her.

Hybrid Transformation: After snapping her fingers to mimic the sound of a whiplash, Whip Hybrid can transform.
Augmented Body: Whip Hybrid has strength, defense, and speed well above average for being a hybrid, being able to match beings like Katana Man and Chainsaw Man.

Whips: Instead of hands, Whip Hybrid's arms end in whips that are used to attack its enemies. Those whips are powerful enough to bisect a human.

Blood Consumption: As a hybrid, Whip Hybrid is able to heal wounds by consuming blood, regenerating her entire body.
Nigh-Immortality: Due to being a hybrid, Whip Hybrid is immortal and nearly unkillable. She can survive getting shredded, decapitated, and take all kinds of injuries that would kill most Devils. Even if she dies, as long as someone activates her trigger, the Whip Hybrid can come back to life in perfect condition.

entries.name: American Thugs
entries.content: A group consisting of Aldo, Joey and their unnamed third brother. They were assassins from the USA, tasked with hunting down Denji’s heart. Due to the incident with the gun devil that killed their parents and their grandmother, they ended up becoming an assassin as their way of living. They seem to be very confident, perceiving themselves as immortals.

entries.name: Anti-Makima Squad
entries.content:
The Anti-Makima Squad was a special squad formed from military officers and devil hunters.

Led by the devil hunter Kishibe, their motive is to eliminate Makima.

entries.name: Quanxi and the Fiends
entries.content: Quanxi and the Fiends was a group that consisted of Quanxi and her harem of four fiends. The fiends being: Long, Pingsti, Tsugihagi and Cosmo.

entries.name: Chainsaw Man Church
entries.content:
The Chainsaw Man Church for World Peace, often referred to simply as the Chainsaw is a cult-like project developed by Fami and Haruka Iseumi alongside an unknown third member, with the stated intention of aiding Chainsaw Man to prevent the upcoming Age of Devils prophesized by Nostradamus and achieving a "world without evil." The group also has a hidden goal of weakening Chainsaw Man to allow him to live a normal life as a human.

Fami is the supposed brain of the group, whilst Haruka's role is solely to attract more people to the cause. The role and identity of the third leader is currently unknown. While Haruka is a member of the three "leaders" he isn't fully aware of the meaning behind their actions. The church also has various members of "The Weapons" among its top brass. Though despite their high positions some of them are disloyal to the church, as they're seen planning to kill other high ranking church members like Asa and plan to lure Chainsaw Man out despite the churchs' goal to stop him from fighting. Asa joined the church under the promise of separating Chainsaw Man from his Devil heart, allowing Yoru to kill the Chainsaw Devil whilst Asa can live with "her" Chainsaw Man, as a compromise between the two. Currently she's a Devil Hunter/Poster Girl for the church and is paid with its donation money.

The church uses a fake Chainsaw Man who pushes a narrative involving Adam and Eve where he wants to achieve a world without Devils, much to the chagrin of Denji. After Asa Mitaka became a member she quickly gained notoriety and many members of the public start attributing Chainsaw Man's past achievements to her instead, further frustrating Denji. Besides this the church also heavily indoctrinates its own members using conspiracy theories about America.

According to Yoshida, whilst the movement was initially founded and composed of diehard supporters and refugees from Devil attacks, its numbers exploded due to its popularity among high school students. The group also accepts donations for their campaigns, both from civilians and politicians. Its numbers were said to exceed 20,000 though the number has likely grown since.

It is revealed that the Church's main building once belonged to another cult and that the organization is run and made up almost entirely of students who are mistrustful towards adults. Every newcomer gets to sleep with a member of the opposite sex, whom they are then forced to marry in the Church's chapel and then raise their children together. The Church is also extremely anti-American, often justifying their most extreme practices by saying they’re subverting American traditions, and spread unhinged conspiracy theories about supposed acts of USA government. Denji briefly considers joining the church, but quickly changes his mind and flees once he's decided they're all insane.

entries.name: Weapon Devils
entries.content:
The Weapon Devils were a group of 7 Devils that previously served under the Four Horsemen, each member embodies the fear of a certain type of weapon. All Weapon Devils are now currently fused with a human.

There isn’t much information about the Weapon Devils before they were fused with their respective human, with very little information provided by Makima. The Weapon Devils once fought alongside the Four Horsemen against Pochita, but at the height of the battle, Pochita vanished and is reduced to a completely changed, near-death state and ended up on Earth.

The Weapon Devils also somehow ended up on Earth, whether it's because they were killed in the battle and reincarnated or not is unknown. They later become fused with different humans all throughout the world, thus creating 7 new hybrids.

entries.name: Four Horsemen
entries.content:
The Four Horsemen is a group of four powerful Devils: the Control Devil, War Devil, Famine Devil and Death Devil.

The Four Horsemen are the only individuals who still remember the names of Devils which have been devoured by the Chainsaw Man, such as the Nuclear Weapons Devil, the Nazi Devil, and others. However, it is unclear how far these memories extend: Makima, one incarnation of the Control Devil, could remember the names of devoured Devils but said that even her memories were starting to fade. The next incarnation, Nayuta, appears to bear no memories from her predecessor’s life but this is not enough evidence to determine if she automatically remembers the names of the erased or not. As revealed by Famine, none of them recognize peoples or devils faces. They all presumably use smell instead like the Control Devil was confirmed to.

Despite collaborating together, the Four Horsemen do not appear to be a cohesive unit, with each member having different goals. Makima, a former member of the Four Horsemen, intended to use Pochita's power to eradicate her fellow Horsemen despite previously battling alongside them against Pochita, whilst the War Devil wants to avoid the Famine Devil and its main goal is to make Pochita throw up the Nuclear Weapons Devil and revive him. Meanwhile, Famine is involved in the apocalypse prophesized by Nostradamus and is currently trying to prevent it from happening and enslave her sister War to aid her in this goal. Nayuta on the other hand doesn't care to involve herself with her sisters and would rather study.

It is also implied that the combined members of the Four Horsemen are almost as powerful, if not on par, with the Primal Fears due to Makima being able to slightly wound the Darkness Devil, albeit at the cost of her arm, and Fami being able to enslave the Falling Devil. However, the Horsemen do not command the same fear and respect as the Primal Fears; the reincarnated Eternity Devil openly cursed and insulted Fami when their deal didn't go according to plan.

entries.name: Four Horsemen Appearance
entries.content:
Though the members of the Four Horsemen vary in individual appearance and can look different upon reincarnation, they are all shown to be female. While the only two known incarnations of the Control Devil have been humanoids the true forms of the rest are unknown or debatable, the War Devil has an unknown true form, with the bird appearance being a near death state, but possesses the body of a teenage girl. The Death Devil has an unknown appearance, but it is implied to also be female.

Each of the Horsemen is shown to have ringed irises of their eyes. Additionally each Horsemen appears to have their own unique eye color.

entries.name: Yakuza
entries.content: The Yakuza is a recurring antagonistic faction. They are a transnational series of organized crime syndicates originating in Japan. A Mafia-like criminal organization, they are known for their strict conduct, organized fiefdom and illegitimate activity. They employ vulnerable individuals to hunt Devils for them, such as with Denji, as a major business venture.

entries.name: Fire Devil
entries.content:
The Fire Devil is a Devil that embodies the fear of fire. They are the unseen overarching antagonist of the Justice Devil arc under the guise of the Justice Devil and as a major antagonist of the entire Academy Saga.

The Fire Devil's true appearance is unknown.

Nothing is known about the Fire Devil's personality, except that their first few contracts tended to be with anyone who sees their actions as "right" and "justifiable" (such as the class president and Yuko) regardless of the actual morality behind their actions.

It is revealed that the Fire Devil is one of the devils Fami has under her control as one of her pawns, essentially all members of the Chainsaw Man Church are or become contracted with the fire devil through a large-scale mass wedding event, at the cost of their humanity.

As a Devil, the Fire Devil possesses all of the standard Devil abilities. These include the ability to make contracts with humans. The contracts with it seen so far are those with the class president, Yuko and the members of the Chainsaw Man Church (including the the Fake Chainsaw Man).

When passed off as the Justice Devil, the Fire Devil, unlike the other Devils, did not seem to ask for any price in exchange for their contract; Yuko tells Asa that the price for her contract is only to receive "a heart that shines with justice". Barem's words, however, imply that the price of the contract is one's humanity, with the contractors effectively being transformed into devils.

As a Devil, the Fire Devil possesses all of the standard Devil abilities. These include the ability to make contracts with humans. The contracts with it seen so far are those with the class president, Yuko and the members of the Chainsaw Man Church (including the the Fake Chainsaw Man).

When passed off as the Justice Devil, the Fire Devil, unlike the other Devils, did not seem to ask for any price in exchange for their contract; Yuko tells Asa that the price for her contract is only to receive "a heart that shines with justice".[6] Barem's words, however, imply that the price of the contract is one's humanity, with the contractors effectively being transformed into devils.

Desire Granting: The Fire Devil's main power is that it can grant others the ability to transform depending on what they desire. As most people who made contracts with it were under the assumption that they were contracting the Justice Devil, many of their powers and forms reflect this. According to Barem, the forms taken by the contractors were initially more hideous and monstrous, but they later adapted and became more similar to Chainsaw Man as the Fire Devil became more powerful through contracts.

1. The contract with the class president, who wished to have a happy ending with her teacher, gave her the power to transform her body into a blob of flesh with multiple heads, large muscular tentacles with claws-like fingers and superhuman strength. While in her transformed state, she is able to move very quickly, being able to attack in just seconds and she was capable to slice though Asa Mitaka's skull and flesh, killing her nearly instantly.
The contract with Yuko, who wished to punish the bullies who persecuted Asa Mitaka, gives her the ability to read others' minds and detect their inner thoughts and feelings. The contract also allows Yuko to transform into a thin and gaunt being with an uncovered brain and tentacles instead of legs. 

2. The contract with a mysterious person, which gives him the ability to transform into a seemingly perfect copy of Chainsaw Man.

3. The contract with one of the Chainsaw Man Church elders gives him a warped figure with two heads, with one protruding on top of the other one. His view of Justice seems to be based on "fighting fire with fire", as well as the consequentialist rhetoric spread across the church.

The contract with numerous members of the Chainsaw Man Church, which allows them to transform into partial copies of Chainsaw Man. It is unknown if they currently possess a full devil form, but they can sprout chainsaws from their heads and arms. Unlike with other contracts, the pseudo chainsaw people lose their mind completely and behave more like zombies, killing and eating people they come across. Similar to Denji, they can regenerate from any injury if someone pulls the starter on their chest, forcing Public Safety to cremate them to fully kill them.

Collective Empowerment: The Fire Devil has the ability to become more powerful based on the number of people who have contracted with it. According to Barem, the number of people who have contracted with the Fire Devil through the Chainsaw Man Church is currently 350,000.

entries.name: Prophecy
entries.content:
The Prophecy of Nostradamus foresees the arrival of the Death Devil on Earth, followed by the extinction of humanity and the takeover for Devils in July 1999. It is the most important foreshadowed event to date.

According to Fami, the War Devil is the only individual possibly capable of stopping or subverting its effects. Though Nayuta considers Chainsaw Man to be equally essential.

The first mention of the prophecy's existence comes from Hirofumi Yoshida, who believes Fami to be involved with it in some way and met her for questioning. He further reveals that Public Safety made 30 convicts make a contract with the Future Devil under the terms of release from custody. The convicts received the knowledge of the dates of their deaths for an unknown price, and it was confirmed that 23 out of the 30 would indeed die in July 1999.

Fami finishes the exposition by revealing that the 7 remaining convicts will die this week and that 40 seconds ago a Primal Fear, the Falling Devil, appeared on Earth and that Devil will be the first of many to cast the world into the abyss of terror.

The aforementioned Devil begins a mass slaughter of Tokyo's population casting countless people into Hell where they'll be devoured while also murdering any Devil Hunter in sight. She chooses the War Horseman, Yoru alongside Asa Mitaka as her next targets and plans to "serve" them as the main dish. However after being "served" they escape Hell with the help of Chainsaw Man and a mysterious benefactor. Because of the harsh terms set by the Falling Devil, other Devils desperately attempt to hunt them down causing severe collateral damage and deaths through the city.

The Falling Devil's presence caused worldwide devastation as the gravity fluctuations occurred all around the globe. The death toll in Tokyo alone was at least 2000. As predicted by Fami, this caused widespread panic about the upcoming apocalypse. The worldwide damage was severe enough to impoverish many nations. Yoru predicts imminent conflict between nations due to this.

Fami is revealed to be somewhat orchestrating some of the events leading up to the prophecy. However, it's revealed that rather than her being complicit with its events, as she believes that they are fated to happen, she instead wants to subvert the prophecy's meaning to ensure humanity's survival, even if her methods cost the lives of numerous innocent people.

It's also revealed that Public Safety have a keen interest in stopping The Prophecy. However, instead of sacrificing human lives to solve the problem, they aim to "evolve" humanity in a way by erasing Devils that represent weaknesses inherent in humanity, such as the problems that stem from aging. As of such, they wish to utilise the Chainsaw Devil's powers in one form or another, whether he consents to it or not.

entries.name: Guillotine Devil
entries.content:
The Guillotine Devil is a Devil that embodies the fear of guillotines. It appears as one of Fami's many pawns that she took under her control.

The Guillotine Devil is reminiscent of a large monstrous pigeon. It features a pair of ears at the base of its beak, and its head maintains a constant right-leaning tilt.

Its body is covered by wings shaped like a cape, revealing its front resembling skeletal structure consisting of a spine, pelvis, and legs. Instead of a rib cage, a large guillotine blade occupies its place. The Guillotine Devil also lacks apparent feet, as its legs bend at the knee and seem to terminate at the Tibia.

In spite of being Fami's pawn, the Guillotine Devil shows an unusual level of independence as it only cuts apart the weapons and clothes of Public Safety members instead of killing them as Fami orders it. When faced with a considerable threat, it retreats and leaves its master to fend for herself. Its intelligence seems to be on the lower spectrum as it can only repeat the phrase "Gyohnee!!" but is intelligent enough to follow its orders (to a limited extent).

entries.name: Devil Detention Centre
entries.content:
The Tokyo Devil Detention Center is a large jail facility for Devils and those who have been affected by Devils located somewhere in Tokyo, Japan. It is the facility where Denji was kept after disobeying Public Safety's orders not to transform into Chainsaw Man.

The Detention Center is an incredibly large military facility. It sports large rectangular panels going across the walls of the building. Near the entrance are sensors that allow the control room to detect intruders that infiltrate the facility. The staff inside the control room can utilize the building's weapons such as gun turrets to kill off any intruders that attempt to enter the building.

Inside the facility contains a series of long hallways and armed guards patrolling the area. Most of the rooms shown are confinement rooms holding its various prisoners captive, such as a group of Pseudo-Chainsaw People or the Devil Hunter Club trio. It is also mentioned by Fami that the room Chainsaw Man is imprisoned in is the third floor of the basement.

entries.name: World
entries.content: The world of Chainsaw Man contains devils, personifications of the fears that humanity feels. The more they are feared, the stronger they are. Devil Hunting is profession in the world.

entries.name: Aging Devil
entries.content:
The Aging Devil is a Devil that embodies the primal fear of aging.

The Aging Devil is a tall devil with a thin and gaunt physique, resembling a withered aggregate of flesh with several holes in it. The largest hole is placed right in the center of its chest, where the heart should be. Its face, which emerges from the split head of an old man with long hair, is a smooth surface with only a mouth, connected by several strings to the two halves of the previous face.

It sits on a throne made of flesh and bones, with human fingers decorating the back and tongues, mouths and teeth protruding from the base which is supported by the backs of two naked men with their hands cut off.

The Aging Devil is shown to be apathetic to any forms of life, both its own and that of others, as described by Fumiko. However, it is shown to possess an amicable relationship with Public Safety, evident by it complimenting Yoshida for subduing Pochita. Its lack of empathy led it to demand the sacrifice of thousands of innocent lives in exchange for being eaten by the Chainsaw Devil. It also seems to be rather lazy, expressing annoyance at the request to "hit" the Chainsaw Devil.

The Aging Devil appears to have some knowledge regarding how Denji defeated Makima, as they tease Pochita by calling the act “romantic” when they offer themselves to be devoured in a similar way.

Once Pochita erases the Ear Devil from existence, Public Safety decides to use their contract with the Aging Devil to temporarily subdue him. The Aging Devil receives Public Safety's message within the depths of Hell, proceeding to slam their fist near a projected mirror to strike Pochita with a large fist. This attack is only temporarily effective as Pochita easily breaks free, slicing off two of the Aging Devil's fingers. Hirofumi Yoshida follows up by using the Octopus Devil to forcibly make Pochita puke out the Ear Devil's head, restoring everyone's ears back to normal.

It is later revealed by Fumiko Mifune that the Aging Devil possesses no attachment to life, and has made an offer to Public Safety. In exchange for being devoured and erased by Pochita, the Aging Devil wants Public Safety to kill 10,000 children with Japanese citizenship, between infancy and nine years old, in front of mirrors. The Aging Devil attempts to strike Pochita once again with two colossal hands alongside Yoru and Katana Man but are swiftly overpowered in the process. In the aftermath of the failed attack, the Aging Devil is revealed to have lost both of its hands.

After Yoru unleashes a devastating attack that fatally damages Pochita, the Aging Devil reveals itself to the wounded Chainsaw Devil. From there, it offers Pochita some of its blood and asks him to eat its entire body from top to bottom. The Primal Fear reveals that the more Pochita consumes portions of its body, the more children will die as a part of its contract with Public Safety. Deeming it as an romantic act, the Aging Devil prepares to initiate its contract while watching the Japanese government preparing to execute children from one of its mirrors.

Pochita refuses to go with this offer and tries to flee, but is held down by the Primal Fear. The Aging Devil holds Pochita by the head, mocking the devil by asking him if his head is empty. After Yoru launches a bullet at the Aging Devil for stealing her show, the latter stops the finger bullet and causes it to wither away into dust via physical contact. The Primal Fear is disappointed that Yoru believed such an attack could actually kill them. The Aging Devil then deems that neither Pochita or Yoru are mature enough to talk to them, meaning it's time to have them "grow up". With that being said, the Aging Devil transports Yoru, Asa, and Denji into a world where nobody can age or die.

The Aging Devil appears before Denji through one of its trees and offers a way out by convincing Pochita to eat them. It explains its desire to be eaten by the Chainsaw Devil at the cost of the lives of children. Denji tells the Aging Devil that they're evil and that they should've considered the idea that Pochita doesn't want to kill innocent children just to save himself. The Primal Fear then mocks Denji for moving on from Nayuta's death so quickly, and questions him on what exactly he plans to do for escaping this realm. It is revealed that the Aging Devil is now in direct contact with Public Safety, ready to battle the Chainsaw Devil once he regenerates.

It offers an contract to a group of Public Safety agents to utilize their bodies as weapons against Pochita in exchange for being saved from his attacks. Once they agree, the Aging Devil proceeds to sacrifice every organ it can use from the agents to cleave an incoming Pochita to shreds. However, Pochita continues regenerating due to Denji's continuous feasting of human organs while pulling his cord. Much to its shock, the Aging Devil expresses disbelief that Pochita can still move regardless of any attack thrown at him. Pochita eventually resorts to extracting his heart and hurling it at Public Safety's location.

Once Pochita regenerates from his heart, he begins attacking the Aging Devil. Each time the Primal Fear is struck down by Pochita's chainsaws, it continues to regenerate due to its immortality. Even when attempting to immobilize Pochita by transforming him into a tree through rapid aging, the Aging Devil is unable to keep him down. Unamused by his efforts to keep fighting, the Aging Devil bluntly tells Pochita to just eat them already, believing he has no other means of killing them.

However, the Aging Devil doesn't anticipate those trapped in its realm trying to force their way back to the real world. Sticking his arm in Denji's mouth, Yoshida uses one of the Octopus Devil's tentacles to latch onto a pillar, only for the limb to be severed by the Aging Devil. Yoru follows up by attempting to gun down the Primal Fear with the Right Gun Gauntlet. She forces the upper half of her body through Denji's mouth but is rapidly aged by her opponent, causing the War Devil to back down. While this happens, Pochita continues hacking down the Aging Devil, who notes the futility of this battle. It then notices Fumiko betraying them by offering Yoshida her heart to the Octopus Devil, which allows him to command it to swallow the Aging Devil whole.

Before it can react any further, one of its victims traps the Aging Devil within its realm by dragging it through Pochita's mouth. Noting that since they're still alive, Yoshida realizes that the Aging Devil cannot utilize its powers within its world. The group then confronts the Aging Devil, with Yoshida negotiating a deal where it returns the trapped humans to their respective worlds. The Aging Devil questions what will happen if they refuse, to which Denji reveals that since everyone can leave through his mouth but him, that means they'll be trapped with him for eternity. Realizing the inevitable, the Aging Devil accepts defeat and sends everyone back to the real world.

entries.name: Ear Devil
entries.content:
The Ear Devil  is a Devil that embodies the fear of ears, and a Public Safety Devil Hunter from Tokyo Special Division 5.

The Ear Devil resembles a muscular humanoid figure with twisted smooth flesh and a large gaping mouth with a small tear near his lips. His most notable feature are two oversized ears on the upper portions of his head. He also wears dark-colored pants and shoes, and is usually seen slumping forward.

Not much can be currently inferred about the Ear Devil's personality as he was only shown following orders under Public Safety.

As a Devil, the Ear Devil possesses all of the standard Devil abilities. His initial powers are currently unknown as he wasn't able to utilize them due to Pochita swiftly attacking him and his teammates from behind.

The Ear Devil is summoned by Public Safety as a member of the newly-reformed Special Division 5 to subdue Chainsaw Man alongside his teammates. The group is given orders by their superior, and head out to confront Pochita. However, none of them realize that their target is literally standing right behind them.

Before each member can react in time, Pochita blitzes past Special Division 5 and shreds them to pieces. Once Pochita finishes defeating Special Divisions 5 and 6, he proceeds to consume the decapitated head of the Ear Devil, erasing him from existence. The erasure of the Ear Devil also causes everyone's ears to vanish in the process, rendering them all deaf.

This was only temporary as Public Safety uses the Aging Devil and Hirofumi Yoshida's Octopus Devil to forcibly make Pochita vomit out the Ear Devil's head, restoring everyone's ears back to normal.

entries.name: Mouth Devil
entries.content:
The Mouth Devil is a devil that embodies the fear of mouths.

The Mouth Devil possesses an appearance that is similar to that of an octopus and its head resembles a humanoid's with two misplaced eyes and multiple rows of teeth. It also has tentacle-like tongues with teeth arranged like suckers on the tentacles.

When Yoru forces the Chainsaw Devil to spit out the Mouth Devil's head, it is revealed to have two white eyes and a mouth with two mouths inside of each other, as well as another mouth on top of it.

The Mouth Devil's personality is currently unknown.

As a Devil, the Mouth Devil possesses all of the standard devil abilities which includes bestowing contracts upon humans for a price.

At some point after breaking free from Public Safety's trap, Pochita proceeds to erase more Devils by consuming them as he continues to rampage through the city, including the Mouth Devil.[1] As a result, everyone's mouths across the world are erased. This also temporarily prevents Public Safety from enacting their plan to sacrifice 10,000 children with Japanese citizenship, between infancy and nine years old, in front of mirrors for the Aging Devil.

After regaining usage of her arms via the Tank and Gun Devils transforming into weapons for her, Yoru shoots Pochita with the Right Gun Gauntlet. Yoru's attack creates a large tear through Pochita's body, releasing the Mouth Devil's severed head and restoring the concept of mouths.

entries.name: Tank Devil
entries.content:
The Tank Devil is a Devil that embodies the fear of tanks.

The Tank Devil's appearance is currently unknown.

When transformed by Yoru into one of her weapons, it takes the form of a completely black left arm, which replaces the one the girl previously lost. This arm is covered by a stretchy dark lace glove.

The Tank Devil's personality is currently unknown.

When Yoru is nearly defeated by Pochita, she remembers the other reason why she wanted to defeat the Chainsaw Devil. She then telepathically communicates with both the Gun Devil and the Tank Devil to help her. The Tank Devil escapes from the Devil Containment Facility in the Gulf of Mexico. Together with the Gun Devil, the two arrive on the battlefield and quickly transform into weapons for Yoru, with the Tank Devil becoming Yoru's Left Tank Gauntlet.

As a Devil, the Tank Devil possesses all of the standard devil abilities which includes bestowing contracts upon humans for a price. Although its power and abilities are unknown, it still boasts enormous firepower, having been able to break through the blast door it was locked behind with a single blow.

entries.name: Gun Devil History
entries.content:
Thirteen years prior to the events of the Public Safety Saga, the whole world tried to cash in on guns as a countermeasure against devils. This led to an increase in gun use during crimes and civil revolts. Due to heavy media coverage of gun crimes in every country, worldwide fear of guns has increased drastically.

On November 18th, a large terrorist attack involving guns occurred in America, causing that to be the day that the Gun Devil first appeared. The Gun Devil hit Japan for 26 seconds, killing 57,912 people. Aki Hayakawa witnessed the Gun Devil destroying his house and killing his family as it passed by. It hit several countries around the world in succession eventually leading a death toll of 1.2 million lives in only five minutes. Aldo, Joey, and their brother survived the Gun Devil's attack but lost their home along with their father, mother and grandmother. This would be one of the events in their lives that would lead them to believe that they're immortal.

After that, the Gun Devil disappeared but its impact on human society led to an overall increase in fear of all Devils. An international law has been prepared to strictly control the manufacturing of arms in every country to lower the fear of guns.

At some point in time, the Gun Devil has been taken down by someone unknown and he was found by the Soviet Union while he was in an unconscious state. His body is separated into several pieces and held by countries and devils. Specifically, 20% of his body is owned by the United States, 28% is owned by the Soviet Union, 11% is owned by China, 4% is owned by other nations and the remaining 37% is in the form of pieces of meat in the hands of devils scattered around the world.

entries.name: Yoru's Abilities
entries.content:
As a Fiend, Yoru can not make contracts. However, she still has all the other standard Devil abilities, such as reviving in Hell after being killed, restoring her health by consuming blood, fear empowerment and enhanced physical prowess. Despite being rather weak at the start, Yoru has the potential to become one of the strongest Horsemen, even strong enough to prevent the upcoming apocalypse.

Currently, Yoru has taken possession of Asa Mitaka's body, after her head got sliced in half by the Class President. The War Devil, however, only took over half of her brain, leaving Mitaka’s consciousness intact while still being able to take control over Mitaka’s body anytime she wants to unless Asa is stricken with fear.  Adding to that if Yoru is already in control but Asa get's frightened she'll lose control and be unable to regain it until Asa calms down.

Thanks to this unusual circumstance Yoru is able to feel human emotions despite being a Devil. Whoever isn’t in control of the body will appear as a hallucination to the other and can even communicate to them. In addition Yoru is able to read Mitaka’s thoughts and access her memories while the latter is unable to do the same.

Although part of the Four Horsemen, Yoru claims that her Devil power weakened after her body was partially devoured by Chainsaw Man. This, combined with the long absence of wars in the human world (the concept of which is only been relegated to movies and videogames), has greatly diminished her original strength. Adding to that her strength was reduced even further by becoming a Fiend.

Combining all of these factors her current strength is a mere fraction of her full power and is by far the weakest horsemen.
During the events of Chainsaw Man Church arc, Yoru experienced a significant power boost due to the fear of war rapidly rising.

Enhanced Speed: Yoru is able to move very quickly, easily jumping around and dodging attacks from the contracted Class President and Yuko's Devil form. As the public starts to fear war again, Yoru's speed exceeds the infamous speed of Quanxi; she moves so fast that Yoshida, who was able to keep up with Quanxi, has a delayed reaction.

Enhanced Strength: Yoru was able to pull Tanaka's head off his shoulders and spinal cord out of his body, requiring a great deal of force, and is able to easily carry objects as big as herself with one arm over her head. Her strength significantly increased after she experienced a tremendous power boost from the increasing fear of war.

Enhanced Durability: Yoru is able to take hits that would kill an ordinary person, such as during her battle with Yuko she took a serious hit that flung her across a classroom and into a wall, but was able to get up moments later without any injuries. Later, Yoru's durability increases even further; Yoshida's sword, which was previously able to cut off her arm, could only make a minor skin-deep cut.

Weapon Creation
Yoru has the power to transform anything she owns into a weapon, whether it be an object or a living being. Initially, to activate the weapon transformation, Yoru had to touch what belongs to her and say the name of the weapon, but as her power increased, she and Asa became able to create a weapon without even touching the related object and telekinetically summon them regardless of distance without even calling their names verbally. The strength of the weapon is proportional to the amount of guilt Yoru and/or Asa feel in creating said weapon. There is no objective measure of when something belongs to Asa or Yoru, but the greater the guilt (such as Yoru's familial attachment to the Gun Devil and the Tank Devil), the more powerful the weapon will be.

So far the only types of weapons that were created have been either melee weapons, such as swords and spears, or explosives such as hand grenades. It is unknown whether Yoru can create more advanced weapons such as modern firearms.

Flesh Weapon Creation: Yoru is able to make anyone she "owns", including humans, Devils and Fiends, into a variety of deadly weapons almost instantaneously simply by touching them. This does not appear to immediately kill the human, as they can still scream in agony. In order to make a flesh weapon, Yoru must either: take a limb from the victim which she can then turn into a weapon, kill them and turn their remains into weapons, or form a relationship with someone wherein they "belong to her". She can also make weapons from her own body parts which will violently tear themselves off her if she does so. Flesh weapons created by the War Devil so far are:

Tanaka Spinal Cord Sword: A long crooked sword that the War Devil created using Tanaka's head and spinal cord that is ripped out of his body. The blade is sharp enough to easily cut through Devil-enhanced flesh with ease.

Flesh Hand Grenade: A hand grenade that the War Devil created using the arm from the contracted Class President. And it is shown that it is able to detonate like a normal grenade.

Yuko Leg Sword: A katana-like blade made from one of Yuko's legs that were severed by the Devil Hunter Club, it presumably lacked unique abilities due to Yoru's lack of guilt, but it never managed to be used.

Left Tank Gauntlet: A tank-themed arm gauntlet formed from the Tank Devil after it arrived to help Yoru fight back against the rampaging Chainsaw Devil. Yoru is capable of firing off bullets using the gauntlet.

Right Gun Gauntlet: A gun-themed arm gauntlet formed from the Gun Devil during Yoru's rematch against the rampaging Chainsaw Devil. Like with the Left Tank Gauntlet, Yoru can fire bullets that are strong enough to pierce through the Chainsaw Devil's body and tear off some of his arms.

Object Weapon Creation: Yoru has shown the ability to turn objects that belong to her into weapons. Objects that belong to her can either be things she bought or things she took. Weapons created by the War Devil so far are:

Pencil Spear: A wooden spear made from a school pencil. This weapon changes form with each pencil, some are three-pronged spears approximately two meters long, others a meter long spear with four smaller spikes along the side. This weapon is sharp enough to easily kill a human, although Yoru calls them weak weapons.

Ruler Sword: A sword made by a measuring ruler found in Asa's backpack. It is a rectangular shaped sword approximately one meter long with a hole at its base for a handle.

Scalpel Sword: A sword made from a nearby scalpel Yoru uses when she battled Quanxi. It is a curve-shaped sword resembling a larger scalpel.

Soap Sword: A soap-themed sword made from a soap bar. Yoru formed this weapon by bringing a soap bar towards her telekinetically.

Straw Knife: A knife made from a discarded straw that Yoru attempted to use to slice off Denji's penis. It resembles a switchblade, although in some panels it resembles that of a combat knife.

Sushi Sword: A sushi-themed sword made from a sushi dish. Yoru used this blade in an attempt to strike Pochita from above when confronting him alongside Katana Man but it proved useless against the might of the Chainsaw Devil.

Contract Trigger: When Yoru turns a Devil she "owned" into a weapon, she can enter into and activate any contract associated with that Devil and use them for herself. Yoru demonstrated this by activating the contract the National Pistol Association of America has with the Gun Devil and using it to activate an ability.

Gun Goddess: After sacrificing the index fingers of approximately 40,000 of the National Pistol Association of America's 3.5 million members, Yoru transforms the Statue of Liberty into a grotesque crowned creature holding a rifle capable of firing giant bullets in the shape of severed fingers. This creature was able to destroy buildings and severely damage the Chainsaw Devil at Yoru's command (presumably killing hundreds of lives with the bullet fired across the world), but not enough to affect a devil equal to a Primal Fear.

Swordsmanship: Yoru is a skilled swordswoman, being able to easily take down the contracted Class President with her sword.

Spearmanship: Yoru also demonstrates her skills on using a spear during her fight against the reincarnated Eternity Devil.
Strategic Intelligence: Yoru prepared quite an elaborate setup in preparation for fighting Yuko, such as setting up traps and hiding weapons all around the school. This however wasn't of much use due to contracted Yuko's mind reading ability.

entries.name: Yoru and Asa
entries.content:
Yoru resurrected and inhabits Asa's body, turning her into the War Fiend, but left half of Asa's brain intact, keeping Asa alive as the Devil was not familiar with the ways of the human world and needed her help to find and defeat Chainsaw Man without her cover getting blown and needed Asa's help to do so. Despite this, Asa isn't thankful to Yoru for saving her life, unlike her reaction to being saved by Chainsaw Man, whom she does feel thankful towards. With the two now sharing one body, Asa was initially overwhelmed with her situation and needed time to accept reality; but she eventually agrees to help Yoru defeat Chainsaw Man under threat of permanent death and so long as she gets her body back after they defeat Chainsaw Man.

Because of Yoru's personality, Asa often gets put in awkward social situations, like asking Yoshida to be her boyfriend in an attempt to make him into a weapon or getting caught kissing Denji by Nayuta. Because of her more passive and talk-oriented approach to conflicts, Asa commonly clashes with Yoru's methods regarding the problems they face. She also wonders if she can "tame" Yoru. In casual situations, Asa shows little to no fear toward Yoru and isn't afraid to talk back or defy Yoru if she demands something she isn't willing to do. However, she does get overwhelmed by Yoru's cold and cruel methods she uses during life threatening situations.

Asa grows used to talking with her devilish companion as seen when she instinctively tries chatting with her during the aquarium date after being separated. However, despite growing used to Yoru's presence, she's still not fully comfortable with her. She can get easily scared by Yoru due to her deeply mistrusting her. In an outburst she says she has no reason to trust her to as they barely know each other, how Yoru always says disturbing stuff, takes over her body whenever and cut her hand moments before. Yoru has made it clear to Asa that she only cares about her own objective and will kill her if she becomes troublesome. Yoru has also never claimed that she cares about Asa or wants what's best for her. Likewise, Asa has little care for Yoru, though she briefly contemplates her choice upon seeing Yoru's terrified expression, she ultimately ignores her and decides to go forward with her suicide attempt even though she'll kill Yoru alongside her.

Asa easily gets frightened and emotional which frustrates Yoru as it often puts both of them at the risk of imminent death. Either due to Yoru's lack of humanity or a misunderstanding of Asa's character, she continues trying to convince Asa using cold and logical arguments despite the latter being emotionally distressed. Ignoring Yoru's unsupportive comments, she grows frustrated that Yoru doesn't understand her feelings despite being able to read her mind and continues to break down in front of her. In her rant, Asa mentions being afraid of companionship which could mean her current state is due to her being scared of getting closer to Yoru aside from simple mistrust.

When Asa falls for Chainsaw Man after he saves her from the Falling Devil, Yoru is more frustrated that Asa had to fall for none other than her own arch nemesis and yells at her to stop making love poems. When Asa becomes a Devil Hunter, the two act rather cordially with each other as more like partners, with Yoru even sometimes praising Asa's skill in making powerful weapons.

By the time they escape from the Public Safety facility, Asa and Yoru start getting way more influenced by each other's emotions, particularly Yoru. After Yoru, under the influence of Asa's emotion’s, kisses Denji a second time and gives him a handjob, Asa fights her by punching Yoru, with their following exchange being more reminiscent of an internal monologue or a single mind in conflict with itself. Whilst this incident creates a spark of doubt within Asa, she fully realises how horrible and destructive a devil Yoru is upon seeing her gleeful laughter the destruction wrought by the Statue of Liberty weapon attack and is further shocked when Yoru did not seem to particularly mind sacrificing the Gun and Tank Devils, who are considered her children, to be their new arm gauntlets to help defeat Chainsaw Man, saying children are property of their parents. In Aging's World, they once again try to work together to escape but realize Yoru is no match for a Primal Devil. When Asa tries to comfort a dejected Denji about the loss of his family by talking about her own personal losses, Yoru takes over and gives horrible advice, which once again leads to Asa punching her to shut her up. When Denji asks her how she regrew her arms and what is truly going on with her, Yoru finally reveals herself as "Asa's other personality". Yoru also dismissively says that Asa is on the verge of a mental breakdown from all the death and destruction she caused, and still kills more people left and right as she and Denji run away from a mob of Chainsaw Man protestors.

Despite the awkward situations they find themselves, arising from the clash between their opposite attitudes, and the emotional manipulation on Yoru's end, Yoru is the closest thing Asa has to a friend.

entries.name: Yoru and Denji
entries.content:
Yoru and Asa decided Denji would be their target to be turned into a weapon. Despite not getting involved directly Yoru will push Asa to continue her date with him even if things don't go her way.[13] She views him as a punk and is annoyed at her feelings of affection for him due to sharing Asa's brain. However her feelings for him were initially very shallow as she immediately tries using these feelings to turn him into a weapon, albeit unsuccessfully.

Later during his movie date with Asa, she tries to push him away presumably to keep him safe from Yoru. In response she takes over and kisses Denji likely in hopes of quickly winning his heart which would allow her to finally turn him into a weapon, but she is swiftly incapacitated by Nayuta instead. After kissing him, she could be seen visibly blushing. After their memories have been wiped and altered she assumes Denji stood them up but is indifferent to it and swiftly suggests they target a different boy instead. This is in stark contrast with Asa's reaction who was deeply hurt. This love-hate relationship with Denji continued, with the most evident being Yoru pleasuring him in the alleyway after she regained her memories of the kiss.

Although it eluded her for a while, Denji is her fabled arch-nemesis Chainsaw Man, who she hopes to defeat in order to regain Nuclear Weapons and get revenge. She despises him for defeating and weakening her which caused wars to cease and in turn reduced her to a shadow of her former self. Furthermore, due to their prior encounter, the fear of war became so minute that she was afraid that she'd fade out of existence. She hates him to the point where she had a meltdown after she's unintentionally saved by him from the Bat Devil. To her dismay the situation repeats itself as they are saved by him once more during the Falling Devil fight, after which Asa falls in love with Chainsaw Man, much to Yoru's protests.

Her desire to defeat the Chainsaw Devil, however, has unfortunately consumed her; even though she acknowledges that transforming the Gun and Tank Devils - two devils that she considers to be her own children - into weapons would completely invalidate her goals of freeing her comrades, she does so just so she can have the chance of defeating her nemesis and prove that she is better.

When trapped in the Aging Devil's world, Yoru once again tearfully kisses Denji who himself is crying. When he pushes her off and asks her why she did that, she coyly replies she finds him "cute" when he cries. Upon escaping the Aging Devil's world, Denji asks Asa how she got her arms back and what's going on with her, Yoru finally reveals the truth, calling herself "Asa's other personality". Yoru and Denji run off to a restaurant, where she kills the owner much to Denji's protests, saying she wants to cook for him.

When Denji asks her if she likes him, Yoru says Asa likes him and since they share a brain she does too, and offers to have sex with him but gives him an ultimatum: she'll have sex with him only if he can defeat the Death Devil, or else she will turn him into a weapon and do it herself.

entries.name: Yoru and Fami
entries.content:
Fami, who views Yoru as her "little sister", claims to be willing to do anything to help her often without Yoru's own consent such as when she trapped Asa and Denji in the aquarium. Despite her apparent affection for her, Yoru doesn't reciprocate those feelings, as she describes her as insane and wants to stay away from her. Fami's contradictory behavior described below could be the reason why Yoru called her insane.

Despite her apparent care for Yoru, she contradictorily doesn't seem to care about her safety and often puts her in harm's way, such as when she got her under attack by the Eternity Devil or later when she sent the Falling Devil after her. As it turns out, Fami’s main goal is to starve Yoru so that she may brainwash and use her to stop the Nostradamus Prophecy.

entries.name: Asa and Denji
entries.content:
After Hirofumi Yoshida introduces Asa to Denji, there is immediate friction between them due to their conflicting attitudes, and when Denji reveals himself to be Chainsaw Man, she doubts him and calls him a loser. The next time they meet, Denji is aggressive toward her, but still accepts her offer to take him out on a date.

On that date, she barrages Denji with talk of sea anemones, believing lecturing him for long periods of time will make their date interesting and make him fall in love with her. However, due to her lack of dating experience and social skills with boys, Denji found her extremely boring. Asa also unintentionally triggered his trauma by telling him he doesn't have to think about anything, which was something Makima would say.

Denji and Asa's relationship begins to improve after days of being trapped in the aquarium. Denji finds Asa sitting alone and asks how she is doing, to which she apologizes to him for the situation they are in and blames herself for asking him on a date in the first place. Denji tries to cheer her up by smiling and trying to find her something to eat, asking if she's ever had starfish before, which also implies that he was paying attention to her during her exposition on sea life. They further bond after Denji says he thinks Asa is fun to watch. This cheers up Asa as she enthusiastically affirms Denji's assessment of her character. Amused, Denji says that her enthusiastic and self-aggrandizing attitude reminds him of an old friend, implying that friend to be Power.

After the two leave the aquarium, Denji admits to her that he actually enjoyed their disastrous first date and asks her to go on a second one together, to which Asa agrees. Yoru then comments that Asa is currently experiencing feelings of love for Denji, much to her shock and embarrassment. After Yoru fails to turn Denji into a weapon, Asa's feelings towards Denji become more complicated as she gets angry after believing he does not like her. On their next date, the two agree to watch a movie at Denji's home. When Denji brings up the topic of kissing, a flustered Asa says she has no desire to kiss him and hates him. She then tries to push him away by saying that she only went on a date to have a distraction and that if they keep dating, he'll wind up dead. Though this was most likely out of care for him as she doesn't want Yoru to turn him into a weapon.

Due to interference from Nayuta, Asa and Yoru lose all memories of the second date and believe Denji stood Asa up. Initially claiming to be unaffected by this, Asa begins to ramble before admitting that she does care, feeling down. After Asa falls into utter despair due to the Falling Devil, she attempts suicide. Though she doesn't realize his identity, Denji saves her once again and comforts her. She begins to see a different side of Chainsaw Man after learning he understands some of her pain. However, that is quickly undone when Denji goes on a rant about how much he wants to have sex, which grosses Asa out as she reveals she finds sex disgusting. She offends Denji by saying no woman would want to have sex with someone who has a chainsaw for a head, a statement which utterly demoralizes Denji and causes both of them to fall into Hell.

However, when she and the weakened Chainsaw Man escaped from Hell, she hesitates to finish him off despite knowing that it would mean her freedom. Instead, she cuts her hand and uses her blood to rejuvenate Denji. Asa explains to Yoru that Chainsaw Man had saved her twice so far, and that if someone like him could keep living, then it would be ok for her to live as well. She yells for Chainsaw Man to save her and pulls his rip-chord. This demonstrates how Chainsaw Man had begun to have a profound impact on her, and in spite of disagreeing with his dreams, she still admires his resolve and appreciates what he's done for her.

After the incident with the Falling Devil, Asa began reflecting on her time spent with Chainsaw Man. She deduced that the man posing as Chainsaw Man on television was a fraud since she understood the real Chainsaw Man's motives. His words of encouragement and the several times he saved her life would ultimately cause Asa to become infatuated with him. She would have flashbacks of the times she rescued him, and even thought up a poem expressing her love for Chainsaw Man. This newfound affection for him is also shown when she agrees to Fami's plan of eliminating devils to weaken Chainsaw Man's heart and allow him to live a regular life. Unfortunately, her devotion to "saving" Denji is shown to continuously hurt him in both direct and indirect ways. The former can be seen with how she allows Yoru to attack Pochita, as she believes it'll free Denji of his responsibilities, whilst the latter is shown with how her offers of returning Denji's life to "normal" upsets him, with Denji realizing she's been brainwashed by the Church.

When Denji asks Yoru if she likes him, Yoru says since Asa likes him, she does too, which causes him to be emotional that there is still someone who likes him.

entries.name: Control Devil Powers
entries.content:
Makima is one of the strongest individuals in the world of Chainsaw Man thanks to her physical and supernatural abilities as a Devil, along with her cunning and manipulative personality. She is feared by humans, Fiends and Devils all around the world, which increases her powers as a Devil. According to the President of the United States, other countries besides America have already given up trying to fight her.

As a Devil, Makima possesses all of the standard Devil abilities. These include the ability to make contracts with humans. Thanks to her ability to control humans, she is also able to force them to make a contract with herself. Makima made a contract with the Prime Minister of Japan in return for working for the Japanese government. As a result of this contract, any fatal attacks inflicted to Makima are transferred into an appropriate illness or ailment affecting a random citizen of Japan. She was shown to have been shot in the back of the head and seemingly killed, only to stand up later with no visible wounds. She stated that she was merely grazed by the bullet, but this is unlikely given the placement of the gun when it was fired, as well as the location of the blood from the exit wound. Later, she was killed by the Gun Devil after it fired a bullet through her head, though it did not finish her off. It is confirmed that she had been killed twenty-six times up until the attack of the Gun Devil. Later on, she gets killed by Pochita several times during their final confrontation.

However, Denji found a way to bypass the conditions of her contract with the Prime Minister of Japan by killing her in order to end her misery, which he viewed as a form of love rather than an attack. After being eaten by him, she returned to Hell and subsequently reincarnated in China as Nayuta due to the revival ability of Devils.

Immense Strength: Makima possesses a great deal of physical strength allowing her to fight effectively in hand-to-hand combat without relying on any of her subordinates. Her strength was great enough to overwhelm Pochita's weakened form and shatter his chainsaws with her strikes.

Enhanced Smell: According to Denji, Makima primarily differentiates others through smell. In their first encounter, she was able to detect that Pochita still existed within Denji through his scent. However, she cannot differentiate between humans through sight, similar to how humans cannot differentiate between dogs by their faces.

Besides her Machiavellian tendencies, Makima holds the power to directly control her inferiors, stating as follows: "I have the power to control those I consider to be of lesser rank than myself.". This "brainwashing" ability works on any being — from humans to animals, to Devils, to Fiends, to Hybrids, and she was not shown to have a limit to the number of subjects she can keep under control at once. It seems as though once placed under her control, a victim subsequently loses their memory of anything that happened immediately before they put under control, and of anything they did while being controlled.

Makima can channel the power of her victims by summoning them through chains connected to her body. It has been shown that she can use the abilities of the Angel Devil, Future Devil, Snake Devil, Punishment Devil, Spider Devil, and Zombie Devil. Even deceased individuals can be controlled in this manner. Makima was able to form a squad of weapon Hybrids, three of which (Reze, Quanxi, and Katana Man) were former enemies who now behaved affectionately towards her. This suggests that Makima can control individuals outright as well as warp their personalities in subtle ways. Makima's control can be broken however, as seen with Angel Devil.

She borrows the hearing of rats, birds and other small animals she controls to hear conversations remotely, seemingly anywhere on the planet and possibly extending into Hell itself. She was able to spy on Denji and Reze's conversation and was listening in on Kishibe's conversation with Quanxi. This ability can be circumvented by communicating nonverbally such as writing on a piece of paper.

She has been shown to control a large number of rats which allow her to travel around using them. These rats can then cluster together to form the shape of a human and thus allow for Makima to be transported to that location instantly. Makima is also able to summoned through Princi's zipper, which can move her from Earth to hell or wherever the Spider Devil happens to be.

She has demonstrated the ability to make others hear her voice by placing her hand on their head even if the person is dead. She uses this to command the Devils that the person is currently contracted with.

Force Manipulation: Makima has been shown to offensively manipulate an invisible force in a variety of way similar to Darkness Devil. This force can be used to damage her weak targets internally by simply staring at them. Depending on the situation, she can use this power in other various way such as:

She has shown to cause her target to be crushed by an invisible force from over long distances. In order to use this technique, Makima appears to require a high altitude place such as a shrine, the name of a target and a human sacrifice. Makima forms a symbol with her hands and instructs the sacrifice to utter the name of the target. The sacrifice then dies and target is subsequently crushed, preceded by a brief sense of "wrongness". This attack completely destroys the target's body but causes no damage to adjacent people or objects, even the target's clothes. While using this ability, sacrifices and witnesses are blindfolded. She used this ability once from Kyoto to kill the goons of Sawatari's gang.

She has been shown to inflict damage by projecting an invisible force to targets she points at with her index finger which is strong enough to heavily damage Darkness Devil, who is a Primal Devil, kill Power instantly and send an empowered Chainsaw Man high into the atmosphere when she used it repetitively against him. She usually says "Bang!" while using this ability.

She has been shown to remove the heads of her targets in the vicinity from a short-to-mid range by using a sword; similar to her ability to crush her targets remotely, the people around her close their eyes with a black cloth.

High Alcohol Tolerance: Makima has an exceedingly high tolerance for drinking alcohol; able to out-drink both Aki Hayakawa and Himeno without showing any signs of being debilitated by the vast quantities of liquor/ethanol. However, due to her contract with the Japanese Prime Minister, it is likely that any damage her excessive drinking would have caused was redirected to a random Japanese citizen.

Hand-to-Hand Combat: Makima is very a proficient combatant, despite not usually being seen fighting. She was capable of defeating a weakened Pochita by herself and only using her fighting skills, she even managed to rip Pochita's heart from his body by restraining him after she defeated him.

High Intelligence: Makima has shown to be a highly intelligent individual. Even without using her Devil powers, she is very cunning and manipulative. A fine example is the way she controls Denji throughout most of Part 1's story. Makima knows what exactly to say, move and how to react in order to make Denji her pet. Being aware of Denji's desires, she often interferes by making him feel that he is a person, and behind the scenes, she is pulling the strings in order to achieve her goal. Just like she helps him feel love and happiness, she also attacks and makes her move to destroy his personal relationships in order to make him feel desperate and guilty over the losses he suffers.

entries.name: Denji's Abilities
entries.content:
Enhanced Human Condition: Due to fusing with Pochita, Denji gained superhuman abilities even when not transformed.
