In his human form, Denji is durable enough to survive being hit by Power with a hammer and getting squeezed by the Bat Devil, despite both individuals possessing immense strength. He is also very strong, capable of decapitating a Fiend with just one swing of his Axe.

Enhanced Endurance: Due to his rough childhood, Denji has developed a high tolerance for pain and stress, being able to still function as a Devil Hunter for the Yakuza despite having multiple of his organs missing at the time. His mental fortitude has allowed him to fight for three days straight while constantly being injured and remaining conscious even after having multiple parts of his body cut or blown off.

Hybrid Transformation: By pulling on the cord emerging from his chest, Denji can transform into a bloodthirsty Chainsaw Devil. Denji needs blood in order to use his abilities, so if he does not have enough of it in his body, he can not fully transform and will instead enter a pseudo-hybrid form. While Denji still has access to some of his powers in this form, they are considerably weaker and his chainsaws are shorter. If Denji runs out of blood, while already being fully transformed, his chainsaws will automatically retract themselves. While in this form Denji still doesn't posses Pochita's signature ability of Devil erasure which was proven in his fight against the Falling Devil which was eaten by him but neither weakened or erased.

Augmented Strength: After entering his Hybrid form, Denji's physical strength is increased exponentially. He can break walls and kill most Devils with just one punch. On one occasion, he was able to catch a thrown car out of the air without staggering and then throw it back with an equal amount of force and on another occasion, he was capable of lifting a car and then throwing it with enough force to make it explode.

Augmented Durability: While in his Hybrid form, Denji's physical durability is increased to inhuman levels. He can fall from great attitudes and punch Devils through walls, without receiving any injuries. He also has survived a point-blank blast from the Bat Devil that destroyed a building behind him, multiple explosions from the Bomb Hybrid, being on fire for extended periods of time and being near the Typhoon Devil's tornado, which has been shown to be strong enough to lift cars. His head and chainsaws are far more durable than the rest of his body, due to being made of metal, and being capable of deflecting bullets.

Augmented Stamina: Denji was capable of fighting the Eternity Devil for approximately three days. As long as Denji continues to drink blood to recover from his injuries, he is essentially a perpetual motion machine.

Chainsaw Manifestation: As part of his transformation Denji grows fully-functional chainsaws from his arms, legs, feet and head. These chainsaws are extremely effective at cutting Devils' flesh, allowing Denji to sever limbs and bifurcate his enemies. They are also very effective at cutting other materials, such as stone and concrete, however they have shown to be incapable of cutting through metal. The chainsaws in his legs and feet are not usually active, however, Denji can employ them just by willing it. Just like the rest of his body, these chainsaws are regenerated every time Denji pulls his cord and fully transforms.

Chainsaw Retraction: If he needs the full use of his arms and legs to do certain tasks while in his Hybrid form, Denji's chainsaws can be retracted into his body, allowing him to perform mundane actions such as grabbing objects. While Denji can willingly retract his chainsaws, they can also be retracted automatically based on his instincts alone.
Chainsaw Wall Crawling: Denji is able to manifest short chainsaws under his feet, which he can use to stick onto walls and even walk on them. He used this ability once, in order to run away from a group of dolls that were created by Santa.
Chain Entanglement: Denji is able to disconnect his chains from his chainsaws to use them in combat. He can wrap his chains around his opponent's body and then pull them closer to him. Denji can also wrap his chains around objects to cut them, throw them or do both. If Denji's arms get torn off but are still connected to his body, he can still use his chain like body tissue to wrap his enemies around. The chains can also be used as grapple hooks, allowing Denji to wrap them around a target and then pull his body closer to said target.

Devil Transformation: After surrendering his contract with Pochita, Denji transformed into a Full Devil. In this form, Pochita displays incredible speed and strength, easily defeating multiple Hybrid Devils in a matter of seconds. Though he has been shown to have taken damage, and even been incapacitated by being sent to Hell and blasted into Space, these acts merely delayed him for a few minutes before he returned unscathed. His immense power is further highlighted in Hell, where it is implied that he defeated every Demon residing there. Makima stated that he has killed her 26 times in this form. This form seems to lack Denji's personality and awareness, though it has been shown to retain some memories and frequently acts in accordance with them. After being defeated by Makima to save Kobeni and later rescued by Power, Denji transformed back to normal and regained consciousness.

Blood Consumption: Denji is able to heal completely from nearly any fatal injury, and in some instances recover from death, so long as he consumes a sufficient amount of blood. After losing his arm to Bat Devil, Denji's arm re-attached itself after he received a blood transfusion. With his fight against Santa Claus, he consumed one of her doll's blood to keep fighting while still being on fire.

Nigh-Immortality: Due to being a Hybrid, Denji is immortal and nearly unkillable. He can survive getting shot, being thrown from buildings and taking all kinds of injuries that would kill most Devils. Even if he dies, as long as someone pulls the cord on his chest, Denji can come back to life in perfect condition. Even after being decapitated, being cursed by the Curse Devil and having most of his body blown up, Denji still managed to come back to life with no lasting damage.
Body Duplication: As a full Devil, he regenerated from just his heart after he ripped Pochita out and threw it from space. After noticing this method of regeneration, he is able to remove Pochita from his body and regenerate it as a separate entity that talked just like Denji, which allowed him to fool Makima, using the rest of Power's blood to seemingly keep himself alive without a heart while the duplicate fought.

Devil Contracts: 

Chainsaw Devil Contract: In exchange for living a "normal life", Pochita became Denji's heart and turned him into a Hybrid. All of his Hybrid abilities are originated from this contract.
Blood Devil Contract: In exchange for finding the reincarnated Blood Devil and befriending them, Power gave all of her remaining blood to revive Denji.

Blood Chainsaw: Due to the blood gained from Power, Denji is able to manifest a chainsaw made from said blood, boasting a sharp pair of horns similar to that of Power's on the base of the chainsaw. By using her blood manipulation ability that was imbued into the chainsaw, Denji was able to disturb the regeneration of Makima by causing her blood to continue ripping her body apart internally, which allowed him to defeat her.
Skill set

Hand-to-Hand Combat: Even without his transformation, Denji is a capable unarmed and armed fighter. Against the Leech Devil - which was many times his size and weight - he was able to easily block her blows, whilst delivering punches and headbutts with enough force to damage her. His skills improved further after training with Kishibe, in which he learnt to rely more on strategy instead of blind-strength.

Strategic Intelligence: Despite never receiving a proper education, Denji is very perceptive when it comes to ascertaining his enemies' weaknesses and how to exploit them. Denji was trained under Kishibe, who he refers to as "master" later on in the story, who teaches him various strategies. This is shown in the fight against Katana Man where Denji deceives Katana Man by making him think that Denji can only manifest chainsaws in his arms. Denji also managed to incapacitate Reze by using her weakness against water and defeat Santa Claus by abusing her weakness towards fire and light. In the time between Parts 1 and 2 Denji has continued developing his skills, such as learning to use his neck cables to reattach his head and legs after being dismembered and learning to resist mental attacks by damaging his own brain with his chainsaws as seen in the fight against the Falling Devil.

Swimming: After meeting Reze, Denji learned how to swim. He managed to use this skill to his advantage during his fight against her.

Anemia/Low Blood Amount: Despite being turned into a Devil Hybrid, Denji will suffer from anemia when he was fatally injured by either a shallow cut or a heavy blow, which weakens his transformation into Chainsaw Man. To counteract this, Denji must consume a copious amount of blood to refill his strength.

entries.name: Pillbug Fiend
entries.content:
The Pillbug Fiend is a Devil Hunter who works as a member of Public Safety's Tokyo Special Division 6.

The Pillbug Fiend possesses the corpse of an unknown man and wears the standard Public Safety Devil Hunter uniform and suit. The top half of his head resembles that of a pillbug, complete with a pair of long, segmented antennae extending from the front. Additionally, the Pillbug Fiend dons seven hard, articulated plates that cover the upper portion of his hands.

Not much is currently known about the Pillbug Fiend's personality but he is shown to be protective towards his coworkers when attempting to guard them from Pochita.

As a Fiend, the Pillbug Fiend can't make contracts and his powers are considerably weaker than those of his Devil form. However, he still has all the other standard Devil abilities.

Armored Plates: The Pillbug Fiend can use a pair of armored plates as arm guards for defensive purposes. He attempted to use this power but failed as Pochita effortlessly tore through his defenses.

entries.name: Nail Fiend
entries.content:
The Nail Fiend is a Devil Hunter who works as a member of Public Safety's Tokyo Special Division 7. They work together with Katana Man, often assisting him in taking down members of the Chainsaw Man Church.

At some point, they were originally a normal human, but died under unknown circumstances. Their body was subsequently found and possessed by the Nail Devil. They were then employed by Public Safety, likely sometime after Makima's death.

The Nail Fiend is dressed in the typical office worker and jacket attire of other Public Safety members. Their most notable feature is their face, which is completely split in half. The right half of their face is mostly cracked open and showing only nail-riddled brain matter even though other organs should be present.

In particular, there is a prominent crack on their right cheek, possibly as a result of the injury that caused their initial death, or one they sustained prior to it. The left half of their face is covered by a long fringe that reaches down to their nose. The hair on the back of their head is medium-length and flares outward.

Their form is rather androgynous; their pants are worn high up their waist similar to female members of Public Safety such as Himeno and Makima, but their torso - especially their chest and shoulders - is far more masculine in shape. They are also drawn with a predominant Adam's Apple, which is typically associated with men.

They are also always shown seen carrying a hammer which they use in combat.

Similar to their partner, the Nail Fiend believes to hold some form of moral principals. Whilst Katana Man respected his grandfather's work as a mobster who only killed "when necessary" and claimed to feel guilt over killing those transformed by the Zombie Devil, his partner criticises the Church for training children to act as soldiers due to valuing their innocence, as well as calling Yoru rude for kicking Fami out of the way of their attack. However, just like Katana Man, they have a major violent streak; most evident when they aggressively struck one of the children they were "protecting" just because they didn't speak politely, likely traumatizing the very children they claimed they were protecting the innocence of. Despite this, their protectiveness of children does seem to be legitimate, as their distaste for the culling of Fire Devil-contracted children is what lead to them betraying Public Safety.

Flamboyant and jovial, they also strike poses during combat and involve elaborate flips and slides in their movement, and during casual conversation they rest a hand on their hip. They often refer to other people with terms of endearments - such as calling the Church's children "moppets" or "dears" and Fami "the poor thing" when she was struck by Yoru - and they refer to themselves with unisex language and pronouns in the Japanese version. In addition, they tend to treat dangerous situations with a casual attitude, such as calling the Chainsaw Man Church elder "arrogant" when he morphs into his Devil form, and due to being placed among the ranks of other powerful Devils like Katana Man and Quanxi, they likely have the skill and proficiency to justify this behavior.

Nail Fiend seems to find men sexually attractive, as evident by how they laid by Denji's side when he slept. However, they don’t seem to find Denji's rudeness and grossness attractive in the slightest and they quickly lose interest in him.

Enhanced Physique: Similar to their partner, they can move at an extraordinarily fast speed, being able to disarm an entire squad of gunmen whilst dodging their every bullet. They are also able to swing their hammer with enough force and speed to pin nails into concrete walls from a distance whilst giving their targets no time to avoid the attack.

Hammer: The Nail Fiend also wields a hammer in battle, which they use to make their striking attacks.

entries.name: Takagi
entries.content:
Takagi is a Public Safety Devil Hunter and member of Tokyo Special Division 7. He serves as an antagonist in the Current arc, where he tries to prevent Asa and Fami from rescuing Chainsaw Man within the Tokyo Devil Detention Center.

Takagi appears to be a middle aged Japanese man dressed in standard issue Public Safety attire. His hair is trimmed short and neatly, with only a short tuft of hair coming down the left side of his fringe. His most notable feature is the stitched arc-shaped scar that wraps from his forehead, down his left eye and stopping short from the top of his lip. His intact eye is rather drowsy in appearance with notable eyebags, suggesting that the recent Devil attacks have taken a toll to his health.

Takagi is shown most in his element whenever he believes he has control over a situation and can order other, more powerful people to do his bidding in order to keep his hands clean. Without this control, his instinct is to either retreat and recuperate, or to violently snap.

His most notable trait is his relationship with his wife, whom had been transformed into a Pseudo-Chainsaw Man thanks to a Fire Devil contract. Despite claiming to love her and viewing her as a symbol of good in the world, he still went behind her back and cheated on her, even dismissing his actions as not being severe due to how the affair only lasted half a year. In addition to how he treats his wife, he also appears to treat women as lesser beings, as his dying words implied he was about to say something sexist due to Quanxi's disobedience.

Despite to his "devotion" to his wife, he appears to be fairly apathetic to the suffering of others: he didn't object to any of Denji's organ harvesting despite how much pain it would've caused the boy, and when he found out his wife was turned into a devil, he instead wished his ornery neighbour should've transformed instead.

Unlike the other Special Division 7 members (excluding Fumiko), Takagi doesn't possess any unique abilities that makes him stand out nor does he present any physical prowess when encountering Asa and Fami's group. Due to being a normal human being, Takagi prefers to run away from fights he cannot win as a result.

entries.name: Kentaro Ishita
entries.content:
Kentaro Ishita is the current Prime Minister of Japan.

Prime Minister Ishita is an ageing elderly figure with short, dark hair. He has two moles near his left eyebrow and noticeable wrinkles.

Despite being the leader of Japan's government, Ishita is a rather meek individual. He seems to react with fear or bewilderment upon hearing Public Safety's plan on erasing the Aging Devil, and he has no qualms in letting Tadashi Hasegawa - someone who theoretically should have no power over him - take initiative in agreeing to the plan.

entries.name: Hadaji Sakagami
entries.content:
Hadaji Sakagami is Japan's Minister of Internal Affairs and Communication.

Sakagami is an elderly man with neatly combed white hair. His eyes are wizened and he has noticeable wrinkles.

Little is known about Sakagami's personality. He appears to be rather resourceful, as his department were responsible for recording the status of the Ear Devil's erasure.

entries.name: Shin Toma
entries.content:
Shin Toma is Japan's Minister of Defense.

Toma is a late middle-aged to elderly Japanese man with pale hair. Compared to his fellow politicians, he wears a paler suit.

Toma is shown to be one of the Japanese board members who is unsure of the safety of Public Safety’s plan to utilise Chainsaw Man as a tool. This is best illustrated in his response to the Aging Devil’s plan, which was to question the contract price that Public Safety had in place with it.

entries.name: Yuki Tomoda
entries.content:
Yuki Tomoda is Japan's Chief of Cabinet Secretary.

Tomoda is a middle-aged man who is starting to show the signs of aging; his lower eyelids are starting to grow puffy and his hairline is starting to recede.

Tomoda is the most outwardly critical of Public Safety’s plan, as he immediately raises the concerns of side effects whilst calling the whole process messy.

entries.name: Tadashi Hasegawa
entries.content:
Tadashi Hasegawa is Japan's Former Minister of Finance.

Tadashi is the most elderly member of the politician board by far; unlike the other members, he’s entirely bald and confined to a wheelchair.

Tadashi appears to be the most malevolent and influential member of the Japanese board of politicians - even moreso than the prime minister himself - as it was his confirmation that lead to the Aging Devil contract going through. He also holds no qualms with threatening other politicians and their families.

entries.name: Miki Takanashi
entries.content:
Miki Takanashi is Japan's Minister of Economy, Trade, and Industry.

Compared to his peers, Takanashi is by far the youngest. He has noticeably round eyes and slanted eyebrows.

Takanashi is the sole member of the Japanese politician board who outwardly protests against the morality and ethics regarding Public Safety’s plan. He’s also the only member concerned for the welfare of children, regardless if they’re Japanese-born citizens or not.

entries.name: Centipede Devil
entries.content:
The Centipede Devil is a Devil that embodies the fear of centipedes.

The Centipede Devil resembles a large, monstrous centipede with two eyes and jagged teeth.

Nothing is currently known about the Centipede Devil's personality except it presumably possesses hatred for humans like all non-humanoid devils.

After Pochita dismembers the second iteration of Tokyo Special Division 5 on a skyscraper, Special Division 6 detonates explosives directly underneath the Chainsaw Devil, causing him to descend.

Upon landing, Pochita is briefly restrained by the Centipede Devil, who attacks him alongside two other insect-like Devils. Without any warning, Pochita swiftly shreds the Centipede Devil and its allies to pieces alongside the Special Division 6 leader and the Pillbug Fiend.

As a Devil, the Centipede Devil possesses all of the standard Devil abilities. They are able to use their body to wrap around their targets to render them unable to move. Its grip on Pochita was strong enough to keep him restrained for a brief moment before being shredded to pieces.

entries.name: Pochita's Abilities
entries.content:
Immense Speed: As noted by Beam, the Chainsaw Devil was renowned for his amazing speed. When fighting Makima and the hybrids, he effortlessly assaulted them before they could even react. He moves almost instantly, making it look like he is teleporting to his opponents. When the Hell Devil was summoned to defeat Chainsaw Man, it couldn't even attack before being effortlessly dismembered.

Immense Durability: The Chainsaw Devil's body is incredibly tough, being able to survive sonic lashes, explosions, piercing attacks, massive concussive blasts capable of sending him into space and atmospheric entry burns with little to no major repercussions. He was also able to survive the onslaught of Makima's Thousand Year Spear attack, even when weakened by public adoration, though he was in critical condition thereafter.

Immense Strength: As stated by Pochita himself, when he was Chainsaw Man, he was so strong that he couldn't do basic social interactions like receiving or giving a hug. This is even more highlighted on his visit to the Burger Shop, where even small movements of his arms were enough to kill several locals, probably accidentally. To avoid unintentionally injuring Kobeni Higashiyama with his force, he had to carry her using his intestine scarf. Later, while fighting the hybrids, his attack on Quanxi and Miri Sugo was so powerful that it destroyed several buildings and effortlessly decapitated both of them.

Immense Healing Factor: As a full Devil, Pochita's regenerative abilities are enhanced to the point that he completely regenerated his body from just his heart after throwing it from space without needing blood, even when suffering intense atmospheric entry burns. Later on, this ability of Pochita was used cleverly by Denji that he removed Pochita from his body by leaving his body without a heart and let Pochita regenerate completely to mimic Denji and fool Makima.

Devil Erasure: The Chainsaw Devil is infamously able to consume other Devils, causing the "name" they represent to vanish from public consciousness while also erasing their physical existence. Barem Bridge speculates that chainsaws may have had many different uses originally, but Chainsaw Man repeatedly consuming Devils and erasing their related concepts eventually left the chainsaws' only use to cut down trees, with Pochita's concept erasure being a remnant of that. Kishibe was unable to recall historical events or things such as the Holocaust, Nazis or nuclear weapons, meaning that the Chainsaw Devil at some point consumed their respective Devils. The specifics of this ability are unclear; Makima was able to recall numerous erased names, and the War Devil wanted to make the Chainsaw Devil "puke" the Nuclear Weapons Devil up. The erasure process can be partial: after the War Devil was partially devoured, the concept of "war" has remained, but no more wars have broken out in the human world.

Chainsaw Appendage: As an embodiment of fear of chainsaws, protruding from Pochita's head is a chainsaw shaped appendage that functions as an actual chainsaw. This ability is activated when the cord in his tail is pulled. As a full Devil, besides his head, he has four arms with chainsaw appendages. He can also generate chainsaws from his legs.

Chain Entanglement: Pochita is able to disconnect his chains from his chainsaws to wrap around his opponent's body. He uses this to pull them closer to him. He's able to capture multiple opponents with it. Beam claimed that the Chainsaw Devil could use his chains to hook around buildings to move around quickly in the past, but this has yet to be seen currently.
Body Assimilation: Pochita can fuse with a human body, restoring it to full health in the process. It was done on Denji, turning him into a hybrid. It is later revealed by Makima that this fusion occurred as a result of the contract. In exchange for Denji living a "normal life", Pochita becomes the heart of Denji.

Devil Transformation: Should Denji's contract with Pochita ever be broken, Pochita can possess Denji's body and return to his original form. Makima stated that he has killed her 26 times in this state. The form seems to be under the control of Pochita as it is shown that he remembers Denji's dreams and tries to fulfill the requirements of their contract by eating a hamburger and going on a date with a girl. After being defeated by Makima to save Kobeni Higashiyama and later being rescued by Power, Denji's contract was restored and Pochita reverted back to his heart form while Denji transformed back into his normal hybrid. Pochita still can transform into his Devil form if Denji removes the heart from his body, in this form, Pochita has retain a calmer personality and has two arms similar to Denji`s hybrid form, however his arms are still covered with an armor.

entries.name: Aging Devil's Abilities
entries.content:
The Aging Devil is described as a transcendent being — one of the "Primal Fear" Devils that have never experienced death due to being so powerful; embodying a Primal Fear, it can be assumed that the Aging Devil is almost as old as humanity itself. The true extent of their power is still unknown, but they are powerful enough to overwhelm the Chainsaw Devil with a single, powerful punch and easily stop a bullet from one of Yoru's most powerful weapons (capable of even overpowering the Chainsaw Devil himself).

Naturally, it possesses all of the standard Devil abilities such as blood consumption, contract creation, etc. They appears to have made a contract with three Public Safety agents: by cutting off a finger each and writing the word "HIT" on the mirrors in blood, preceded by the names of body parts (cervical spine, neck and vertebrae, probably additional body parts to be sacrificed), the Aging Devil would proceed to strike its enemy with a single, powerful attack.

It is possible, however, that its number of contracts is much higher, as it tends to transport people who do not wish to age into the Aging's World as part of a contract. The Aging Devil later utilizes another contract with several other Public Safety agents, one that involves using their bodies as weapons in exchange for being spared from the Chainsaw Devil's attacks. From there, the Aging Devil can sacrifice any organ from the agents to continuously cleave Pochita to shreds.

Fumiko Mifune states that the Aging Devil, due to having no attachment to life, is ready to make another contract with the Japanese Public Security and Government: in exchange for killing 10,000 children with Japanese citizenships, between the ages of infancy and nine, in front of mirrors, the Aging Devil will let itself be devoured by the Chainsaw Devil without putting up any resistance, removing "Aging" as a concept from the world. It later reveals that it wants humans to live longer so they may reach the culmination of thought on questions beyond how to escape Aging's World, and discover new concepts and unseen possibilities, even if it comes at a cost such as its death and consumption.


Nigh-Absolute Immortality: Devils of Primal Fear status are considered unkillable due to their power, hence why they never undergo reincarnation. Like with the Darkness and Falling Devils, humanity has no means of attack that could kill a Primal Fear.

Hell Connection: The Aging Devil can freely manifest floating mirrors that connect directly to Hell. This allows it to send powerful attacks on opponents via large hands similar to that of the Hell Devil. This ability also works in reverse, with humans being able to contact the Aging Devil through mirrors.

Time Manipulation: The Aging Devil possesses the ability to seemingly stop time, as it was able to easily stop a speeding bullet that was launched for continental travel at incredible speeds from Yoru's powerful Gun Goddess weapon, allowing them to observe and comment on it and a time-frozen Yoru before destroying the bullet and sending Yoru to the Aging's World.

Rapid-Onset Aging: The Aging Devil can make someone or something rapidly age via physical contact, to the point that it can crumble into dust in mere seconds or transform them into a tree.

Remote Harm: By sacrificing a human's body parts, the Aging Devil can cause a target to take extreme damage regardless of distance, even managing to dismember Chainsaw Man with a single strike. Unlike a normal contract's sacrifice, where the sacrifice simply vanishes, when this ability is used the sacrifice is violently and painfully destroyed. The Aging Devil seems to find this ability an "ugly method".

Aging's World: The Aging Devil has the ability to transport individuals to an alternate realm, which appears as a lush forest with a lake. After Denji vomited the head of the Snow Devil, the forest became filled with snow, implying that the alternate realm typically snows and its prior setting was due to Pochita consuming the Snow Devil. In this reality, its residents have no need for food or water and are even incapable of dying, slowly going insane. The Devils' powers also seem to be nullified, as Yoru was unable to kill Denji, who instead reverted to human form.

The Primal Fear typically selects people who do not wish to age, bringing them to this reality as part of a contract, but can also do so forcibly, as in the case of Yoru and Denji. The Aging Devil's most recent victim (who was transported to the Aging's World 82 years earlier) says that it is nearly impossible to escape from this reality, with only one person supposedly having succeeded.

When reaching the culmination of thought upon arriving at some sort of answer, those who remain trapped for 1,000 or 2,000 years turn into a tree. According to the Aging Devil, this mechanism isn't a result of its powers and is innate to humans. These people, although on the outside look like trees, are still flesh and blood internally which can be consumed by a Devil to regenerate. Only once the tree rots into soil, and their body and mind have become one with nature, will they be allowed to return to their original body in the real world.

The Aging Devil can manifest itself within this world, emerging their head from the trees to speak with the people that have been imprisoned there. However, as displayed, this manifestation is not their true body, as even the Aging Devil loses access to their powers should their true body be forcibly transported to their world. As shown where after being forcibly dragged into it via Pochita/Denji's stomach, the Aging Devil was also unable to access their powers when their actual body was brought there and was thus unable to kill Asa, Denji, Yoshida and its latest victim.

entries.name: Fake Chainsaw Man
entries.content:
The Fake Chainsaw Man is an enigmatic figure who appears multiple times throughout the Academy Saga. Despite claiming himself to be Chainsaw Man, his real name and identity currently remains unknown.

The Fake Chainsaw Man is an exceptionally tall male and has a rather bulky physique. He wears an all-black uniform and dark pants which appears to be the common outfit of male Devil Hunter Club members. He also wears a black cap which obscures his face, however his hair is still visible and was shown to be black.

In his transformed state, his head is morphed into a demonic, mechanical hape with long, jagged fangs resembling Denji and Pochita's devilish forms. His body becomes more grotesque and skeletal in structure, and large chainsaws emerge from both his forehead and arms; much longer than Denji's. He also dons a large flesh-like cape that drapes over his body similar to that of Pochita's intestine scarf.

Not much is known about the Fake Chainsaw Man's personality except that he speaks in a formal, polite, and calm manner. When encountering the real Chainsaw Man for the first time, the imposter expresses a strong desire to help him out in any way possible. The Fake Chainsaw Man also firmly opposes anything related to the Prophecy of Nostradamus, striving to prevent it from becoming a reality. Additionally, he appears to be aware of the Devils residing within Hell, and demonstrates knowledge of religion when mentioning Adam and Eve in his TV speech.

Like with those contracted with the Fire Devil, the Fake Chainsaw Man possesses a distorted sense of justice, believing that defeating Devils with Devil powers and delivering "justice" to so-called evildoers is what defines justice itself. When confronting threats such as the Death Devil, he notably speaks in an overly heroic manner that deviates from Denji's crude way of talking. His belief in what he stands for is strong enough to make him refuse to believe he would ever make any mistakes as long as he is guided by "justice". He also states that he has the power of "justice" within him, notably referring to the power and himself as "us" during one point. However, whether it means he quite literally has the "Justice Devil" inside of him or not is yet to be seen.

In general, he seems to be very powerful, as he has no qualms facing a member of the Primal Fears. Not much is known about the nature his abilities, though so far they are mostly similar to those of Denji's Hybrid powers. These abilities include:

Chainsaw Manifestation: Just like his original counterpart, he grows fully functional chainsaws from his arms and head. These chainsaws are extremely effective at cutting Devils' flesh as seen when battling the Falling Devil and later the Famine Devil. It is unknown whether he can extend chainsaws from his legs like Denji can. Just like Denji he can also temporarily retract his chainsaws if he needs to do certain tasks, such as picking something up. Notably, retracting his chainsaws seems to leave long gashes in his arms unlike Denji's chainsaws, which simply melt away.

Enhanced Strength: He is shown to easily hold up Yuko's entire body with just one hand. Later after he incapacitated the Falling Devil he lifts her up as well, holding up her entire body weight with just his neck. During his battle against the Famine Devil, the fake Chainsaw Man is capable of overpowering her using nothing but the sheer strength of his enhanced body's chainsaws.

Enhanced Speed: As shown when battling the Famine Devil, the Fake Chainsaw Man appears to move much faster than the average human, as he can swiftly hack down his opponents in mere seconds.

After Yuko says her goodbyes to Asa, she sets off on a journey to find her Devil Hunter relative, seeking to find a way to return to a human form. She tries to get some rest on the rooftop of one of the buildings, unaware of the imposter lurking near her location. When she awakens, Yuko discovers that she got beheaded by the Fake Chainsaw Man, even mistaking him for the real thing before presumably dying afterward.

When the Falling Devil blocks the way for Denji and Asa's escape out of Hell, Fake Chainsaw Man appears behind her, tearing her apart and incapacitating her. He explains to Denji that the Falling Devil does not tolerate customers who don't finish their food, and as a result, the rest of the Devils in Hell will desperately try to devour Asa in order to satisfy her demands. He then asks Chainsaw Man to evade the other Devils until sunrise.

He is later presented on live television by Haruka, to prove to the public that the Chainsaw Man Church really does have contact with Chainsaw Man. He introduces himself as Chainsaw Man and reveals who he is and why he fights.

This greatly upsets Denji on the other side of the TV screen, furious about his backstory, achievements and motivations being falsified and misappropriated by someone. Asa Mitaka also witnesses this broadcast but manages to decipher that the Chainsaw Man on television isn't the same one who saved her from the Falling Devil.

Just as the "Death Devil" is about to use her powers on a bandaged student to "save" mankind from their "earthly suffering", the Fake Chainsaw Man reveals himself by declaring that he will stop her in the name of justice. He makes good on his words by rushing in and swiftly hacking the devil to pieces. Although confused by how "easy" it was to take down Death herself, the imposter assures himself that he did the right thing. He informs the bandaged student he is Chainsaw Man and that it is his duty to prevent the Prophecy of Nostradamus from becoming a reality. The imposter also reveals that the Death Devil is partly responsible for these events.

Even when being told he has made a mistake, the imposter refutes it by reminding himself "they" would never make mistakes as the "Justice Devil" resides within him. He then immediately notices one of the Devil's severed arms latching onto the student's leg. Screaming for him to watch out, the imposter can only watch as the Devil absorbs the student's lifespan to revive herself. He quickly braces himself for a second round against the devil, who readies herself to "save" her opponent within three seconds. The two rush at each other, only for the Fake Chainsaw Man to easily overpower the devil while mocking her for being weak.

The Devil attempts to bribe the Fake Chainsaw Man with a mere 2,000 yen, but the attempt fails since he doesn't believe money is real or important. She responds by claiming she still needs to save lives, but he argues that even though she wants to save people through death to ease their suffering, she's unaware that people still have hope despite their bleak circumstances. He tells her that as the Death Devil, she could never truly understand this fact. To clear things up, the Devil regenerates her body by draining the lifespan of the ants nearby and introduces herself as Fami, the Famine Devil.

Confused, the Fake Chainsaw Man questions the Devil's identity, but they are suddenly crushed to the ground by the work of the Falling Devil under the orders of the true Death Devil, who acted under Famine's identity. After the two (along with several bystanders and a giraffe) are arranged on a plate for the Falling Devil's "Blood Sautéed Human and Giraffe" dish, Death descends to the ground, and the Fake Chainsaw Man recognizes her as the real Death Devil. He then watches as Famine pleads with her sister to die to keep humanity safe, after which Death lifts her school uniform to reveal that she could not die even after removing all of her organs.

entries.name: Asa and Yoshida
entries.content:
Asa attends the same school as Yoshida but doesn't interact much with him. Yoru briefly takes control over Asa and asks Yoshida out so she can turn him into one of her weapons, with Yoshida declining and Asa getting embarrassed. When Fami locks the Devil Hunter Club in an aquarium, Asa and Yoshida keep their interactions brief and cease entirely after Asa accidentally destroys her phone. After Nayuta prevents Asa's date with Denji, Yoshida finds her mumbling to herself and invites her to the club's office. Asa wonders why a public safety Devil Hunter would spend time with her and begins wondering if he likes her. As they turn out to share some values, Asa becomes excited to get asked out, only to be let down again. Yoshida tells her to stay away from Denji without elaborating, making Asa more depressed.

When Asa encounters Yoshida again in the Aging's World, she expresses hatred towards him for having cutting her arm off before, even to the point of attempting to attack him when he falsely apologizes to her. Yoshida instead dismisses Asa's anger, reasoning that since she regrew her arms, there's no reason for her to be mad at him.

entries.name: Asa and Barem
entries.content: Even though he is a member of the very same organization, it appears Asa has not yet met Barem. Despite this, the Flamethrower Hybrid already seems to have developed animosity and disrespect towards her. Barem calls her "dumb" and outright asks Denji if that means killing her would bring Chainsaw Man back. He later abandons his plan to kill Asa Mitaka to anger Denji because he knew Denji hardly knows her and he knew Denji wouldn't be affected by it that much. Instead, he decides to murder Denji's pets with the other Weapon Hybrids since they seemed "more flammable" to him than Asa, just to get a reaction out of him.

entries.name: Death Devil's Abilities
entries.content:
The Death Devil is the strongest Devil in existence, her name being most feared of all.

Death herself possesses all of the standard Devil abilities. While her powers and their extent are still unclear, she seems to be able to influence the power of Devils in some way. Rather than being directly involved in conflicts, she prefers to utilize the powers of other Devils who are either cooperating with her voluntarily or under her direct control. She was able to separate Yoru from Asa temporarily but left Asa her power to turn people and objects into weapons and communicated with her at a distance despite Asa being trapped in another Devil's pocket dimension.

While lesser "Primal Fears" are already transcendent beings that cannot be killed and whose mere presence can be felt across the world, the Death Devil's arrival is held as tantamount to the apocalypse. Indeed, the Prophecy of Nostradamus calls her "Ultimate Terror" and "Great King of Terror" — who is to usher in an Age of Devils and thus end the human race. According to Yoru, once Death descends, the other high-ranking Devils, such as the Fire Devil, will pay court to her.

However, her sisters seem to believe that killing Death is within the realms of possibility: Makima desired to kill all her sisters by having Chainsaw Man eat them, and "Fami" plots to empower the War and Chainsaw Devils by rapidly reigniting humanity's collective fear of them (by means of inciting a global war) so that both can grow strong enough to rival Death. Yoshida has reiterated this notion, stating that, while no country in the world has the means to prevent Death's descent, if War were to control Chainsaw Man as a mindless weapon, humanity may have a chance of surviving and perhaps even overcoming Death.


Nigh-Absolute Immortality: Devils of Primal Fear status are considered unkillable due to their power, hence why they never undergo reincarnation. The Falling Devil has affirmed that, at present, humanity has no means of attack available that could kill a Primal Fear.

Enhancing Healing: The Death Devil has shown the ability to heal others, causing the healed person to gain great strength and size. This ability was used on Yuko after she was fatally injured by Asa Mitaka's weapon.
Enslavement: While acting as the Famine Devil, the Death Devil claimed to be able to turn the "hungry"  into her "pawns" to do her bidding, and this ability is shown to work even on a "Primal Fear" Devil. The Death Devil can turn those whom she put under her control into miniature effigies of themselves to transport more easily. However, the Death Devil says that the Devils under her control cannot use their full strength and that her summoning has restrictions, the exact nature of which she won't reveal, promoting her to use this power sparingly.

Falling Devil: One of the Devils that the Death Devil has successfully turned into pawns is the Primal Fear, Falling Devil. The Death Devil seemed to enjoy total obedience from the Falling Devil despite her own immense power.

Fire Devil: Another one of the Devils she has managed to turn into a pawn is the Fire Devil, who gets stronger the more contracts it does.

Guillotine Devil: One of Death's many pawns she collected at some point in time. Despite being under Death's control, this Devil exhibits its own level of independence by disobeying its current master's commands on occasion.

Teleportation: The Death Devil can seemingly appear anywhere she chooses at any moment. She snapped her fingers to teleport out of the aquarium and later suddenly appeared next to Yoru and Asa who noted that the door was locked so there was no way she could have gotten in.

entries.name: Death Devil and Makima
entries.content: Makima, the first Control Devil, sought to kill all three of her Horseman sisters to better the world for humanity, or at least claimed as much. Barem Bridge later averred this, saying Makima's goal had always been to use Chainsaw Man's power to defeat Death so that a controlled, peaceful world may arrive.

entries.name: Death Devil and Fami
entries.content: The Death Devil possesses an apathetic demeanor towards her younger sister Fami, though she does apologize for using her name as an alias to deceive everyone around her.

entries.name: Death Devil and Nayuta
entries.content: Nayuta, the Control Devil's second incarnation, was well aware of Death's status as the strongest Devil. She noted that she and "Fami", as her younger sisters, can tell that the Death Devil will indeed descend to Earth, while also deducing "Fami"'s scheme to stop Death by empowering War and Chainsaw Man. However, Nayuta did not directly involve herself with "Fami"'s plan to kill their strongest sibling, as she would rather go to school. She never learned that "Fami" was none other than the Death Devil herself by the time of her untimely demise.

entries.name: Death Devil and Yoru
entries.content: Yoru, the War Devil, has not yet made her position regarding the Death Devil and the Prophecy known. Regardless, "Fami" and the Chainsaw Man Church plan to pit War and Chainsaw against Death. It is later revealed that Yoru is aware of the Death Devil's impending arrival and plans to have her eldest sister dealt with so that she can enact something far more catastrophic than humanity's destruction. Like with the others, she is unaware that the "Fami" she knows is none other than the Death Devil herself.

entries.name: Death Devil and Pochita
entries.content: The Four Horsemen are said to have engaged in a brutal fight against Chainsaw Man in Hell, with the Death Devil's degree of involvement being unknown.
